fdroid:co.rorystandley.rune.name: Rune
fdroid:co.rorystandley.rune.summary: Private, on-device encrypted notes. No network, no telemetry, no trackers.
fdroid:co.rorystandley.rune.description:
Rune is a calm, fast notes app for people who don't want to trust an app with
their data. Your notes never leave your device, they are encrypted at rest, and
the app makes no network connections at all. There is no account, no cloud, and
no sign-up.
Privacy by construction, not by promise:
* No telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising, no tracking —
 none, not "anonymised", not "aggregated".
* No networking code. Put your device in airplane mode and everything still
 works. If anything ever tries to reach the network, that is a bug.
* No account and no server. There is no "we" that could hold your data.
Real encryption:
* Your passphrase derives a key with Argon2id; notes are sealed with
 XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption. Only ciphertext is ever written
 to disk.
* The passphrase is never stored and is not recoverable. If you forget it, your
 notes are gone — no reset, no backdoor. That is the price of real privacy.
* A wrong passphrase simply cannot decrypt your notes.
What you can do:
* Create, edit, search, and organise plain-text notes with an Apple-Notes-style
 layout that adapts from phone to desktop.
* Auto-lock on inactivity and lock-on-background; the app starts locked.
* Export an encrypted backup (safe to keep anywhere); plaintext export is gated
 behind an explicit warning.
* Capture voice notes — recording stays entirely on your device.
Free and open source under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later. The security-critical code is a small,
dependency-light, pure-Dart core so it can be read and audited. Releases published on
GitHub ship with cryptographic provenance (SLSA build-provenance attestations
and a keyless cosign signature) so you can verify those binaries were built from
this source. Builds distributed by F-Droid are built and signed by F-Droid
itself and are not covered by that provenance.
This is honest software: it tells you what it does not yet do. See the project's
SECURITY.md for the threat model and current limitations.

For example if you have enabled English and Persian and Persian (Pinglish) layouts the order going to be English (tap > ABC >) Persian (tap > ABC >) Persian (Pinglish) (tap > ABC >) English ...

6. This is open source application. Feel free to contribute on https://github.com/pi3ch/persian_anysoftkeyboard

fdroid:com.corphish.quicktools.name: Text Tools
fdroid:com.corphish.quicktools.summary: Useful text related functions that can be done on the selected text
fdroid:com.corphish.quicktools.description:
Collection of useful text related tools that can be accessed from the context menu that appears on text selection. The feature list will keep on growing. Let me know if you have any ideas.
Current Features
1. Text unsaved numbers in WhatsApp - Often we find ourselves needing to text/send file/share location to someone for temporary purposes (if you ask me, I face this a lot in situations where I go to a printing centre where they ask me to share the file that I want to print over WhatsApp, so I have to save their contact, refresh my WhatsApp contact list and then send them). Having a context menu option to directly open a WhatsApp chat from their phone number would save a lot of time and keep your phonebook clean, right?
2. Evaluate mathematical expressions inline - We may often find ourselves to mathematically calculate something while texting someone (probably while making plans). Having an option to perform math calculations in line without needing to open calculator could save time.
3. Transform text - Transform the selected text inline. Supported transformations include changing the case, wrapping it with text etc.
4. Text analysis - Get detailed analysis about character count, word count, letter count and more for the selected text.
5. Save text to a file - Lets you save the selected text into a file so that it can be accessed later.
6. Find & Replace - Quickly find certain text and replace them with text of your choice within the selected text.
7. Number Analysis -Analyze numbers, convert them to different bases, find factors, prime information, and more.
8. Text Templates - Create and apply custom text templates with your selected text as a parameter.
9. Actions - Process the text directly with supported system functions.
Where are screenshots?
The app adds capabilities to text selection wherever supported in the Android System, there is nothing much to do inside the app, hence very less screenshots.
Installation Warning
While installing the app (you have to sideload), Google Play may block the installation saying it has never seen the app before. While it is true (from Google Play POV), kindly proceed with installing the app. If you have doubts about the app being malicious, you are free to verify the same from the source code (it would not be open-source if the app was malicious in the first place, right?).

fdroid:com.thothterm.debian.name: ThothTerm • ThothDock
fdroid:com.thothterm.debian.summary: Docker on your phone, in a Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) terminal. No root.
fdroid:com.thothterm.debian.description:
ThothTerm • ThothDock is an independent Android application. It provides a terminal, a Debian
GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) environment to work in under PRoot, and ThothDock, a
Docker-compatible container engine for phones without root. No root, no virtual
machine, no remote server: everything runs on the phone, in the app.
The Debian side is ordinary Debian. apt and dpkg install from Debian's own
archives (trixie, trixie-updates and trixie-security), sudo is Debian's sudo,
and what you install, like your home, survives app updates.
What you get
* Debian 13 "trixie", arm64, set up on first launch
* apt, dpkg and passwordless sudo for the user thoth
* Several terminal windows, pinch-to-zoom, an extra keys row, copy and paste
* Correct Arabic and other right-to-left text
* ThothDock: the Docker command line, working on the phone, with no root
* Docker Compose, user networks with container names, restart policies
* Containers, Images and Volumes screens: start, stop, logs, shell, delete
* Flatpak apps and snaps, run by ThothDock and listed in an Apps screen
* A Web Panel to manage containers from a browser, over HTTPS with a pairing code
* LAN Mode, to use the same Debian from a web browser on another computer
ThothDock
ThothDock is a Docker-compatible container engine written for unrooted
Android. The unmodified Docker command line talks to it over a private socket
that only this app can open, so docker pull, run, exec, logs, stop, volumes,
-p port publishing and docker compose work from the terminal. There is no
dockerd: containers run through the same PRoot that runs Debian. Containers
on a user network get a private loopback address and reach each other by name.
Containers are userspace environments, not a security boundary: there are no
namespaces and no resource limits. A published port is a loopback listener
that every app on the phone can reach; UDP publishing is not supported.
Containers stop when the app is closed. Images are downloaded only when you run
docker pull or docker run, never in the background. Android may end the engine
when too many processes run; the Containers screen warns first. Engine
Guard stops apt replacing ThothDock with a real Docker engine.
Flatpak and snap
Debian's flatpak works: ThothDock runs its sandboxes, as bubblewrap needs root.
The snap command installs from the Snap Store and runs apps and services; it
contacts the store only when you run snap find, info or install. Each app or service gets its own loopback address. Snap confinement
and Flatpak sandboxing are not enforced, as with containers.
Web Panel and LAN Mode
Both are off until you turn them on and never listen on mobile data. The Web
Panel serves HTTPS only, on the phone itself or on Wi-Fi or Ethernet; a browser
must enter the pairing code shown on the phone, and its sessions end when the
panel stops.
LAN Mode gives each paired browser its own terminal after a one-time PIN. Its
connection is plain, unencrypted HTTP: use it only on networks you trust.
First run
The F-Droid build does not include Debian, so the first launch offers to
download it: about 60 MB from the project's GitHub release. Nothing is
downloaded until you agree. The download is checked against a size and a
SHA-256 checksum written into the app, and refused if either differs. The
archive holds only unmodified Debian packages, built reproducibly by a script in
the app's source.
Requirements: a 64-bit ARM phone (arm64-v8a) with Android 8.0 or newer, and
about 185 MB for Debian after setup.
ThothTerm • ThothDock is an independent application and is not affiliated with or
endorsed by the Debian Project. Debian is a registered trademark owned by
Software in the Public Interest, Inc.
ThothTerm is free software under the Apache License 2.0, a fork of TermOne
Plus, which derives from Terminal Emulator for Android and the Android Open
Source Project. The PRoot runtime is built from source during the build.
Licences are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

fdroid:hans.b.skewy1_0.name: Skewy - anti eavesdropping
fdroid:hans.b.skewy1_0.summary: A tool to prevent eavesdropping and ultrasonic access of your smart phone.
fdroid:hans.b.skewy1_0.description:
Skewy has two objectives:
 1) By pressing Play, Skewy's sound will mask your conversation / will make the data picked up by the microphone unusable (like a jammer). Giving someone who wants to use this data a near impossible task to filter out what you said. The Sound Tab allows for fine tuning of the sound level and set an optional alarm to notify when masking no longer occurs.
 2) Skewy processes the data to identify ultrasonic (inaudible) signals. Such signals are used by advertisement/tracking companies such as SilverPush to access your phone without you noticing. Skewy can notify you when such a signal is present and optionally jam such a signal, if the frequency shield is turned on.
 All data is visualized with live graphs (both sound and frequency).
 It works best with a small hardware extension (a small speaker/headphone) to focus the sound on the mic, making it silent its surroundings. An idea how to build it is found in the Menu.
 No actual sound data is saved.

fdroid:io.github.chrisimx.scanbridge.summary: F-Droid is the app distribution ecosystem for Android where your user freedom comes first. Discover our app store, explore the world of free and open source (FOSS) apps and [learn](https://f-droid.org/about/) about our app distribution tools.

AirScan/eSCL ist ein weit verbreitetes Protokoll, mit dem du dich über dein Netzwerk mit netzwerkfähigen Scannern verbinden und Dokumente scannen kannst – ganz ohne zusätzliche Software oder Treiber.

 Modernes Design: Ansprechendes Material-You-Design.
 Benutzerfreundlichkeit: Intuitive und leicht bedienbare Oberfläche.
 ScanBridge ist kostenlos, quelloffen und enthält weder Werbung noch Tracking. Die App wurde mit einer Hochachtung auf Datenschutz entwickelt und benötigt keine Berechtigungen – außer der Internet-Berechtigung, um auf den Netzwerkscanner zugreifen zu können. Diese wird von Android automatisch erteilt. Es werden keine Daten oder Telemetrie gesammelt.

fdroid:io.heckel.ntfy.name: ntfy - PUT/POST to your phone
fdroid:io.heckel.ntfy.summary: Send notifications to your phone from any script using PUT/POST requests
fdroid:io.heckel.ntfy.description:
Send notifications to your phone from any Bash or PowerShell script, or from your own app using PUT/POST requests, e.g. via curl on Linux or Invoke-WebRequest.
ntfy is an Android client for https://ntfy.sh, a free and open source HTTP-based pub-sub service. You can subscribe to topics in this app, and then publish messages via a simple HTTP API.
Uses:
* Notify yourself when a long-running process is done
* Ping your phone when a backup has failed
* Alerts when someone logs into your server
Example:
$ curl -d "Your backup is done" ntfy.sh/mytopic
Find more examples and usage instructions here:
* Website: https://ntfy.sh
* GitHub (server): https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy
* GitHub (Android app): https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy-android

This app is a complement to Orbot, which provides the full, "batteries included" Tor utility.

apple-macos:1582306019.name: Big News - Smart Reader
apple-macos:1582306019.description:
Big News blends your newsletters and feeds together into one super-smart reading experience.
- Combine newsletters and RSS feeds together
- Get your very own @bignews.app email address
- Sort stories by the day's biggest news
- Enjoy a beautiful fullscreen, distraction-free reading experience 
- Realtime push notifications from your favourite channels
- Add the news to your home screen with our Widgets
- Search hundreds of thousands of stories in a snap
One place for your newsletters and feeds:
Big News combines different sources from across the web – like newsletters and RSS feeds – into one unified reading experience. So it doesn't matter what you're reading, or where it's from, you can find it all in Big News.
An email address just for newsletters:
With your very own @bignews.app email address, newsletters skip your regular inbox and instead are sent directly to Big News. That means less stuff mixed in with your daily emails and more great reads for when you want them.
Not just another inbox: 
We didn't want to create another list of things in an inbox to be managed. That's why Big News uses dozens of signals to intelligently prioritise the stories that matter to you today, all in one inviting layout. There's no endless pile of unread badges or month-old news. Just the Big News, today.
Sources you already know and trust: 
Add your existing newsletters and feeds to Big News in just a few taps. Plus, the Big News directory contains hundreds of channels, so you're sure to find the sites and newsletters you already love – as well as discover something altogether new.
RSS. SMTP. OMG:
We built Big News upon the open standards of the web – like RSS and SMTP – so it already works with thousands of sources today, as well as thousands more in the future.
And now for the legal bits:
Payment will be charged on either a monthly or annual basis to your Apple ID account. Your monthly or annual subscription automatically renews unless you cancel before the end of the current billing period. You can manage and cancel your subscription at any time by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. For our full Terms of Service please visit: https://bignews.app/terms. For our Privacy Policy visit https://bignews.app/privacy

flathub:io.github.faridjaff.StickyNotesC.description:

 Pan, zoom, and drop notes wherever they feel right on an infinite workspace.
 Link two notes together and the connection shows up as a dashed arrow on
 the canvas.
 Features:
 Infinite pan-and-zoom canvas — your whole desk, at a glance
 Folders with colored badges, per-folder note counts, and a drawer that gets out of the way

 Markdown bodies, link arrows between notes, color-coded folder badges

flathub:org.gnome.World.Iotas.name: Iotas
flathub:org.gnome.World.Iotas.description:
Iotas aims to provide distraction-free note taking via its mobile-first design.
 Featuring
 Optional speedy sync with Nextcloud Notes
 Offline note editing, syncing when back online
 Category editing and filtering
 Favorites
 Spell checking
 Search within the collection or individual notes
 Focus mode and optional hiding of the editor header and formatting bars
 In preview: export to PDF, ODT and HTML
 A convergent design, seeing Iotas as at home on desktop as mobile
 Search from GNOME Shell
 Note backup and restoration (from CLI, for using without sync)
 The ability to change font size and toggle monospace style
 Writing in markdown is supported but optional, providing
 Formatting via toolbar and shortcuts
 Syntax highlighting with themes
 Inserting images
 A formatted view
 The ability to check off task lists from the formatted view
 Slightly more technical details, for those into that type of thing

 There's basic sync conflict detection
 Notes are constantly saved
 Large note collections are partially loaded to quicken startup

 Create and edit your specs, with the locations of parsing errors
 marked in the modules
 Run the PlusCal translator, with the locations of translation

 Run the TLA+ proof system

Whether you want to convert Fahrenheit to Celsius, kilometers to miles, liters to ounces or any other popular unit of conversion, this tool simplifies the process and provides instant results. You can also add notes for easy reference so you never forget important details.
How it works
To use the metric converter:
- Click Metric Unit Converter & Search on your toolbar to open a new tab
- Select a category for unit conversion (eg. Length)
- Enter a value into an input box (eg. ‘5’ in the mile input box)
- Get precise conversion results across multiple metric units

Adorable cartoons to play with. Play the xylop
bluejetty:00065782:ios.description:
Phone game. Music and sounds is a fantastic game to learn numbers, animal sounds and musical notes while having fun playing. It will keep you occupied with nursery rhymes and fantastic images.
Adorable cartoons to play with. Play the xylophone and listen to the musical tones. You are encouraged to learn about animals and the sounds.
-Learn the numbers and how to count.
-Lots of Sound Effects that you will love.
-Tablet Support! All content is FREE!
-Make through interaction with engaging animations and sound effects!
-Teaches animals, sounds, musical notes, numbers and action/reaction.
You will enjoy the different sounds and songs that will be discovered in each of the screens:
Animals: you will learn the sounds of animals like squirrels, cow, rooster, cat, dog, goat, frog or owl.
Numbers: funny numbers on the screen so that you learn to count and to pronounce the numbers in english.
Musical Notes: touch the phone keys and make the musical notes sound: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, and their melody.
Phone game. Music and sounds will keep you entertained with nursery rhymes and funny cartoons to play with.
▶ MUSICAL STIMULATION
The musical stimulation produces great benefits as the sense of hearing. This game helps stimulate different areas:
- The expression of feelings and ideas.
- The development of memory.
- Motor skills.
- The linguistic possibilities.
▶ ABOUT EDUJOY
Thank you very much for playing Edujoy games. We love creating fun and educational games for people of all ages. If you have any questions or suggestions about this game you can contact us through the developer's contact or through our profiles on social networks:
@edujoygames

bluejetty:00154215:ios.description:
Say hello to N Controller—your convenient way to control your TV and enjoy compatible games right from your iPhone.
N Controller turns your phone into a powerful N Remote and virtual Gamepad, making it easy to navigate your TV, launch supported games, and control your entertainment from one place. Simply connect over your local Wi-Fi network and start using your device in just a few moments.

The app is designed with a clean, intuitive interface that makes both gaming and everyday TV navigation simple and comfortable.
To help prevent fraudulent refund requests, anonymous information about app usage may be shared with Apple as described in our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

bluejetty:00005085:ios.name: Mystic Pillars X Kantara
bluejetty:00005085:ios.developer: Holy Cow Productions India Private Limited
bluejetty:00005085:ios.summary: In a major crossover between Indian cinema and interactive entertainment, Mystic Pillars x Kantara update marks a significant expansion to the game. The new free update introduces a narrative collaboration inspired by the cinematic universe
bluejetty:00005085:ios.description:
In a major crossover between Indian cinema and interactive entertainment, Mystic Pillars x Kantara update marks a significant expansion to the game. The new free update introduces a narrative collaboration inspired by the cinematic universe of Indian movie Kantara by Hombale Films - blending folklore, spirituality, and logic-based gameplay into a culturally rooted gaming experience.
The expansion includes:
- Newly designed thematic puzzles for the Kantara village
- Animated cinematic cutscenes capturing the mystic forest tone with Kannada Voice Overs
- Environmental restoration of Kantara village where solving puzzles visually heals the land
Mystic Pillars is an original blend of intriguing puzzles and an immersive storyline set in Ancient India, providing you with a unique gameplay experience.
Play as a mysterious traveller whose journey across the world lands you in the kingdom of Zampi. Resolve the drought plaguing the once-prosperous kingdom of Zampi by solving puzzles and destroying the magical pillars blocking the water.
[REVIEWS]
“An interesting twist on your typical puzzle game which leads to a fun experience.”
3.5/5 – Geeky Hobbies
“They say video games can’t teach you anything. They say it’s not an art form and it can’t offer you a single drop of culture. Whoever said that really needs to give Mystic Pillars a shot. Not only did I feel smart tackling its math-based puzzles like a smug scholar, but also made me want to dive into Indian culture.”
7/10 – waytoomanygames
“Mystic Pillars is a great puzzle game that not only looks pretty but the art design and lore of the game is pretty unique. The gameplay is solid as well because the puzzles will keep you busy for a good time.”
Preview – Games Hedge
[AWARDS]
- Official Selection: BitSummit Gaiden Showcase 2020
- Official Selection: Indie Megabooth GDC Showcase 2020
- Official Showcase as part of Unite India 2018 event
[FEATURES]
- A game based in the southern part of Ancient India
- 100 simple and unique logical puzzles
- Interesting story that reveals itself as you play
- Hand drawn colourful 2D artwork
- Animated cutscenes
- Supported in 20+ languages - English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Portuguese EU, Polish, Turkish, Portuguese BR, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Arabic, Catalan, Hebrew
- Voice over in English and Kannada (the local language in Bangalore, India)
Over the course of your journey, you meet other characters and slowly uncover what exactly happened that led to the downfall of Zampi. The animated cutscenes in the game add to the storyline and keep you wanting for more. Puzzles become more interesting and challenging to solve with different configurations as you proceed further in the game.
[ABOUT US]
Holy Cow Productions is a small team of passionate game developers based out of Bangalore, India. We are focused on creating quality games for PCs, consoles and mobile / tablet devices.
Minimum Device Requirement
- iPhone / iPad device with 2GB RAM
- Mystic Pillars does NOT support iPhone 6 or older, iPad air (2013) or older and iPad mini 3 or older

Twitter: https://twitter.com/HolyCowGames

bluejetty:00119984:ios.description:
A real IDE on your phone and tablet, with an AI Agent that works inside your own Cloud Container.
Ask the Agent for a change. It edits, runs and tests. You review every step and Undo any Task.
Write, run and debug in 18 languages, in a Linux terminal that installs anything.
Start from a Template or an example, keep your Projects on every device.
AI AGENT
Describe the task. The Agent edits your files, runs the code and fixes what breaks, inside your Cloud Container, where you see every file and every command. Build does the work. Plan writes the steps first. Teach me coaches you while you write the code yourself. Hold the mic and say the task. Get a notification when a Task is done or needs you. Generate a whole Project from one description.
PLAN FIRST, UNDO ANY TASK
Read the plan before the Agent touches a file. Every Task is one Undo away.
CODE EDITOR AND RUN
Open a file, press Run, read the console. The compiler or interpreter for your language is already installed. Autocompletion and linting come from real language servers.
A REAL LINUX TERMINAL
Ubuntu with apt, npm, pip and whatever else you install. It stays installed in your Cloud Container.
PROJECTS AND TEMPLATES
50+ Templates: React, Vue, Svelte, Next.js, Express, Django, Laravel, Ionic, React Native, Blazor, and a plain starter for every language.
PREVIEW
Run a web Project and open it in the in-app Browser, with Pro.
GIT
Clone, commit, push and pull, with Pro.
LEARN BY EXAMPLE
1,600+ runnable examples, 1,000+ of them free. Open one, run it, change it, or ask the Agent to teach you.
ON EVERY DEVICE
A hardware keyboard with VS Code, IntelliJ and Xcode Keymaps. A tablet layout with panels you arrange. Your Projects live in one Cloud Container, so you pick up where you left off on a phone, a tablet or in a web browser.
18 LANGUAGES
Java, Python, C, C++, C#, Dart, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Shell, Swift, Ruby, Go, Kotlin, Lua, Haskell, Rust, Scala.
FREE, PRO AND CREDITS
Free: the code editor, Run, the Linux terminal with package installs, 1,000+ examples, the free Templates, the Agent on the Standard model with 100 Starter credits, and Generate with AI Agent.
Pro: a Cloud Container with up to 4 vCPU, 4 GB RAM and 8 GB disk (4× the free one), Docker, GUI apps over VNC, the in-app Browser, Git, SFTP upload, keyboard toolbar customization, two more editor themes, every example and every Template, 500 credits a month and the Smart model.
Credits: Agent Tasks spend credits. Every account gets 100 Starter credits once, Pro adds 500 a month, and credit Packs are sold in the app. Bring your own API key and Tasks on it spend no credits.
Terms of Service: https://www.codesnack-ide.com/terms-of-services
Privacy Policy: https://www.codesnack-ide.com/privacy-policy
Discord: https://discord.gg/FKmzpuqUnZ

- Book Movers in Seconds: Quick, easy booking with a few taps.
- Fast Arrival: Movers can arrive within 30 minutes.
- On-Demand Moving Help: Same-day service when and where you need it.
- Trusted Pros: Licensed, background-checked, and top-rated.
- Real-Time Tracking: Know exactly where your movers are, at all times.
- Cashless Payments: Secure, in-app payments for a hassle-free experience.
- Service Areas: Available in Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, Houston, New York City, San Francisco, Atlanta, Dallas, Boston, Washington DC, Phoenix, and more — expanding nationwide!
Our Most Popular Services:
- Apartment Moves, Condo Moves, Dorm Room Moves, Senior Moves
- Same-Day Couch Delivery, Mattress Delivery, Refrigerator Delivery, Washer & Dryer Delivery
- Labor-Only Moving Help — Loading, Unloading, Rearranging Furniture
- Retail Pickup & Delivery — IKEA, Home Depot, Costco, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist
- Eco-Friendly Junk Removal & Debris Pickup — Furniture, Appliances, Yard Waste, TV Removal, Electronics Recycling
- Office Moves & Commercial Deliveries — Small Business Relocations, Equipment Moves
Perfect For:
- Moving last-minute or scheduling in advance.
- Furniture, mattress, appliance, and heavy item delivery without the wait.
- College students, small apartments, studios, and city moves.
- Clearing out old couches, mattresses, appliances, and junk fast.
- Store pickups — get your purchases delivered the same day.

5. Rate Your Experience: We constantly strive to deliver 5-star service.

With Muvr, you skip the rental truck, the heavy lifting, and the long wait times. Book movers, delivery help, or junk removal instantly — all from the convenience of your phone. Whether it’s a small move, appliance delivery, or clearing out old junk, Muvr has you covered.
We believe moving should be easy, fast, and stress-free — that’s why thousands of customers trust Muvr for reliable, affordable moving, delivery, and removal services.

*Meet people near you.
*Let people help you wherever you are.
*Meet new people.

bluejetty:00095755:ios.summary:

Willo is the baby tracker and parenting app made for tired moms, dads, and caregivers who want calmer days, better baby sleep, and more confidence in early parenthood. Built for newborns through age 6, W
bluejetty:00095755:ios.description:
You're doing better than you think.
Willo is the baby tracker and parenting app made for tired moms, dads, and caregivers who want calmer days, better baby sleep, and more confidence in early parenthood. Built for newborns through age 6, Willo turns the chaos of baby development into something you can actually understand.
35 Developmental Phases, Not a Mystery:
Willo maps your baby's first six years into 35 named developmental phases. Each one explains what is happening in your baby's brain, body, sleep, and mood, so you can stop guessing why things changed overnight. Ahead of every sleep regression, fussy week, and growth spurt, Willo gives you a heads up and a plan.
A Baby Tracker That Actually Gets It:
Log moods, track bedtime routines, celebrate milestones, and watch your baby's journey unfold on a personalized daily home screen. Willo is the baby milestone tracker and baby development tracker parents keep coming back to, because it speaks to how you feel, not just what your baby did.
Willo AI: Your 24/7 Parenting Assistant:
Ask anything, any time of night. Willo AI is an always on parenting assistant that gives warm, science based answers about baby sleep, feeding, milestones, mood, and your own wellbeing. No more 3am Googling. No more spiraling. Just one trusted place to turn.
Sleep Sound Library for Better Baby Sleep:
Calming white noise, pink noise, womb sounds, lullabies, ocean waves, and gentle frequencies designed to help your baby fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer. A simple baby sleep sounds app built into a full parenting companion.
Bite Sized Parenting Guidance:
Short, clear daily tips matched to your baby's age and current phase. Covering sleep, new skills, emotional changes, feeding, play, and what your baby may be learning right now. No long articles, no confusing advice, just the support you need in the moment.
The Memory Book: One Photo A Day:
The new Today tab turns every day into a keepsake. Snap one photo of your baby, add a sentence if you want, and Willo automatically stamps it with the age, phase, and any milestone you logged that day. Scroll back in a year and watch your baby grow through every phase, every little face, every tiny change you were too tired to remember. Your photos stay on your device. Never uploaded, never shared, yours forever.
Mood Journal for Baby and You:
Log how your baby feels, spot patterns in the calendar view, and notice the quiet wins. Willo helps you see your baby, and yourself, more clearly.
A Village That Gets You:
Real moms, real posts, real honesty. The in app community is where you can share the highs, the hard nights, and everything in between.
Made for Parents, Not Babies:
Willo is not a toy. It is a calm, thoughtfully designed companion for the parent behind every little person. Whether you are a first time mom navigating the newborn phase, a dad running on two hours of sleep, or a caregiver looking for peace of mind, Willo brings clarity, calm, and connection to your day.
Install Willo and see how much lighter parenting can feel when you finally have a guide. Whether you have 5 minutes or 5 seconds, Willo meets you where you are.
Subscription Required:
Willo offers a free onboarding flow to help you get started. Access to all premium features, including the Baby Tracker, Sleep Sound Library, Parenting Guidance, Willo AI, and Community requires a subscription.
Disclaimer:
Willo is not a medical device and does not offer medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Content is for informational purposes only and should not replace professional guidance. Always consult your pediatrician regarding your baby's health or development.
Need help? Email: help@meetwillo.app
Support: https://meetwillo.app/support
Terms of Use: https://meetwillo.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://meetwillo.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00157039:ios.description:
HHO on the Go can help you get the care you need with a convenient phone or video visit. Any time. Anywhere. No more driving to the doctor or sitting in crowded waiting rooms. Within a few minutes, a medical provider will greet you ready to listen and resolve your issue. With HHO on the Go, quality medical care providers are available 24/7 to help you get well sooner.
Connect with experienced doctors and nurses who can diagnose, recommend treatment, and prescribe medicine (if necessary) for many medical issues like:
· Urgent or scheduled care for, but not limited to, bronchitis, sinus and respiratory infections, cough, congestion, sore throat, diarrhea, vomiting, cold and flu symptoms, cuts and scrapes, sprains, urinary tract infections, hives, pinkeye, migraines, and more.
· Help living with depression, anxiety, substance abuse, PTSD, trauma, panic attacks, and other behavioral health concerns.
HHO on the Go features include:
· Convenient access from mobile devices, computers, or by smart phone.
· Live video or phone urgent care visits.
· Live video or phone behavioral health and psychiatry visits.
· Evaluation by board-certified physicians, therapists, and psychiatrists.
· Secure, encrypted platform.
Questions or feedback? Call your Member Services representative toll-free at 1-844-325- 6251 (TTY: 711) from 8 a.m. - 8 p.m. Monday-Friday. We can help!
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

bluejetty:00144670:ios.description:
Othership is a music-driven breathwork app designed to help you shift your state one breath at a time.
Cultivate big lung energy and harness the power of your breath to regulate your nervous system through your energetic, mental and emotional bodies in as little as 60 seconds for up to 60 minutes. 
Consider this your new daily ritual to energize and start your day, improve focus + performance, decompress after work, wind down for a deep sleep, or release negative emotions with short + effective exercises when you need them most.
Our active sessions are set to music with guidance from world-renowned breathwork facilitators to shift your body + brain quickly. Rooted in ancient tradition, informed by modern science, and inspired by magic, Othership’s meticulously curated guided breathwork practices are simultaneously playful and effective.
Explore the ins + outs of your breath with guidance from psychotherapists, wellness practitioners, hypnotherapists, artists, DJ’s, spiritual teachers, and life coaches featuring breathwork, guided meditations, affirmations + visualizations, sound healing, hypnosis, somatic release therapy, vocal toning, self-massage, mindful walking + working, movement + dance, and more trippy stuff.
EXPLORE THE APP
Our app features daily UP and DOWN sessions to keep your practice feeling fresh. Spend less time deciding and more time breathing. Our curated weekly practice offers a longer haul, transformative journey designed to give you a complete release + reset from the stressors of modern living.
Othership offers five types of daily breathing styles with unique benefits:
UP
Harness the power of your breath to energize and kickstart your day. Cultivate focus and productivity. Fight fatigue and tap vitality. Explore elevating practices to get lifted and stay lifted.
DOWN
Build a routine for deep rest and better sleep. Unwind with practices to de-stress and linger in stillness. Soothe anxiety and find centre.
ALL AROUND
Practice self-care with deeply transformative journeys designed to create the space + presence needed to gather meaningful insights. Reach altered states, regulate your emotions, and cultivate mind-body connection.
BODY
Combine conscious breathing with mindful movement and embodiment practices including self-massage, gentle stretching, dancing, and somatic therapy.
BRAIN
Learn the science behind how + why we do breathwork. Try a benchmark breathing test to track your progress from A to B to infinity.
CULTIVATE BIG LUNG ENERGY
Shift your state through a medley of breathing styles including: box breath, diaphragmatic breathing, Wim Hof Method, ocean breath, alternate nostril, 4-7-8 breathing, Buteyko Method, coherent breathing, breath of fire, triangle breath, dynamic breathing, kundalini pranayam, up-regulated breathing and lots more.
MEMBER[SHIP]
Come for the journey. Stay for the shift.
- Access to 500+ on-demand breathwork sessions
- Inspiring soundscapes from sound healing musicians, artists and DJs
- Streak and progress tracking
- Custom challenges and pathways to meet your mindfulness goals
- World-renowned breathwork facilitators
- Curated daily notifications to amplify your practice and ignite your personal growth
- Stay inspired with new sessions released weekly
- Integrated with Apple Health's Mindful Minutes
- A global community of daily breathers
Transformation in your hands.
T’s + C’s
If you’d like to learn more about our Terms + Conditions, visit:
[www.othership.us/terms]

“DC Transit keeps me on time ever
bluejetty:00029860:ios.description:
DC Transit — Your Smarter Way Around Washington DC
Get real-time Metrobus, Metrorail, and regional transit updates for DC, Maryland, and Virginia — all in one easy-to-use app designed for daily commuters.
“DC Transit keeps me on time every morning. The live Metro and bus updates are always accurate, and it’s great having all my routes in one place.”
Why Washingtonians love DC Transit:
• Live Metrobus and Metrorail tracking
• Stop and schedule alerts
• Trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customizable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, DC Transit tells you exactly when to hop off. Track your bus or train in real time, see how crowded it is before boarding, and get instant notifications about delays, detours, and service changes across the DC region.
Whether you’re commuting to Capitol Hill, traveling from Bethesda, or heading home to Arlington, DC Transit gives you all the live travel information you need in one reliable app.
Coverage Includes:
• WMATA Metrorail (All Lines)
• WMATA Metrobus (DC, Maryland, Virginia)
• DC Circulator
• MARC Trains and Virginia Railway Express (VRE)
• Montgomery County Ride On and Fairfax Connector
• Alexandria DASH and ART Arlington Transit
• Real-time service alerts, detours, and closures
Plan trips, check live arrivals, and save your favourite stops — all in one simple app designed for the entire Washington metropolitan area.
--------
What is DC Transit?
DC Transit is a real-time public transport app for Washington DC and the surrounding region. It provides live Metrobus and Metrorail updates, trip planning, and service alerts.
Does it work with WMATA?
Yes — DC Transit covers all WMATA Metrobus and Metrorail services across DC, Maryland, and Virginia.
Does it include MARC and VRE commuter trains?
Absolutely. You can view MARC and Virginia Railway Express schedules and live updates where available.
Does it support local systems like Ride On or Fairfax Connector?
Yes. DC Transit includes regional systems such as Montgomery County Ride On, Fairfax Connector, ART, DASH, and DC Circulator.
Can I check service alerts and delays?
Yes — the app provides live notifications about delays, detours, and planned maintenance across all major networks.
Can I use DC Transit offline?
Yes — offline maps and saved timetables let you plan your trip even without mobile data.
Will it remind me when to get off?
Yes. “Get Off Alerts” use GPS to notify you just before your stop so you never miss it.
Is DC Transit free?
Yes — it’s free to download and use, with optional premium features like widgets and enhanced alerts available via in-app purchase.
How do I contact support?
Email talk@travelwhiz.app or message @trymomego on X (Twitter).
--------
Travel smarter with DC Transit — your all-in-one Metro, bus, and rail companion.
Download now and get real-time maps, schedules, and service alerts for Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia.
Privacy Policy: travelwhiz.app/privacy
Terms of Use: www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00065725:ios.description:
Welcome to Thrive: Food ordering made for your workplace! Browse food options and menus at work then order ahead on your schedule with secure payments from any mobile device.
Starved for time? Find a meal fast with clear menu options, custom choices and pickup options that suit you. Feed your workday with Thrive!
Here's what you can expect:
Connection to great food
Thrive partners with your workplace to connect you directly with the food menus at your location. View what's for breakfast or lunch well before you get there.
Custom choices
View custom options available on food menus to help you make choices to match your taste.
Order on the go
Extra busy day? We have those too. Now you can order ahead and find a pickup time on your schedule.
Flexible ordering
Not sure what to eat? You can re-order items from your past orders and browse your order history. Select locations also offer Scan & Pay flexibility to easily add grab and go items on the spot.
Safe and easy checkout
All major credit cards accepted at checkout using secure encryption, including Apple Pay. Expensing lunch? Use your personal or company card and we’ll send you the receipt.

bluejetty:00157805:ios.description:
Coffee Sort - Puzzle Games, the fun Coffee Games where you sort, stack, and pack your way to success! If you love block games, coffee jam challenges, and organizing the fun coffee pack, this Coffee Sort block jam game is for you. Get ready for a fun, fast-paced coffee jam as you match the right cups and serve up some Good Coffee, Great Coffee!
Sort, Stack & Pack – Master the Coffee Jam!
Step into your very own café block, your mission? Sort coffee cups by color and type, match them to their corresponding colored doors and clear the board! But beware—the timer keeps coming, and the coffee jam never slows down. Can you handle the challenge of managing a busy coffee block jam?
With endless color block games levels, vibrant animations, and satisfying coffee stack mechanics, Coffee Sort offers a blend of fun and strategy. Whether you're looking for a relaxing break or an exciting puzzle challenge, this coffee block game has everything you need!
How to Play Coffee Sort - Puzzle Games
- Sort & Match – Slide colorful blocks and clear paths by matching them to their corresponding colored doors. 
- Solve & Clear – Plan your moves carefully to clear the path and complete the block jam puzzle on time.
- Manage the Coffee Jam – Every level presents a new challenge, so use your wits to find the most efficient way to clear the blocks.
- Level Up Your Coffee Block – Unlock new challenges and master advanced sorting games mechanics.
Key Features
- Addictive Sorting Games Gameplay – A fresh twist on classic sort & block puzzles!
- Coffee Stack Perfection – Satisfyingly stack coffee cups into the same color coffee pack.
- Endless Sorting Fun – Lots of levels filled with unique coffee games challenges!
- Relaxing Yet Fast-Paced – Unwind with smooth color block gameplay while testing your speed and accuracy.
- Daily Challenges & Special Events – Stay engaged with new surprises block jam every day!
- Easy to Play, Hard to Master – Suitable for all ages, from casual players to puzzle masters!
If you enjoy sorting games, coffee stack challenges, and the thrill of a coffee jam, then Coffee Sort - Puzzle Games is a great game for you! 
Join the Coffee Craze Now!
Are you ready to sort, stack, and brew your way to victory? Download Coffee Sort - Puzzle Games today and experience the most satisfying coffee game ever!

bluejetty:00024842:ios.name: iCab Mobile (Web Browser)
bluejetty:00024842:ios.summary:
iCab Mobile is a web browser for iOS. iCab Mobile is customizable in almost all areas and can thus be made into your very own personal browser.
PRIVACY:
In private mode, no private data is saved permanently. Special private tabs increase p
bluejetty:00024842:ios.description:
iCab Mobile is a web browser for iOS. iCab Mobile is customizable in almost all areas and can thus be made into your very own personal browser.
PRIVACY:
In private mode, no private data is saved permanently. Special private tabs increase privacy even further, with only a small loss of comfort.
PROFILES/USER ACCOUNTS:
Any number of profiles/user accounts can be created, with each profile having its own settings, bookmarks, etc. Profiles are suitable for an iPad that is used by the whole family, but also for users who want to separate professional and private surfing.
TABS, WINDOWS:
iCab Mobile can open any number of websites simultaneously in tabs. Tabs can be saved and organized in groups so that they can easily be loaded together again later. Tabs can be protected against accidental closing or overwriting. 
On the iPad, multiple app instances can be opened as windows (Stage Manager, Split View), even with multiple profiles simultaneously (since iOS 18).
FILTERS:
Filters can be used to block advertising, trackers, etc. Popular filter lists can be used directly (Easylist, AdBlock Plus, uBlock & compatible), but you can also define your own.
USER INTERFACE:
The user interface is freely configurable. Action, context and text selection menus, toolbars and gestures can be adapted to your own needs. 
ACCESSIBLE:
The user interface is barrier-free and adapts to the system font size and is compatible with VoiceOver.
BOOKMARKS:
Bookmarks can be organized in folders. “Smart folders” create special collections based on self-defined rules (e.g. the latest bookmarks from the last 2 weeks). Colored labels allow further categorization.
DOWNLOADS:
Download any files and manage the files in the download manager, including unpacking/creating ZIP archives, exporting/importing, etc.
SEARCH:
The app offers a large list of search engines (self-expandable) that you can use to search directly on the web. It is also possible to search on the current page.
WEBSITES:
You can define what websites can and cannot do. Highlight important content with a highlighter, hide unwanted elements, allow buttons to be clicked automatically (e.g. for cookie messages). Control permissions for camera, microphone and sensor usage. Pro users can even inject JavaScript and CSS code into websites to customize them to their liking.
EXPORT/IMPORT:
All data can be exported/imported (for creating backups, data synchronization with other devices/apps)
WIDGETS:
Widgets allow you to control the App and open bookmarks directly from the home screen. Websites can also be displayed directly there.
APPLE WATCH:
Open websites directly on the Apple Watch (albeit limited). Remotely control iCab Mobile on the iPhone from the Watch. 
FURTHER FEATURES:
- Quick starter 
- Configurable browser ID (UserAgent)
- Full support for international domain names 
- Simple built-in RSS reader
- Kiosk mode - a more limited version of the full-screen mode for kiosk systems. 
The app includes a store where you can give us a tip via InApp purchase to additionally support the further development of the app. The development of the app takes a lot of time and is a lot of work, which the low purchase price cannot cover. Te sources of income used by the big popular browsers, such as advertising, deals with search engines, tracking etc. are not an option for iCab Mobile. 
Tipping is completely voluntary and you won't miss out on any important features if you don't tip. However, users who tip will be given the option to change the app icon as a thank you.

bluejetty:00036675:ios.summary: Step into the thrilling world of free-to-play crime investigation with "Unsolved Case: Killer Popularity," where your sharp instincts and legendary skills are all that stand between justice and chaos! Engage in heart-pounding detective game
bluejetty:00036675:ios.description:
Step into the thrilling world of free-to-play crime investigation with "Unsolved Case: Killer Popularity," where your sharp instincts and legendary skills are all that stand between justice and chaos! Engage in heart-pounding detective games that challenge you to seek and find hidden objects crucial to each case, exploring crime scenes meticulously crafted for fans of item search games. Face chilling mysteries, from gruesome murders to calculated robberies, as you unravel each meticulously planned crime. With your loyal partner Paul by your side, immerse yourself in this ultimate crime investigation experience, designed to test your wits in the darkest corners of criminal minds.
Your name still makes countless criminals tremble at the sound of it. But there are others who commit crimes with cold calculation, trying to outsmart you. Prove them wrong! This new collection of crime episodes is full of terrifying and bone-chilling murders, break-ins, and robberies. We believe you are the only one who can stop the perpetrators, but just in case, we've sent Paul to you for backup. Your faithful partner will be there to assist you or even bring you a new case.
Crime Scene Investigation!
Dive into the world of Unsolved Case, where every detail counts. Examine crime scenes, seek and find hidden objects, and use your sharp detective skills to piece together complex clues and uncover the truth behind each criminal case!
Hidden Object Gameplay!
Embark on a series of intricate finding object games where every detail matters. As you scour crime scenes and hidden locations, you’ll need to find hidden objects that are key to unlocking new clues and progressing in your crime investigation.
Enigmatic Storyline!
Get entangled in a criminal case, rich with item search games and unexpected twists. As you delve deeper into the city of crime, the boundary between right and wrong blurs, leaving you to solve the unsolved case and decide the fate of your characters!
Mind-Bending Challenges!
In addition to finding hidden objects, your detective skills will be challenged by a variety of puzzles. These puzzle mystery games are specifically designed to test your logic and problem-solving abilities, integrating seamlessly into the crime detective game process!
Can you solve these cases and keep your legendary status intact? Play the free-to-play version right now and find out!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00062329:ios.name: Japanese Hiragana Letter！もじあそび
bluejetty:00062329:ios.summary: A free educational app for kids to learn how to read and write Japanese letter with fun. Made for 3 year old to 5 year old kids who starts to have interests in Japanese Hiragana letters like AIUEO. Interactions with and animated character(G
bluejetty:00062329:ios.description:
A free educational app for kids to learn how to read and write Japanese letter with fun. Made for 3 year old to 5 year old kids who starts to have interests in Japanese Hiragana letters like AIUEO. Interactions with and animated character(Goobee) will amuse your kids and enables to let them enjoy the learning process.
Target Age: 3 year old to 5 year old
[AIUEO(あいうえお) Game]
A simple free game that lets your kids learn the connection between the sound and the appearance of Japanese letters. You can turn on/off each Hiragana letters if you want them to learn specific letters.
[Balloon Fly(そらとび) Game]
As a next step to AIUEO game, this free game let your kids to search Japanese letters from a larger number of letters. Children can enjoy popping lots of balloons. Be careful not to fall down by selecting wrong balloons!
[Word Chain(しりとり) Game]
Pick a word that starts with a letter in the tail of previous word. Make word chain longer and run through the roller coaster. Be careful not to select a word that ends with letter [ん], since no Japanese words starts with the letter!
[Whac-a-letter(もじたたき) Game]
Find and hit letters that fit in the square on the board. Letters will try to hide like in a whac-a-mole game.
[Word(ことば) Game]
Kids can learn words from a connection of Japanese Hiragana letters in this game. Familiar words will show up and your kids can enjoy the interaction of the word images and Goobee.
[Write(なぞりがき) Game]
A free game that let your kids learn how to write Japanese Hiragana letters by tracing and popping little balloons. As you trace the balloons and make words, cloud-like images will be shown in the sky.
[Dakuon(だくおん) Game] Included in paid package
Learn how the sound changes when letter parts like DAKUON["], HAN-DAKUON[the circle on upper right] are added to each letters.
[Calligraphy(しゅうじ) Game] Included in paid package
Leveraging the skills learnt in the writing game, kids can learn the detail shape of each letters such as TOME(stop) and HARAI(sweeping).
[Karuta(かるた) Game] Included in paid package
Kids can utilize the letters learnt in the other basic games to play Karuta(Card game of Japanese words). It helps to learn more words.

bluejetty:00129548:ios.name: dictate2us Record & Transcribe
bluejetty:00129548:ios.summary: Experience the power of the award-winning dictate2us transcription service in your pocket, at your desk, or on the go. Record letters, reports, case notes, interviews and much more. The possibilities are endless, and the time and money yo
bluejetty:00129548:ios.description:
Experience the power of the award-winning dictate2us transcription service in your pocket, at your desk, or on the go. Record letters, reports, case notes, interviews and much more. The possibilities are endless, and the time and money you can save are significant.
dictate2us is the world's number one transcription service provider of accurately typed documents with fast turnaround times. We have unparalleled experience in the transcription industry, working with over 475,000 clients worldwide. We assist doctors, consultants, lawyers, whole hospitals, large law firms, government bodies, students and universities. Our typists are experienced in specific fields and are assigned files that they are familiar with, ensuring they understand the different terminologies and formatting styles required.
Our team of 1,200 human office based transcribers can return files within 1 hour if required, but we have 3, 5, 12, 24 , 48 or 72 hour turnaround times to choose from, 24/7, 365 days a year.
You can download the app for free, and a £10 ($15) free trial credit is offered so you can test our typing service. When the trial credit has been used, we then charge an audio minute rate, depending on the turnaround chosen. You can add credit to your account using PayPal or a debit/credit card.
IMPORTANT: All users can record and edit audio files. To take advantage of the dictate2us transcription features, you will need to register within the app, which only takes 60 seconds!
How does it work?
1. The user records audio and saves a recording with the dictate2us app.
2. The audio is securely uploaded to the dictate2us transcription platform.
3. A dedicated typist transcribes the file into a Microsoft Word document.
4. An editor amends any errors or formatting issues.
5. The document is proofread to ensure accuracy.
6. The finished document is e-mailed to you or made available for download.
How do we charge for transcription?
We charge per minute of audio rather than per word, line or time taken to type. We believe this is the fairest way as you will know exactly how much a file will cost before uploading. People dictate 3 to 4 times more quickly than they type. Thus, a 10-minute dictation file could take up to 40 minutes to transcribe. With d2u, you only pay for the 10 minutes.
How long does it take to transcribe?
The d2u app allows users to get their transcribed documents back extremely quickly. As soon as your encrypted file arrives at our servers, it is decrypted and assigned to your regular typist. Once edited and proofread, our online transcription platform will e-mail a copy of the finished document, or, if preferred, a link can be sent to download the document straight to your phone, tablet or PC. We return work in a Microsoft Word document and can type into your personal letterhead or template.
Data Confidentiality and Security
The d2u Transcriber app uses state-of-the-art data security, including military-grade 256 bit encryption, the same technology that used in online banking and retail websites. Our servers are UK based and hack-tested daily. We are fully data protected with the ICO and fully HIPPA compliant. Our staff are office-based and have signed non-disclosure agreements. We do not employ homeworkers, and our staff have no means to remove data from our systems.

bluejetty:00015337:ios.description:
Join millions of kids in new hairstyling and beauty makeover adventures in Jungle Animal Hair Salon 2 kids game! Meet their beloved beauty salon clients at the beach and play new summer holiday makeover and pet care games for kids. Wash, dress up, style and design fun and crazy looks!
Kids' favorite jungle animals and new games make Jungle Animal Hair Salon 2 the best sequel of the most popular pet care game for kids from TutoTOONS. Free your imagination and have fun!
Travel to the tropics and say hello to leopard Amy, elephant Sarah, zebra Gizelle, monkey Maya and toucan Rosa. Every jungle animal has its own style and favorite spa but they all need summer fashion tips from the best pet beauty salon! Leopard Amy wants to look cute with new makeup and fancy clothes. Elephant Sarah loves a spa bath and wants to dress up for holidays at the beach. Zebra Gizelle can’t wait to try new hairstyles and cool outfits. Monkey Maya plays in the jungle, always gets messy and hungry. Toucan Rosa misses her Rio Carnival look and needs your help to look wonderful. Take your hair styling tools to the sandy beach and start your summer beauty salon adventures!
Play tropical summer beauty salon and pet care games for kids: 
· Pick the animal you want to style first: leopard, elephant, zebra, monkey or toucan!
· Try out different hairstyles and outfits and create a magical look for zebra Gizelle!
· Clean up hungry monkey Maya, feed her, dress up and do an amazing hairstyle!
· Take care of elephant Sarah's skin, do nails, style hair and choose the cutest clothes!
· Get ready for the scariest night and carve a pumpkin for Halloween party!
· Wash and braid leopard Amy's hair, do makeup and dress up in style!
· Mix and match carnival accessories and create a Brazilian look for Rosa, queen of the jungle!
· Play music with leopard Amy’s ukulele and toucan Rosa’s maracas!
· Join sloth Linda at the beach hut and make exotic fruit slushies for everyone!
· Play Jungle Animal Hair Salon 2 kids game every day and collect bonus coins!
· Level up and unlock new exciting mini games with your favorite jungle animals!
· Watch videos for kids and toddlers, earn coins and unlock new dress up items!
· Play, learn about jungle life and tropical animals and have tons of fun!

bluejetty:00178691:ios.description:
Get Ready for the ultimate rallycross racing experience!
From the creators of the legendary Mad Skills Motocross, Mad Skills BMX, and Mad Skills Snocross comes the most intense rally racing game yet! Whether you're a fan of high-speed racing, competitive drifting, or head-to-head clashes, this is the game for you.
Master Every Track
Take the wheel of your custom rally car and push your racing skills to the limit on dirt, snow, and asphalt. Every race is an adrenaline-pumping battle of speed, precision, and control. With smooth one-hand controls, drifting is easy to learn but tough to master.
Race in Extreme Events
Compete in events inspired by the thrill of Nitrocross and the stunts of Nitro Circus. Stunning graphics and real-time racing make you feel like part of the action. Customize and upgrade your rally cars to dominate the track and leave your rivals in the dust.
Endless Excitement
With exclusive events, and a variety of unique tracks, and tones of regular updates, no two races are ever the same. Whether you’re boosting past opponents or perfecting your drift, every race is a chance to prove you have what it takes to be the ultimate rallycross champion.
FEATURES:
-High-speed rallycross racing and drifting.
-Compete on dirt, snow, and asphalt tracks with smooth, easy-to-learn controls.
-Unlock and upgrade rally cars to improve your performance in intense events.
-Stunning graphics and immersive gameplay bring the world of racing to life.
-Exclusive Nitrocross events featuring extreme stunts and rewarding in-game prizes.
-Play solo or challenge others to dominate the leaderboard.
Requires iOS 11 or later.
ADDITIONAL DISCLOSURES

bluejetty:00187642:ios.description:
Genius Scan is a document scanner app in your pocket. Quickly scan your paper documents on the go and export them as multi-page PDF files.
*** Apple App of the Week *** 20+ million users *** 1000s of small businesses ***
Place any document in front of your device’s camera: our scanner app automatically recognizes the paper against the background, crops it, and cleans up the result. You obtain a crisp, legible scan. Batch scanning lets you scan dozens of pages in a matter of seconds. Powerful tools help you organize, share, or archive your documents.
“Next time you plan to hit the road, don’t forget to download Genius Scan to make life easier for yourself and your accounting department.” - AppPicker.com
“Camera apps aren’t designed for close-up text scanning, but Genius Scan is.” - The Guardian
== ENTERPRISE EDITION ==
Genius Scan Plus Premium Plan:
- All the premium features of the Genius Scan Plus Premium Plan (denoted with + below), out of the box (no upgrade needed).
Managed Configuration:
- Deployment to fleets of devices managed by a MDM tool
- Pre-configuration of app settings on a per-user basis (eg. set default email address, WebDAV/FTP credentials)
- Control of which apps and services users can export documents to
- No ads
== KEY FEATURES == 
Smart Scanning:
- Document detection & background removal
- Distortion correction
- Shadow removal and defect cleanup
- Filters (black & white, whiteboard, photo)
- Batch scanning
PDF Creation & Editing:
- Document merging & splitting
- Multiple page PDF creation
- Photos and PDF import
Security & Privacy:
- On-device document processing
+ Face ID locking
+ PDF password encryption
Document Organization:
- Document tagging
- Metadata and content search
+ Smart document renaming (custom templates, …)
+ Backup and multi-device sync with Genius Cloud (separate subscription)
Export:
- Email
+ Box, Dropbox, Evernote, Expensify, Google Drive, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, OneNote, FTP, SugarSync, WebDAV.
+ Any WebDAV compatible service such as Citrix ShareFile, NextCloud, ownCloud, Synology, Yandex. 
+ Automatic background auto-export
OCR (Text Recognition):
+ Text extraction
+ Searchable PDF creation
+ Business card scanning & contact creation
== ABOUT US ==
It’s in the heart of Paris, France that The Grizzly Labs develops Genius Scan. We take pride in crafting apps that help millions of users throughout the world and hold ourselves to the highest standards in terms of quality and privacy. Get in touch with us @thegrizzlylabs if you have any questions.
== PRICING & LEGAL ==
You can subscribe to Genius Cloud for backup & synchronization. In that case, Genius Scan’s store displays the duration and price of each subscription, updated at the time of purchase. Payment will be charged to iTunes account when the order is confirmed. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions, disable auto-renewal in the iTunes account settings.
https://www.thegrizzlylabs.com/genius-scan/cloud/terms

With MossAI, you have access to personalized assistance for all types of writing projects, whether it is essays, compositions, social media posts,speeches, lyrics or poems.

Unleash your creativity with MossAI. Write a rap song lyrics, poem or a story.
- Write a rap song in the style of Eminem

【 RELIABLE CHAT PARTNER 】
Whether you're seeking some amusement, advice, or simply in need of someone to talk to, MossAI is always available for you, like a close friend. 
Download the MossAI app now and have your virtual assistant always at hand.

bluejetty:00031414:ios.description:
Access and manage your Thrift Savings Plan (TSP) all in one place.
The official TSP Mobile app is available to all TSP participants. Through the TSP Mobile app, you'll be able to access your TSP account on your device—anytime, anywhere.
Use this app to:
- review your TSP account summary
- check your investment performance and change your investment mix
- access tools, like the TSP virtual assistant, AVA, with convenient navigation
- securely sign paperwork using your electronic signature, submit forms, and upload documents
- use mobile check deposit for rollovers
- enroll in and manage your mutual fund window account
Note: A tsp.gov login is required to use certain functions within the app.

bluejetty:00015361:ios.description:
Kuran-ı Kerim'deki 114 sureyi sizlere sunuyoruz. Sureleri hafız sesiyle dinleyebilir, Arapça yazılışını, Türkçe meallerini ve okunuşlarını bir arada takip edebilirsiniz.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler
• 114 surenin tamamı — Arapça metin, Türkçe meal ve okunuş (latin harfli) bir arada
• Hafız sesiyle sesli okuma; ayet tekrarı, okuma hızı ve bekleme süresi ayarları
• Birden fazla kâri (hafız) seçeneği
• Mushaf sayfa düzeninde okuma ve dikkat dağıtmayan tam ekran modu
• Tecvid kurallarının renkli gösterimi ile doğru telaffuz
• 40'tan fazla meal seçeneği — dilediğinizi indirip anında değiştirin
• Kur'an Fihristi: konu başlıklarından ayet bulma ve favorilere ekleme
• Hatim Takibi: kişisel veya toplu hatim oluşturun, cüzleri kişilere dağıtın, ilerlemeyi izleyin ve günlük hatırlatma alın
• Ayetleri şık görsel kartlar (Hikaye / Gönderi) veya yazı olarak paylaşma
• iCloud ile cihazlar arası senkron — kaldığınız yer, hatim, meal ve favorileriniz tüm cihazlarınızda aynı
• Ana ekran widget'ları: "Devam Et" ve "Hatim Takip"

bluejetty:00124748:android.description:
Can you catch all the monsters and become the best monster trainer?
Your quest is simple...collect and catch all the dragons' eggs and become the best trainer of dragons
Collect as many eggs in the wild! Be fast and agile! 
Explore the wild, cut all the grass, and remove the bushes to discover the dragon eggs.
Unlock new monsters! There are more than 10+ different lizards in this game. Discover all monsters' powers and attacks.
Grow your animals from simple eggs to simple little dragon-pets, to terrific monsters. All the trainers are ready to fight. Are you ready? Enter the fire arena and prepare yourself to fight in the flames.
Remember, if you don't train correctly your beasts, your enemies will beat you in the final round fight.
Play for free. Challenge yourself to become the best trainer and catch all the beasts...
This is not one of those classic and boring simple animals training games.
List of the features of your new free casual game:
🐉 Beautiful 3D graphics
💥 Catch magic animals
🐉 100% free game
💥 Fun and addictive gameplay
🐉 Easy controls
How to become a Green Island: Land of Fire master?
🐲 Find all the monster eggs in the wild and adopt them
🔥 Adopt only the best and strongest creatures
🐲 Be ready to fight the other flying beasts inside the arena
🔥 Choose correctly the monsters that you want to capture and how you want to grow them. If you adopt and maintain only baby creatures, the big ones will crash you
🐲 Be brave and face the other monsters in the arena. Become the best trainer
About Homa:
Green Island: Land of Fire is produced by Homa Games. Homa is a top publisher of Hyper Casual Games, Puzzle Games, and Casual Games. Homa published games like Sky Roller, NERF! Epic Pranks!, Voodoo Pranks, Farm Land, and many others.
Relieve stress, anger, bad thoughts or train your brain with a relaxing, satisfying, yet challenging game anywhere, anytime!
If you believe that catching and training magic creatures is not just a matter of luck, show your abilities and become the best trainer in the world. Best of luck!
Do you have questions regarding our game or need support?

bluejetty:00154630:ios.description:
Proverbs 31 Devotionals is the freemium version of our Christian daily devotional app inspired by the timeless wisdom of Proverbs chapter 31. Created especially for God’s daughters, this app delivers a powerful daily devotional preceded by a daily Scripture verse to help you grow deeper in faith each day.
Whether you begin your morning in prayer or reflect before rest, Proverbs 31 Devotionals encourages you to walk in wisdom, strength, and grace.
Highlights:
• Downloaded over 500,000 times worldwide
• Millions of views across the globe, reaching women from the Philippines to Africa and beyond
• Over 100 five star reviews on our companion devotional book on Amazon
We are grateful to see God use this devotional to reach women in nations around the world.
Features:
• 365 Daily Devotionals (NIV Translation)
• 365 Verse Commentary entries (Matthew Henry)
• Daily Scripture followed by thoughtful reflection
• Community comment section to connect with other women of faith
• Share verses via text message and social media
• Connect directly with the Proverbs 31 community
Our prayer is that this app strengthens your walk with God and inspires you to live out His Word in your everyday life.
If this devotional blesses you, please remember to pray for us and leave a review.
Many blessings!

• Opportunities: apply to paid and gifted UGC
bluejetty:00146703:ios.description:
Brands pay creators for UGC videos, photos and sponsored posts. Jem shows you the paid campaigns open right now, gives you a media kit to send, and helps you pitch brands directly.
FREE ON JEM
• Opportunities: apply to paid and gifted UGC and influencer campaigns posted by brands.
• Media kit: a shareable page with your stats synced from Instagram and TikTok, so brands see your numbers before they book you.
• Creator profile: show your niche and the content you make.
JEM PRO
• Daily brand matches: brands picked for you every day, with why each one fits and what it pays.
• Pitches written for you: AI drafts a pitch for each brand. Read it, edit it, then send it from your own email.
• Brand Finder: search 30K+ brands by niche and pitch one or many at once.
WHY CREATORS USE JEM
• Stop hunting through DMs, hashtags and job boards for brands that pay.
• UGC doesn't need a big following. Brands pay for the content itself.
• Pitch brands that aren't posting campaigns yet instead of waiting to be found.
A NOTE ON RESULTS
Brands choose who they work with, so no app can promise you a deal. Jem gives you more chances: every open campaign in one place, a media kit that's ready to send, and a way to pitch the brands you want to work with.
FOR BRANDS
Post a campaign, find UGC creators and influencers, and send offers from the same app.
ABOUT JEM PRO
Jem Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://jem.social/privacy-policy

Experience an exciting new way to enjoy jigsaw puzzles! In Jigsawcard, you’ll flip, slide, match, and snap puzzle cards to reveal breathtaking HD images. - Stunning HD jigsaw pictures: nature, art, animals & more

- Unlock different sceneries to keep your puzzle journey fresh
Perfect For
- Fans of jigsaw puzzles, sliding puzzles, card matching, or unique blend of jigsaw and solitaire gameplay
- Players seeking a relaxing yet rewarding puzzle experience
- Those who love beautiful, high‑quality visuals while training their brain
Jigsawcard is more than a jigsaw puzzle game — it’s your daily escape, your moment of calm, and a celebration of creativity. Flip, slide, match, and watch stunning HD puzzle cards come to life one satisfying snap at a time.
Download now and join jigsaw puzzle lovers worldwide in the beautiful and rewarding fusion of jigsaw and solitaire card puzzle experience!

bluejetty:00018989:ios.summary:
Throw away your pads and pencils, Clued Up will make you a Clue champion.

bluejetty:00018989:ios.description:
Throw away your pads and pencils, Clued Up will make you a Clue champion.
Clued Up transforms your messy notes into a crisp table, showing you for each card, at a glance: who’s holding it, who’s not holding it, who’s suggested it, who’s seen it and the likelihood of it being the card in the envelope. All you have to do is enter the details of each turn.
If you don’t want to give your opponents a chance Clued Up can go beyond just a smart scorecard. If you enable automatic deductions the app will cross-reference all of the turns in the game and locate cards for you, going way beyond what a human could achieve.
Clued Up works with pretty much any edition of Clue. 
Including: 
Alfred Hitchcock
Alien Vs. Predator
The Big Bang Theory
Doctor Who
Downton Abbey
Dungeons and Dragons
Family Guy
Firefly
Five Nights at Freddy’s
Game of Thrones
Golden Girls
Harry Potter
The Haunted Mansion
Juicy Couture
Legend of Zelda
The Office
Penny Dreadful
Rick and Morty Back in Blackout
Scooby-Doo!
Seinfeld
Sherlock
Simpsons
Star Wars
Supernatural
The Twilight Zone
The Walking Dead
If you don’t see your edition listed you can use the card set editing feature to create any edition you like and store it in the cloud for others to use.
Instructions
Game Setup:
Enter your name then the names of your opponents in the order they are sitting, starting with the player on your left.
Select if you want the game to automatically locate cards for you. If you select to use this feature, as you record the turns in the game the app will cross-reference the location of cards from all of the player's responses and deduce for you what cards must have been shown in each go. Be sure that your opponents don’t mind you winning if you leave this switch on (or don’t tell them).
Once you’ve entered the names of the players in the game you’ll be given the option to select which edition of the game you are playing. If you don’t see your edition listed then you can create a new edition. Any edition you create will be stored in the cloud for yourself and other players to use.
After selecting your card set you then have to enter in all of the cards you have been dealt. Enter every card you are holding and then press finish.
Playing the Game:
On the main screen, you have a list of all of the items. Eliminated items are shown in blue, items held by you in green and solved items are shown in red. Underneath the item name, you will see additional information such as who does or does not hold the card, who has suggested a card and who has seen a card. You will also see stats indicating how likely each card is to be the final item as a percentage and with the progress bar under each card.
To eliminate items you need to make suggestions and enter in the suggestions that your opponents make. The app will automatically eliminate a card if it is shown to you and, if you’ve selected to have the game located cards for you, when entering another player’s suggestion, if a card is shown and it’s known that the other two cards in the suggestion are elsewhere or not held by that player the game will automatically eliminate these.
To enter your suggestion you pick the items from the table and press the ‘Your Suggestion’ button. You will ask the player to your left, if they don’t show a card to you press ‘No Cards Shown’ and move on to the next player, if they show a card you select the card from the wheel and press ‘Card Shown’.
To enter an opponent’s suggestion you do the same thing except you select ‘Other’s Suggestion’ and, on the next screen, select the player making the suggestion.
You can manually enter that a player holds or doesn’t hold a particular card by swiping the cell to the left a pressing the Eliminate/Uneliminate button.
The app will tell you when cards locations are deduced and categories are solved.
You can undo your last move if you make a mistake by pressing the menu button and selecting Undo.
Full Terms and Conditions: 
http://bit.ly/2KylV0Y

bluejetty:00061792:ios.description:
The award-winning (1) U.S. Bank Mobile App lets you manage your accounts, monitor cash flow, send money and much more, all in one app.
Security at your fingertips
• Log in with your credentials or enroll in digital services.

Manage accounts and cards
