bluejetty:00092217:ios.description:
Talk to a primary physician or pediatrician, from your mobile device or computer, 7 days a week, from 6 am to 10 pm Triple-S makes it easy for you and your family to have a virtual visit with a doctor wherever you need care within your service area.
Realiza tus consultas médicas a generalistas, internistas, pediatras o médicos de familia en cualquier momento a través de tu dispositivo móvil, entre las 6 a.m. y 10 p.m., sin necesidad de cita previa. Triple-S lleva el cuidado de tu salud al lugar en el que te encuentres dentro de tu área de servicio, para ti y tu familia.
Have a question to ask a physician? Get the care you need with a primary physician. Typical symptoms include:
¿Quieres realizar una consulta médica? Obtén la atención que necesitas con un médico primario. Los síntomas más comunes incluyen:
Bronchitis
Cough
Sinus infection
Sore throat
Urinary tract infection
Vomiting
Diarrhea
Fever
Pinkeye
Flu
Sprains and strains
Cold
Respiratory infection
Headache
Bronquitis
Tos
Sinusitis
Garganta irritada
Infecciones del tracto urinario
Diarrea
Fiebre
Conjuntivitis
Influenza
Dislocaciones y torceduras
Resfriado
Infecciones respiratorias
Dolores de cabeza leves / moderados
Mordeduras de insectos / piojos
Erupción en la piel
Náuseas / malestar estomacal
Just select a provider. Depending on the issue at hand, the doctor can diagnose, suggest follow up, and prescribe, when appropriate.
Simplemente selecciona un proveedor. Dependiendo de tu situación, el médico puede diagnosticar, sugerir un seguimiento y recetar, cuando corresponda.
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis. 
Si usas Apple Health, puedes optar por compartir tu información de salud con el médico durante tu consulta virtual, como frecuencia cardíaca, presión arterial, temperatura, niveles de glucosa en la sangre, peso, información nutricional y frecuencia respiratoria.
Triple-S takes your privacy very seriously. Your visit with the doctor is secure and HIPAA compliant.
Para Triple-S tu privacidad es muy importante. Tu consulta con el médico es segura y cumple con HIPAA.
User says: "I can't stress how easy and helpful TeleConsulta MD was. I'll be using this app whenever I need to consult with a physician!"
Usuario dice: "No puedo enfatizar cuán fácil y útil es TeleConsulta MD. ¡Usaré esta aplicación cada vez que necesite hacer una consulta médica!"

FNC Bank Mobile Banking is your personal financial advocate that allows you to access your bank accounts anytime and anywhere. It’s fast, secure, and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
With FNC Bank Mobile Banking, you can:
View balances and transactions
Search transactions by description and add tags, notes, and images
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Easily transfer between accounts within your application or to/from your account at other financial institutions
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card, control card alerts, or turn the card off if misplaced or stolen
View and save your monthly eStatements
Find branches and ATMs near you
With two-factor authentication, you’ll know your sensitive data is protected. Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FNC Bank Mobile Banking app, you must be enrolled as an FNC Bank online banking user. If you currently use our Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same credentials.

- Монголын алтан үеийн домог болсон уран бүтээлчдээс эхлээд өнөө цагт өөр мэдрэмж, өвөрмөц хэмнэлээр уран бүтээлээ туурвиж, урлагийн ертөнцөд хөл тавьж байгаа шинэ залуу бүхий л уран бүтээлчдийн дуу хөгжмийг нэг дороос сонсож мэдрэх боломжтой.
- Дэлхийн өнцөг булан бүрд Монголоороо овоглож, омогшиж байгаа Өвөр Монгол, Халимаг, Тува үндэстэн, ястнуудын дуу хуурын нэгдсэн сан хөмрөг.
- Үйлчилгээний нэг эрхээр өөрийн гар утас, таблет, зөөврийн болон суурин компьютер дээрээ ашиглана.
- Сүлжээгүй датагүй газар аялж, зорчихдоо ч оффлайн горимоор дуртай дуу хөгжмөө хүссэнээрээ сонсох боломжтой.
- Зөвхөн таны мэдрэмжид нийцэх шинэ болон хуучны дуунууд, аяз, хөгжмийн бүтээлүүдийг санал болгох recommendation system.
- Канадын StingRay Music компанитай хамтран гадаад дуу хөгжмийг оюуны өмчийн эрхтэйгээр Монголын хэрэглэгч, сонсогчдодоо түгээж буй албан ёсны платфром.
- Дуртай дуу хөгжмөө хүссэнээрээ ангилж, жагсаалт үүсгэх боломжтой.
- Хэзээ ч уйдааж, ганцаардуулахгүй 24 цаг зогсолтгүй эгшиглэх Радио сувгууд.
- Зөвхөн Mmusic-ээс сонсох боломжтой дуу хөгжмийн подкаст.
Дуу хөгжимд дурлагч, мэдрэмж мэдрэхүйгээ хөг аялгуугаар цэнэглэгч эрхэм та Mmusic-г ашигласнаар дээр дурдсан боломжуудаас гадна өдөр бүр шинэчлэгдэх дууны сан, технологийн сайжруулалтуудын алхам бүхэнд хамт байх боломжтой. Мөн та бидэнтэй үйлчилгээтэй холбоотой санал сэтгэгдлээ бидэнтэй нээлттэй хуваалцаж, Монголынхоо дуу хөгжмийн салбарын экосистемийг төгөлдөржүүлэхэд хувь нэмрээ оруулаарай.

bluejetty:00066098:ios.description:
In order to bring back Sally from the Alien army who took her, Brown, Cony, Moon, James, and all the other LINE characters transform into Rangers and set out on an adventure to rescue her!
More than 400 characters you know and love such as Brown and Cony appear in unique outfits!
Make your very own team and beat oncoming enemies with simple taps!
◆ Battle
Tap and dispatch Rangers such as Brown, Cony, Moon, and James from your Tower and reduce the enemy Tower to 0 HP to rescue Sally!
Make full use of Skills and Items by simply tapping them to get an advantage in battles!
This tower defense RPG game is easy to play, so anyone can join in and have fun!
◆ PVP Battle
LINE Rangers also has PVP! Battle with other players and rise to the top of various leagues!
Deploy your favorite Rangers in intense PVP battles!
Knowing the traits of your Rangers and mastering the timings to deploy them are the keys to victory in PVP!
Battle with players from around the world in this easy-to play fun PVP
◆ Ranger development
Level up your Rangers by using them in battles and combining them with other Rangers!
You can make your Rangers such as Brown and Cony more powerful by equipping them with Weapons, Armor, and Accessories!
Collect evolution materials and use them to get even stronger Ultimate and Hyper Evolved Rangers!
◆ Team play with LINE Friends
When you find yourself in a tough battle, summon your LINE Friends to help you out!
Also, join a guild with LINE Friends and you can have even more guild members help you out in a pinch!
Partake in guild raids with other guild members and go after all the guild perks!
You can have an even more fun time battling together with with friends!
◆ Event
A variety of IP tie-ups with super popular characters!
Time-limited stages and tie-up exclusive Rangers appear too!
These events will regularly appear in the future, too!
Once you start playing, you won't be able to stop! An engaging tower defense RPG LINE Game with simple controls!
Deploy now with Brown, Cony, Moon, James, and the rest!
Sally's waiting for you to rescue her!
You're sure to enjoy this game if...
- You enjoy LINE Games.
- You like LINE characters such as Brown, Sally, Cony, Moon, and James.
- You like tower defense RPG battles.
- You're looking for an easy-to-play fun game.
- You like PVP (player vs. player).
Have great battles in this fun and easy-to play tower defense RPG!
Please note:
- You may have difficulty playing the game if you have problematic Wi-Fi connectivity and/or issues with your network environment. 
- Connecting via Wi-Fi is recommended.

Start with one of the patterns included in the app or search to find the perfect pattern for you
bluejetty:00021975:ios.description:
Ravelgurumi makes it easy to find and use thousands of amigurumi knit and crochet patterns, leaving you more time to make adorable plush toys.
Start with one of the patterns included in the app or search to find the perfect pattern for you.
Download patterns so that you can work on them offline - no network required. Find your downloaded patterns easily in “My patterns” so that you can quickly get back to the fun
Track your progress using the built in row counter and notes available for each pattern. Pick the size of the row counter you prefer, and drag it wherever you want on screen so you can always see your pattern and keep count. Keep notes for each pattern, so that you never forget a hook, yarn or adaptation again. 
Get the right patterns for you using the app filters to pick your craft and skill level.
Style the app your way by choosing a color scheme.
Be inspired by the daily featured patterns.
Get quick access to your patterns and featured directly by using your device search bar or shortcuts.
Ravelgurumi is the ultimate amigurumi patterns app to use on-the-go or at home.
Ravelgurumi uses popular patterns from Ravelry. You will need to log in using your Ravelry account to get the patterns or sign up if you don’t have an account already. It’s free to set up a Ravelry account and really quick and simple to do either in the app or the website.
Unlimited access:
Full access to daily featured patterns, my patterns and user filters is available for free to all users.
To get full unlimited access to all patterns, this app requires a subscription. 
This starts on a trial basis so you can try before you buy. If you are happy with the trial, you do not need to do anything to extra to continue your unlimited access - the trial subscription will automatically convert to a paid subscription at the end of the trial period. If you decide to cancel, please go to your app store settings and cancel the trial subscription at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
The unlimited subscription will automatically renew at the end of the subscription period (month or year). You can prevent auto-renewal but cancelling the subscription in your app store settings at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. If you can cancel your subscription it will not automatically renew, but you will still have unlimited access until the period ends. 
Please note: deleting your app does not delete your subscriptions.

bluejetty:00101931:android.summary:
Button mapper lets you Remap all Hard Buttons of your android phone to do any custom action, launch any app or shortcut. This app lets you customize your phone the way you like.
 You can customize single tap , double tap or long press of f
bluejetty:00101931:android.description:
Button mapper lets you Remap all Hard Buttons of your android phone to do any custom action, launch any app or shortcut. This app lets you customize your phone the way you like.
 You can customize single tap , double tap or long press of following buttons:
- Back Button 
- Home Button 
- Recent Button 
- Volume Up 
- Volume Down 
- Headset Button
 You can customize the single tap , double tap and long press for these buttons. assign any custom action to these buttons or remap these buttons to launch any app or shortcut. You can assign any app or shortcut to be launched. 
you can assign following actions to these buttons 
- Disable the Button with No action. 
- Do the Default action of the button, Back button will do Back action, volume will change volume, Home button will do default home action 
- assign Back action to any button i.e volume up, volume down or recent button 
- assign Home action to any button i.e back , volume or recent button 
- assign Recent action to any button i.e volume, Home or Back button 
- Change Volume - Show Power dialog with any button 
- Kill foreground App 
- Turn Screen Off 
- Toggle Flash Light ON/OFF
- Toggle Silent / Vibrate Mode 
- Mute Microphone 
- Activate Do not Disturb Mode 
- Launch Quick Settings 
- Expand Notification Bar 
- Toggle Portrait / Landscape Mode 
- Toggle Play / Pause Music 
- Next / Previous Track 
- Open Search 
- Open any App or Shortcut Advance options: 
- change the long press or double tap duration 
-disable Button Mapper while using specific apps 
-disable Button Mapper while using Camera 
-disable Button Mapper while Phone is On call 
You can change these Options by Going to Advance Options in app 
##### Important Note ######
 This application uses Accessibility services (BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE) . Accessibility is used to replace a failed and broken buttons. ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE is used to detect when the following buttons are pressed : - Home - Back - Recent - Volume Up, Volume Down and Headset. It also uses Accessibility Service to perform Back, Home, Recent Apps Event, Quick Setting Menu, Notification Panel. It is not used to see what you type. This Accessibility Service of Button Mapper does not store or collect your other personal Information.
 This app uses the Device Administrator permission (BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN). This permission is used on

bluejetty:00173572:ios.description:
Bring your leagues with you. Cheatsheet syncs your leagues with the top fantasy football sites — your teams, settings, scoring, and draft order come over and stay in sync automatically. Then draft smarter with rankings built for YOUR exact league — and The GM, your AI assistant, in your corner all season.
MEET THE GM — YOUR AI ASSISTANT
- Ask anything: who to pick, who to start, what your roster needs
- The GM knows your league — your scoring, your rosters, and who's still on the board
- Wondering if a player will make it back to your next pick? The GM reads the whole draft, including every other team's roster
- Act on its advice right from the chat: queue a player, Star, Avoid, or build a custom list — with one-tap undo
IMPORT & SYNC YOUR LEAGUES
- Connect your league from the top fantasy football sites in seconds — no manual setup
- Members, roster settings, and scoring import automatically
- Your draft order comes over, ready to go
- Everything stays in sync as your league changes
- Prefer to build your own? Manual leagues sync across your devices too
INTELLIGENT DRAFT TECHNOLOGY
- Personalized player rankings tailored to your exact league settings
- Player tiers show you where the talent drops off at every position
- Real-time mock drafts that adapt to your league's drafting patterns
- Live team grades after every pick — know which positions to target
- Custom cheat sheets that update instantly as players are drafted
SEASON-LONG ADVANTAGE
- Weekly projections updated daily with the latest player news
- Smart start/sit analyzer for optimal lineup decisions
- Value-based rankings (VBD) you can tune to your preferences
- Custom and dynamic rankings that react to your roster
BUILT FOR EVERY LEAGUE
- Snake, auction, dynasty, best ball, IDP, and fully custom scoring
- PPR, half-PPR, and standard formats
- Commissioner tools, keepers, and trade analysis
- Draft clock and live draft management for game day
- Real-time sync across all your devices
Whether you're importing a league you've run for years or starting fresh, Cheatsheet gives you the edge from draft day through the playoffs.
Download now and draft like a champion.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00068951:ios.summary:

Corkulous is a multi-purpose app containing boards where
bluejetty:00068951:ios.description:
Corkulous© for Mac OS and iOS is the incredible way to collect, organize, and share your ideas that feels completely natural. If you have a Mac, iPhone. or iPad, you need this app! 
Corkulous is a multi-purpose app containing boards where you can place notes, labels, photos, contacts, shapes, strings/lines connections, pdf's, link previews and tasks. There are also powerful sketch tools, that can create shapes and lines based on gestures. Group your ideas visually on one board or spread ideas out across multiple boards (sub-boards also supported). Each board has plenty of real estate and resolutions to capture your best ideas and plans.
WHAT IS CORKULOUS?
Cork Boards, Flow Charts, Idea Board, Photo Albums, Reminder Board, Mind Map, Goal Manager, Planners, Vision Board, To-do list, Exam Study Aid, Lesson Planner, Photo gallery... and more!
FEATURES
- PDF's, Videos, Link Previews, Emoji, Strings/Lines, Notes, Labels, Photos, Contacts, Tasks, Index Cards, Arrow Text, and over 40 shapes
- Sketch tools with shape/line gesture support
- Export and share PDF's, PNG, Text, and Corkulous files
- iCloud and Dropbox syncing of boards. Share boards with other users on dropbox
- The best searching capabilities of any iOS/Mac OS app
- Awesome Drag/Drop support. 
- Dark and Light mode support
- Multi window support on iOS/MacOS
- Markdown for text formatting
- Multiple board resolutions
- Pan and zoom boards
- Create templates of boards for future use
- Nested boards! Go as deep as you can
- Biometrics support for locking content
- On the Mac, quick access Touch Bar and menu support
- On iOS/Mac keyboard shortcuts to fill many tasks
SUBSCRIPTION
Corkulous subscription is cross platform! You can work on iOS or macOS with the same subscription. Just tap Restore Purchase on any other device.
The Corkulous subscription will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel the subscription renewal at any time, and the subscription you purchased will remain active until the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions on the App Store's Account Settings after purchase (http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098).
FEEDBACK
That's right, we LOVE positive feedback! Please be kind in your app reviews, tell others how you use Corkulous, and stay tuned for new and exciting features.
Twitter: http://twitter.com/corkulous
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/corkulous
Website: http://www.corkulous.com/
Privacy Policy: http://www.corkulous.com/privacypolicy
Terms & Conditions: http://www.corkulous.com/terms

bluejetty:00150443:ios.description:
Unscrew colorful puzzles, master tricky challenges, and restore amazing aircraft!
Welcome to Aircraft Master, a satisfying screw puzzle game where every move brings you closer to building your dream collection of aircraft!
Put your logic and problem-solving skills to the test as you remove colorful screws, free overlapping shapes, and clear challenging puzzles. Think ahead, plan your moves carefully, and solve each level before you run out of space!
Start with simple screw puzzles and progress through hundreds of increasingly challenging levels. Discover exciting mechanics, special obstacles, and unique 3D screw puzzles that put your skills to the test.
GAME FEATURES:
• SATISFYING SCREW PUZZLES
Unscrew colorful bolts, clear overlapping shapes, and solve clever logic puzzles.
• HUNDREDS OF CHALLENGING LEVELS
Enjoy 500+ screw puzzle levels with new shapes, layouts, and challenges as you progress.
• EXCITING PUZZLE MECHANICS
Overcome frozen screws, chains, locks, timed challenges, and the Swapper mechanic!
• RESTORE AMAZING AIRCRAFT
Complete restoration tasks and bring 8 unique aircraft and spacecraft to life, including classic propeller planes, helicopters, fighter jets, luxury private jets, vintage warplanes, a tiltrotor aircraft, and even a space shuttle!
• CUSTOMIZE YOUR AIRCRAFT
Make your restored aircraft stand out with special designs and decals.
• NEW CHALLENGES AWAIT
Discover fresh puzzles, new mechanics, and more aircraft restoration adventures in future updates!
Whether you love satisfying screw puzzles, tricky brain teasers, or bringing incredible aircraft back to life, Aircraft Master offers a rewarding combination of puzzle-solving and restoration.
Think smart, unscrew carefully, and complete your aircraft collection!
Download Aircraft Master and start your puzzle adventure today!

• Lots of challenging and fun puzzles, perfect for all audiences
• Immersive ambient music tracks
• First part of an exciting storyline
• Completely free and no ads
• Available in 8 different languages!

bluejetty:00130787:ios.description:
FocusBrain combines 8D spatial audio with brainwave frequencies - 40Hz Gamma, Alpha, and Theta Neural Soundscapes for ADHD, deep focus, calm, and restorative sleep.
Some minds are wired differently. They think faster, feel deeper, and carry more - but finding stillness doesn't come naturally.
FocusBrain is a thoughtfully designed neural sound system for anyone who needs more than silence and less than meditation. Every Neural Soundscape is built around specific brainwave frequencies - delivered in immersive 8D spatial audio you feel the moment you put your headphones on.
DEEP FOCUS - LOCK IN ON DEMAND
Whether it's a long work session, reading, or creative projects that deserve your full attention - Gamma (40Hz) and Beta-frequency Neural Soundscapes create a calm, consistent neural environment that supports sustained presence and productivity. No willpower required. Press play, and your mind knows it's time.
NEURAL TUNING - FOR MINDS THAT RUN DIFFERENT
If your thoughts naturally move in multiple directions at once, you don't need to fix it - you need the right support. Our Alpha and low-Gamma Neural Soundscapes help create a stable, clear cognitive baseline - supporting attention, memory, and mental clarity without medication, without routines, without someone telling you to just breathe.
Pure sound. Specific frequencies. Built for how your mind actually works.
ADHD SUPPORT - DESIGNED FOR HOW YOUR BRAIN WORKS
Living with ADHD means your brain doesn't follow the usual rhythm. FocusBrain's Neural Soundscapes are specifically designed to support ADHD minds - helping reduce mental noise, sustain attention, and build a calmer, clearer cognitive baseline. No medication, no complicated routines. Just put on your headphones and let the frequencies do the work.
ADHD IN DAILY LIFE
- Morning focus sessions to start your day with clarity
- Work and study support to sustain attention without burnout
- Wind-down sessions to quiet a restless mind before sleep
- Short 10-minute resets when everything feels too loud
SLEEP ARCHITECTURE - FROM RESTLESS TO DEEP REST
The hardest part of sleep isn't staying asleep - it's getting there. When your mind won't quiet down, Delta and Theta-frequency Neural Soundscapes guide a gentle neural downshift. Not a sleep story. Not a breathing exercise. Soothing acoustic patterns that support your brain's natural transition into deep, restorative sleep.
WHY FOCUSBRAIN
- Real frequency-engineered Neural Soundscapes - not generic ambient playlists
- 8D spatial immersion designed for headphone use
- 40Hz sessions for attention, cognition, clarity, and flow
- Session-based, timer-ready - simple and easy to use
- No guided voice, no accounts, no social features
- Supports focus, productivity, memory, cognition, ADHD, stress relief, and sleep
BUILT FOR
Anyone who values mental clarity and restorative sleep. Whether you're managing ADHD, navigating a busy life, or simply looking for a reliable way to find calm - FocusBrain meets you where you are.
If you've explored binaural beats, brainwave entrainment, or frequency-based audio and found most options too complicated or too vague - FocusBrain makes the science simple.
START WITH ONE SESSION
Open FocusBrain. Pick your state. Put on your headphones.
---

Have Swansea City AFC at your fingertips with the FREE Official Swansea City AFC App.

bluejetty:00134586:ios.description:
The Clipper app is here! 
- Pay your fares with Clipper in Apple Pay
- Manage your account(s) 
- Load cash value and transit passes
- Plan your trips 
Clipper is the all-in-one transit card used for contactless fare payments throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. The new Clipper app lets you manage your Clipper account from your iPhone—add value, view your history, and plan your trip!
Download the Clipper app today!
Pay with Your iPhone or Apple Watch
The Clipper app gives you step-by-step instructions for setting up a new Clipper card or transferring an existing Clipper card to your Apple Wallet. 
Manage Your Account
The Clipper app gives you the same account access as the website, but on your iPhone! You can register a new card, load cash value and transit passes, set up Autoload, view your recent activity, and other features. Sign in and out of multiple Clipper accounts in the Clipper app to manage a card on behalf of someone else.
Plan Your Trip
The Clipper app has real-time transit information and helpful trip planning tools to make getting around the Bay easy! You can view nearby transit options and routes, get real-time travel and arrival information, and save your favorite locations, stops, and stations.
By downloading this app, you agree to and accept the terms of the Clipper Mobile Application License Agreement (https://www.clippercard.com/ClipperWeb/mobile-application-agreement.html) and the Clipper Privacy Policy (https://www.clippercard.com/ClipperWeb/privacy.html).

AC Transit
BART
Caltrain
City Coach
County Connection
Dumbarton Express
FAST

Golden Gate Transit

Vine
VTA

Wheels
By downloading this app, you agree to and accept the terms of the Clipper Mobile Application License Agreement (https://www.clippercard.com/ClipperWeb/mobile-application-agreement.html) and the Clipper Privacy Policy (https://www.clippercard.com/ClipperWeb/privacy.html).

bluejetty:00099408:ios.description:
Dive into the App for Premium Comics and Manga!
Storygrounds is the only place where the community makes an impact on the stories and is rewarded for it! Whether you're a fan of Manga, Manhwa, or Webtoon, we provide the highest quality comic reads of your favorite genres, including Action, Fantasy, Romance, Comedy, BL, GL, Drama, Horror, and more.
Why Choose Storygrounds? 
OUTSTANDING STORIES - immerse yourself in amazing comics, webtoons, manga and manhwa 
YOU INFLUENCE THE STORY - assist creators by completing quests to shape a comic's path! This isn't fanfiction, this is actual impact! 
BE REWARDED - do fun stuff, get rewarded! Read, complete objectives and collect stamps and coins to get more comics for free! 
FIND YOUR COMMUNITY - join passionate readers and creators who love comics 
GENRES FOR EVERYONE - exciting action, fantasy, romance, horror, and more await you
FEATURED COMICS & MANGA
Beyond the Vale - An interactive comic where YOUR choices determine the story! Join CaseOh in this exclusive manhwa series where readers vote on plot twists.
Popular Categories: Action Manga - Battle comics with interactive combat choices; Romance Manhwa - BL manga, GL manhwa, love stories where you choose couples; Fantasy Webtoons - Magical comics and isekai manga with reader-driven storylines; Horror Comics - Scary comics where you decide who survives; Comedy Webtoons - Funny comics featuring community memes
HOW INTERACTIVE COMICS WORK
Reading comics on Storygrounds isn't passive, you're part of the creative process! Our manga reader app lets you influence storylines through:
Visual Quests - Design characters and backgrounds that appear in comics Story 
Votes - Choose plot directions for your favorite manga and manhwa
Writing Challenges - Submit dialogue and story ideas for webtoons 
Creator Collaboration - Work directly with comic artists
Every comic, manga, and webtoon features interactive elements. Whether you're reading action manhwa, romance manga, or horror comics, your input shapes the story!
REWARDS FOR READING
Our comic app rewards active readers! Collect coins and stamps while reading manga, manhwa, and webtoons:
Daily Login Rewards - Free coins for reading comics every day 
Quest Completion - Earn stamps for participating in manga story decisions 
Free Premium Comics - Use coins to unlock exclusive manga and manhwa chapters
The more comics you read and quests you complete, the more free manga and webtoons you unlock!
EXTENSIVE COMIC LIBRARY
Discover thousands of comics, manga, manhwa, and webtoons across every genre:
Action & Adventure - Epic battle manga, superhero webtoons, martial arts manhwa 
Romance & Drama - Love story comics, BL/Yaoi manga, GL/Yuri manhwa 
Fantasy & Sci-Fi - Magic comics, isekai manga, supernatural manhwa 
Horror & Thriller - Scary comics, psychological manga, zombie manhwa 
Comedy & Slice of Life - Funny comics, school manga, workplace manhwa
New manga chapters and comic updates daily! Our webtoon reader app ensures you never run out of stories.
JOIN THE COMIC COMMUNITY
Connect with fellow manga readers and comic fans: 
Discuss your favorite manhwa and webtoons in forums Share comic fan art and manga theories. Meet creators behind your beloved comics. Participate in reading challenges Vote in popularity contests.
Storygrounds is the hub for comic and manga lovers! Download now and start shaping the stories you love. Your next favorite manga, manhwa, or webtoon is waiting - YOU control how it ends!
Install the best interactive comic reader app today - where readers become creators!

bluejetty:00131066:ios.description:

Artist Only: Hear songs from the station artist.

bluejetty:00071201:ios.description:
Introducing "Shapy" - Your Ultimate Fitness App!
Wherever you are - at the gym, office, home, or enjoying the great outdoors - "Shapy" acts as your personal trainer, available anytime and anywhere. It goes beyond providing workout plans by creating and customizing meal plans tailored to your needs, guiding you towards weight loss, fat burning, or maintaining a healthy lifestyle. The app caters to your unique preferences and dietary habits, offering premium features designed specifically for you. With hundreds of recipes and regular additions, you'll never run out of options.
Join the thousands of satisfied customers who have rated "Shapy" 5 stars and left enthusiastic reviews on the App Store.
Key Features of "Shapy":
Diverse Workout Programs: Choose from a wide variety of exercises and workout plans that vary in length and intensity. No special equipment is required; all you need is dedication and resolve. Our research and science-based routines help you build endurance and flexibility.
Personalized Workouts: "Shapy" offers workouts tailored to your schedule, fitness level, and goals. Whether you want to target abs, arms, chest, back, buttocks, or legs, our workouts cover all muscle groups.
Comprehensive Meal Plans: Enhance the benefits of regular workouts with well-balanced and sensible meal plans based on your dietary habits and needs. We'll accompany you every step of the way to a healthier, fitter you.
Instructive Videos: Our videos demonstrate each exercise step-by-step, ensuring you maintain proper form and technique. We provide valuable tips to help you execute each exercise correctly.
Reminders and Motivation: "Shapy" sends you reminders and motivating messages to keep you on track with your training and healthy diet.
Integration with HealthKit: Seamlessly import body measurement data such as gender, age, weight, and height using the integration with Apple Health. You can easily fill out your information and synchronize it with "Shapy." The synchronization with Apple Health can be disabled in the app's settings.
Shapy Premium Subscription. Choose the subscription duration that suits your needs for unlimited access to all levels of fitness plans, extra workout routines, and premium features. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Start your fitness journey today with "Shapy," your ultimate companion for achieving your fitness goals and maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Take action now and begin your incredible journey with "Shapy"! Download the app today and experience amazing results for yourself!
Terms of Use: https://vgfit.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://vgfit.com/privacy

bluejetty:00099060:ios.description:
The legendary anime returns—now as a mobile game! 
Officially licensed by the Yu Yu Hakusho anime series, this brand-new title brings the action to your fingertips.
One day, Yusuke Urameshi, a rebellious teenager, dies in a traffic accident while trying to save a child. However, he’s told by Botan—the guide of souls—that his death was unexpected in the Spirit World. If he can pass a series of trials set by the Spirit World, he’ll be granted a second chance at life.
And so begins the unforgettable story of Yu Yu Hakusho! 
Team up with iconic characters, overcome challenges, and join Yusuke on an epic adventure in 《Yu Yu Hakusho》! 
▶A Faithful Recreation of the World of Yu Yu Hakusho
Dive into the world of Yu Yu Hakusho, faithfully recreated with stunning cel-shaded visuals.
Iconic scenes are brought to life in high quality, immersing you in action-packed missions and story-driven challenges.
Experience the emotion and intensity of the anime—right in the palm of your hand. 
▶Assemble Your Dream Team – Strategic Combos Await
Build your ultimate team with iconic characters like Yusuke, Kuwabara, Hiei, Kurama, Genkai, Younger Toguro, Sensui, Yomi, and more! 
Mix and match characters and skills to master team synergies and turn the tide of battle with your strategy!
▶Rich Content – The Path to Becoming the Strongest
Dive into a wealth of content including "The Dark Tournament" "the hole to the Demon Realm" and "The Demon World Tournament"! 
Master every PVE/PVP/GVG mode—and strive to become the strongest! 
▶Original Voice Cast & 3D Modeling
Fan-favorite characters are brought to life with vivid 3D designs! 
Featuring voice acting by the original anime cast: 
Yusuke Urameshi (VA: Nozomu Sasaki) 
Kazuma Kuwabara (VA: Shigeru Chiba) 
Hiei (VA: Nobuyuki Hiyama) 
Kurama (VA: Megumi Ogata) 
Younger Toguro (VA:Tessho Genda)
...and more!

bluejetty:00030995:ios.description:
Monitor your heart health with Check Heart Rate Now!
Stay in control of your wellness with Check Heart Rate Now—a powerful and easy-to-use health monitor designed to help you stay on top of your cardiovascular health. Whether you're a fitness enthusiast, actively managing your well-being, or simply curious about your heart's rhythm, our heart rate tracker is known as one of the best heart rate monitor apps on the market.
"This is a great app for monitoring your heart rate and helpful information regarding diet, exercise and much more."
Key Benefits:
** Real-time Pulse Tracker
Use our pulse checker to check heart rate on your iPhone anytime, anywhere. Whether during workouts, rest, or daily activity, you’ll get accurate pulse readings with instant results using our bp tracker features.
** Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Insights
Track how stress, sleep, and exercise impact your heart with HRV analysis. Our pulse monitor offers deep insights into your daily rhythms—perfect for both lifestyle improvement and early warning signs.
** Beats per Minute Analyzer
Want to know more than just your number? Our heart health monitor provides a full breakdown of your pulse and cardiovascular activity. It’s like having a blood pressure app free at your fingertips—without needing extra equipment.
** Cardiac Health Trends and History
Stay in-the-know by reviewing your historical data. Record and track long-term heart trends using our advanced analytics. Use your phone as a checker and record tool for everything from morning resting rates to post-workout peaks.
** Apple Watch + HealthKit Integration
Sync with Apple Watch and HealthKit to log data effortlessly. The app turns your Apple Watch into a smart heart watch companion, giving you even deeper health insights right from your wrist.
** Camera-Based Measurement
Use your phone’s camera to instantly measure your pulse and heart rate — no extra devices needed.
** Simple, Secure, and Designed for You
The intuitive design makes navigation easy for all users. From basic heart rate checks to deep performance trends, you’ll love how smooth the experience is. All your data is kept private and encrypted—we respect your privacy as much as your health.
Download Check Heart Rate Now today and embark on a journey to better well-being.
Questions or feedback? Reach out to our dedicated support team at feedback@pulseheartcheck.com
IMPORTANT NOTICE
Check Heart Rate Now is not intended to replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The app is not a medical device, and users should always consult a doctor or qualified healthcare provider before making any health-related decisions.
PERMISSIONS
• Camera – Used for measuring your heart rate with accuracy
• HealthKit – Sync your heart data for a complete health profile
• Your personal health data stays secure under industry-leading standards.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
You can subscribe to Check Heart Rate Now to get access to premium features, like unlimited heart rate measurements
Options:
3-day free trial, then renews weekly for $6.99
Terms of Use: https://pulseheartcheck.com/terms.html 
Privacy Policy: https://pulseheartcheck.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00182139:android.summary:

Get to grips with a pug game specifi
bluejetty:00182139:android.description:
Look no further!
The most pug-tastic of all pet games is finally here, so join the adventure with Super Pug Play a story match-3 puzzle that’s on a whole new level, one that stands out from all the rest.
Get to grips with a pug game specifically developed to make you look at matching puzzle games in a completely new way. You’re sure to have seen and played tons of cute match-3 games before, both on- and offline, as plenty of them are available. If you haven’t though, but always wondered what it would be like to play one, Super Pug Story is the best possible match-3 puzzle game to start off with. 
What we’re about to introduce you to here is just such a match-3 puzzle, but one with quite a few striking and unique features that will take your breath away. How this game is unlike any other matching puzzle game What exactly is Super Pug Story? Well, it’s a little bit of a toons game, a pet story, a bit of a story puzzle, and, most obviously, a fascinating and well-designed 3-in-a-row game, in which the main task is to combine gems and use magic boosters. As one of the latest fun and free no WiFi games, you can play this super match-3 story on any Android device. And this adventure match-3 has been brought to a brand-new level with its coherent and logical story featuring an intrepid hero. 
On top of that, the game’s other key features that set it apart from most other new match-three games, or offline puzzle games in general, are all about making you a winner. The game is full of funny characters and pleasant surprises, making it potentially one of the best new cute offline match-3 games out there. But what else does Super Pug Story have to offer? All free-to-play 3-in-a-row games try to offer players something special, so we’ve decided to let you swap lives among your friends to extend your playtime and have even more fun! A game with virtual pugs Who hasn’t fallen in love with the cute characters in these free games? Having studied your tastes, we discovered that pug games deservedly occupy one of the top positions among active players in both the story games category and fun offline games you can play with no WiFi. 
Rigorous but easy-to-play, the pug game you’re just about to dive into is the ultimate match-3 adventure that will put a smile on your face while helping you wind down. No other casual puzzle story or match adventure game has such bright graphics and challenging gameplay as Super Pug Story. Though the concept might not be brand new in the world of entertainment and 3-in-a-row games, this free puzzle adventure with a virtual pet option is sure to appeal to everyone thanks to its cutest characters, colorful game spaces, and well-designed levels. We have no doubt whatsoever that Super Pug Story will become one of your most favorite match-3 adventure quest games, not to mention your top offline games.
 So feel free to recommend it not only to your friends but also to basically anyone and everyone with a little time to spare on their Android smartphone. You won’t want to stop or switch to any other 3-in-a-row game, either free or paid, we promise.
 Join the Super Pug squad right now and let’s get playing!

bluejetty:00064920:ios.name: Fortune City: Expense Tracker
bluejetty:00064920:ios.summary:
Track your spending, grow a city! Fortune City gamifies bookkeeping with a fun city simulation game. Record your income and expenses, and watch as your city flourishes into a beautiful metropolis. 
◈ Cultivate Good Habits in a Easy Way ◈
bluejetty:00064920:ios.description:
Track your spending, grow a city! Fortune City gamifies bookkeeping with a fun city simulation game. Record your income and expenses, and watch as your city flourishes into a beautiful metropolis. 
◈ Cultivate Good Habits in a Easy Way ◈ 
- Gamification gets you hooked on recording expenses! Build good habits while watching your city develop and grow.
- Easy to use interface let you track your spending and categorize transactions in simple taps.
◈ Analyze Expenses at a Glance ◈
- Pie charts and bar charts allow you to check income and expenses at a glance.
- Over 10 different categories and multiple accounts so you can keep clear records.
- View your balance weekly, monthly, or seasonally for both long and short term financial planning.
- Advanced searching functions allow you to quickly understand your personal spending habits.
◈ Build it your way ◈
- Choose from a variety of themes to personalize the look of your city.
- Collect over 100 different styles of buildings, unique vehicles, and friendly citizens to inhabit your town.
- Invite citizens to join your beautiful city. The happier they are, the more prosperous your city will become!
- Watch your ranking increase among your friends. See who can develop the most prosperous city!
But wait... there’s more!
- Automatic cloud storage backup
- Private password protection
- Global currency exchange
- Awards for daily use
- Even more practical features!
Any questions or suggestions? 
You can go to Fortune City > Menu > Settings > FAQ to quickly search for a solution to your problem.
If you’re unable to find an answer to your question, tap the envelope icon in the top right corner to contact our customer service. We’ll reply ASAP. :)
Chief Financial Officer is a Fortune City premium subscription plan that helps you improve the way you analyze and manage your expenses and create better financial management habits. After you've confirmed your subscription, you will start a 14 day free trial. After the trial period, iTunes will automatically charge and renew your subscription each month.You can go to your iTunes account to cancel your subscription at any time. iTunes will automatically renew your subscription 24 hours prior to the end of each subscription period. Please be mindful of your subscription period when managing your subscription.Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Fortune City requests access to “Location” to enable ""Smart Note”, which suggests notes based on your behaviors and locations to allow efficient expense tracking.
For other permissions, Please visit our support page: https://sparkful.app/help/apps/fortune-city
Find us on Facebook: https://link.sparkful.app/facebook
Visit our website: https://sparkful.app/fortune-city
Standard Apple Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service: https://sparkful.app/legal/terms
Refund Policy：https://sparkful.app/legal/refund-policy

Download the app and create a free account
Share your goals
Book a yoga class
Experience bliss

Regular yoga practice may reduce levels of stress and body-wide inflammation, contributing to healthier hearts.
Many of our customers have experienced lesser stress and better sleep right after attending even the first class.

Get the math app that will help your child master math in only 15 minutes a day! With over 2 million downloads, students and families around the world are using Smartick to master math, improve their math grade, and boosting their math skills.

EXPERT KNOWLEDGE
Recognized by MIT, HARVARD AND OXFORD UNIVERSITY. With access to an unlimited number of unique arithmetic exercises, including geometry, algebra and word problems! Kids learn math at their own pace with content that’s been developed by some of the world’s best mathematicians and teachers. 
MULTIMEDIA LEARNING
With math exercises and interactive tutorials developed using AI to help kids understand math in a way that adapts to their learning needs. Content available for ages 4-5, ages 6-8, ages 9-12 and ages 13-14.
MATH APPROACH
Boost your child's math learning by understanding the rationale behind math problems solutions, practicing problem solving skills, and engaging in cognitive math games.
Together, we will succeed in learning math, whether that's counting and adding or more advanced topics like geometry and algebra. In a personalized way and at their pace. 
KEY FEATURES
• Free step-by-step explanations

• Numerous solution strategies

bluejetty:00120066:ios.name: Drum School
bluejetty:00120066:ios.summary:
Advanced groove library and drum learning tool for all levels.
Whether you're a beginner or a pro, Drum School is the perfect tool for advancing and expanding your skills. 
With a large selection of grooves, exercises and practice ideas, D
bluejetty:00120066:ios.description:
Advanced groove library and drum learning tool for all levels.
Whether you're a beginner or a pro, Drum School is the perfect tool for advancing and expanding your skills. 
With a large selection of grooves, exercises and practice ideas, Drum School will continue to take you to the next level. 
It is also the perfect tool for easy access to a large library of professional sounding grooves for play along and as a reference library.
Included styles: Rock, Rock'n Roll, Alternative Rock, Heavy Metal, Punk, Blues, RnB, Hip Hop, Funk, Reggae, Ska, Disco, Drum'n Bass, House, Techno, Country, Bluegrass, Jazz, Swing, Dixieland, Ragtime, Fusion, New Orleans, Tango, Bossa Nova, Samba, Afro Cuban, Soukous, Calypso, Waltz and many more.
~ Featured in Modern Drummer and DownBeat Magazine ~
Drum School is divided in five main sections: Grooves, Practice, Technique, Hits and Favorites.
- GROOVES - 
This is the main section of Drum School with over 300 drum grooves in many different styles.
Each groove comes with:
- Standard drum notation with high quality graphics in portrait or landscape mode.
- High quality audio made from real drum samples that loop for play along practice.
- Variable tempo range of 30 to 300 bpm without any loss of audio quality. 
- Audio isolation of what each limb is playing, allowing the student to break down the groove into its basic components, learn them separately, and finally put them back together in various combinations.
- Bass lines that help learning and experiencing the relationship between the drums and the bass in each style in a fun way.
- High quality video performance by the author of the app, established and world renowned drummer, Ferenc Nemeth. The video speed can be adjusted and the more advanced grooves come with an extra video at a slower tempo.
- Multiple drum fills that can be practiced individually or in conjunction with the groove in 2, 4 or 8 bar phrases.
- Color coded indication of difficulty level from 1 (easy) to 6 (hard).
- Ability to mark the groove as completed so you can better track your practice progress.
- Detailed description of performance details, learning tips and historical notes about each style.
- PRACTICE -
The practice section includes 145 drum exercises divided into: Basic Rudiments, Rolls, Flams, Drags, Hand Exercises and Coordination.
Each exercise comes with:
- Standard drum notation with high quality graphics in portrait or landscape mode.
- High quality audio made from real drum samples that loop for play along practice.
- Variable tempo range of 30 to 300 bpm without any loss of audio quality. 
- Audio isolation of left and right hand.
- High quality video demonstration with adjustable speed.
- Detailed descriptions of performance details and learning tips.
- TECHNIQUE -
This section includes 12 video demonstrations of basic drum technique for hands and feet.
Each video is accompanied by a detailed description and learning tips.
- HITS -
This section includes classic Pop, Rock and Funk hits. Each groove comes with the same features as the "Grooves" section.
- FAVORITES - 
This is where you collect your favorite grooves and the ones you are currently working on.
Visit the support website for a video demonstration.

bluejetty:00095997:ios.description:
AI Tattoo Generator – TattooAI helps you create, explore, and preview unique tattoo ideas before making them permanent. Generate a custom tattoo design with AI, try tattoos on your own photos, create tattoo stencils, explore tattoo fonts, and prepare designs for printing — all in one creative tattoo app.
Whether you are planning your first tattoo, looking for inspiration for your next piece, or simply experimenting with different styles, Tattoo AI helps bring your ideas to life in seconds.
AI TATTOO GENERATOR
Describe the tattoo you have in mind and let our Tattoo Generator transform your idea into original artwork. Explore minimalist, fine-line, tribal, geometric, traditional, floral, lettering, fantasy, abstract, and many other tattoo styles. Try different prompts and create a tattoo design that matches your vision.
TATTOO TRY-ON
Wondering how a tattoo will look on your body? Choose your photo, select a tattoo design, and preview it directly on your skin. Adjust the placement, size, and position to experiment with different looks before choosing your favorite. Tattoo AI makes it easy to visualize tattoo ideas without commitment.
CUSTOM TATTOO DESIGN
Create tattoos based on your own ideas instead of relying on generic designs.
• Describe your tattoo concept
• Generate personalized tattoo ideas
• Explore different tattoo styles
• Preview tattoos on your body
• Save your favorite designs
• Share ideas with friends or tattoo artists
TATTOO STENCIL
Turn your tattoo artwork or photo into a tattoo stencil. Create clean stencil-style designs that can be saved, shared, or used as a reference when discussing your tattoo with an artist.
PHOTO TO TATTOO STENCIL
Choose a photo, sketch, symbol, or illustration and transform it into tattoo-inspired stencil artwork. Experiment with different images and discover new tattoo design possibilities.
TATTOO FONTS & LETTERING
Create lettering tattoos using different tattoo font styles.
Design tattoos with:
• Names
• Quotes
• Dates
• Initials
• Words
• Short phrases
• Custom lettering
TATTOO PRINTER
Prepare your tattoo artwork for printing. Use the tattoo printer feature to create a physical reference for your tattoo design, stencil, lettering, or other tattoo ideas.
EXPLORE TATTOO IDEAS
Looking for inspiration? Explore tattoo ideas for different styles and body areas, including:
• Arm tattoos
• Forearm tattoos
• Wrist tattoos
• Shoulder tattoos
• Back tattoos
• Chest tattoos
• Leg tattoos
• Hand tattoos
• Neck tattoos
• Small tattoos
Use these ideas as inspiration or create something completely new with Tattoo AI.
WHY USE TATTOO AI?
• Create original tattoos with AI
• Generate personalized tattoo ideas
• Preview tattoos on your photos
• Explore multiple tattoo styles
• Create tattoo stencil artwork
• Convert photos into stencils
• Try tattoo fonts and lettering
• Prepare designs with tattoo printer tools
• Save and share tattoo designs
• Experiment before choosing permanent ink
AI Tattoo Generator – TattooAI gives you everything you need to move from an idea to a finished tattoo concept.
Download AI Tattoo Generator – TattooAI and start creating your next tattoo today.

bluejetty:00086325:ios.description:
Wurdian is a strategic word game where you build words on a classic 15×15 board and compete against friends or players from around the world. If you enjoy crossword-style games like Scrabble or Wordfeud, Wurdian offers deep gameplay, flexible pacing, and competitive tournaments.
Play letters, form high-scoring words, and outsmart your opponents in exciting word battles.
◆ Multiplayer Word Battles
Challenge friends or find new opponents online in competitive word matches.
◆ Standard and duplicate mode
Play the variant that suits you.
◆ Unique Bonus Mode
Earn extra points for creating long words and clever plays.
◆ Integrated Tournaments
Join tournaments with up to 20 players and climb the rankings.
◆ Play at Your Own Pace
Choose turn timers that fit your schedule: 90 seconds, 24 hours, or 48 hours.
◆ 100 Parallel Games
Keep the action going by playing many games at once.
◆ Replay and Analyze Games
Review past matches to improve your strategy.
◆ Track Your Progress
View statistics, milestones, and your gameplay history.
◆ In-Game Word Definitions
Look up definitions instantly while you play.
◆ Custom Boards
Personalize the look of your board with different colors.
◆ Real Opponents Only
Play against real players for a fair and authentic challenge.
◆ Multiple Languages Supported
Play with dictionaries in English, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, French, Danish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Afrikaans, and Frisian.
Challenge your vocabulary, strategy, and creativity in one of the most engaging multiplayer word games available.

bluejetty:00025334:ios.description:
Discover a new way to solve crossword puzzles with Crostic!
Crostic combines crossword clues, word puzzles, cryptograms, and fascinating facts in one relaxing game. Read the clues, guess the words, connect letters with numbers, and reveal hidden quotes, proverbs, facts, and phrases.
SOLVE WORDS AND REVEAL THE MYSTERY
Each level starts with clues and definitions. Find the correct answers and place the letters into matching numbered spaces.
Every solved word reveals new letters across the puzzle. Follow the connections, complete missing answers, and watch the final message appear step by step.
Can you decode the hidden message before solving every clue?
MORE THAN A CLASSIC CROSSWORD
Crostic brings a fresh twist to crossword and word games. Instead of filling a traditional grid, you combine clues, vocabulary, logic, letters, and numbers to uncover the final answer.
Each puzzle introduces a new topic and can reveal a famous quote, interesting fact, proverb, or unexpected phrase.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND
- A unique mix of crossword puzzles and cryptograms
- A wide variety of clues, words, and topics
- Relaxing and challenging levels for every skill level
- Clear clues and helpful hints
- Four daily goals with rewards
- Unique puzzles in the Daily Levels section
- Trophies to collect
- Points and leaderboards to track your progress
- Simple and intuitive gameplay
PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Solve a quick puzzle during a break or enjoy a longer solving session. Complete daily goals, unlock additional topics, collect trophies, and return for new challenges.
Crostic helps you improve your vocabulary, challenge your logic, and discover interesting facts while enjoying the satisfying process of solving each puzzle.
Download Crostic and start decoding your first puzzle today.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
*The price is for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
*Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
*Subscription will be automatically renewed for the same price and duration period, auto-renew can be turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
*Your account will be charged for the subscription fee within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period for the price initially selected.
*Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings.
*Unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a user decides to subscribe.
Privacy Policy: https://severex.io/privacy/
Terms of Use: http://severex.io/terms/

bluejetty:00151710:ios.description:
What’s happening in your neighborhood — right now?
Local Matters shows you what’s actually happening where you live.
Powered by AI, it cuts through the noise and delivers the local news that truly affects your daily life — right outside your door.
INSTANT LOCAL UPDATES
Just enter your ZIP code and you’re in.
No account. No setup. No endless scrolling.
See the updates that matter to your neighborhood — instantly.
SAFETY, WHEN IT MATTERS MOST
Get real-time safety alerts and local incident reports.
From road closures to emergencies, know what’s happening before you step outside.
AI-POWERED SMART FEED
Our AI scans hundreds of local sources so you don’t have to.
Every update is automatically organized into clear, meaningful categories:
 • Safety — critical alerts you shouldn’t miss
 • Urgent — time-sensitive local updates
 • Important — decisions and news that impact your community
 • Informational — events, lifestyle, and everyday local stories
No clutter. Just what matters.
LOCAL WEATHER, RIGHT WHERE YOU NEED IT
Accurate current conditions and forecasts for your exact location — built right into your feed.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE LOCAL MATTERS
 • Works instantly with just your ZIP code
 • No account required — your privacy comes first
 • Clean, ad-light experience
 • Smart categories that save you time
Stop missing what’s happening in your own backyard.
Download Local Matters and stay connected to the place you call home.

bluejetty:00039426:ios.description:
A Food To Save é o app nº1 no combate ao desperdício de alimentos no Brasil. Conectamos você aos melhores restaurantes, padarias, hortifrutis, mercados e docerias da sua cidade para resgatar Sacolas Surpresa cheias de sabor e economia!
Pensou em pedir comida ou fazer compras economizando? Vai de Food To Save!
VANTAGENS E CUPONS EXCLUSIVOS
• 15% OFF na 1ª compra: Ganhe desconto de boas-vindas logo no primeiro pedido.
• Até 70% de Desconto: Refeições e produtos de qualidade por uma fração do preço original.
• Cupons o Mês Todo: Ofertas diárias e promoções exclusivas pra você gastar pouco sempre.
• Entrega ou Retirada: Escolha receber em casa via delivery ou retirar no estabelecimento parceiro perto de você.
O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NO APP?
• Padarias e Confeitarias: Pães artesanais, bolos, doces, pão de queijo e salgados frescos.
• Restaurantes e Marmitas: Pizza, sushi, hambúrguer, comida japonesa, pratos executivos e opções vegetarianas.
• Hortifrúti e Mercado: Frutas, legumes, verduras, itens de mercearia e produtos selecionados.
COMO FUNCIONA A SACOLA SURPRESA?
1 - Explore o Mapa: Encontre padarias, restaurantes e mercados próximos a você.
2 - Escolha sua Sacola: Selecione o tipo de sacola (Doce, Salgada ou Mista) com descontos imperdíveis.
3 - Resgate e Economize: Retire no local ou receba via delivery no horário indicado!
POR QUE FAZER PARTE DO MOVIMENTO?
Mais de 40% dos alimentos produzidos no mundo são descartados. Ao resgatar uma Sacola Surpresa no Food To Save, você evita o desperdício de comida, reduz a emissão de CO2 e ainda economiza no bolso.
Baixe agora o Food To Save, aproveite seus 15% OFF e comece a salvar comida hoje mesmo!

bluejetty:00182643:ios.description:
Think you know pop culture? Prove it!
Welcome to the ultimate trivia game where you guess as many answers as you can on hundreds of fun and challenging topics. From "Pizza Toppings" and "Pixar Movies" to "Oscar-Winning Actors," our lists will test your knowledge and keep you guessing!
Why you'll be hooked:
• ENDLESS TOPICS: Dive into hundreds of curated lists covering movies, music, celebrities, food, and so much more. New topics are added regularly, so the fun never stops!
• CHALLENGE THE WORLD: Jump into exciting multiplayer battles! Compete against random players in real-time or invite your friends for a private trivia showdown.
• CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS: Think you're the best? Rise through the ranks on our global leaderboards and prove you're the ultimate trivia master.
• LEVEL UP & CUSTOMIZE: Earn experience with every correct answer! Level up to unlock exclusive avatars and collect awesome badges to show off on your profile.
• PLAY SOLO: Sharpen your skills at your own pace. The single-player mode is perfect for discovering new topics before you challenge others.
• EARN COINS & REWARDS: The more you play, the more you win! Use coins to get hints when you're stuck or unlock exclusive premium topic packs!
Whether you're a film buff, a music fanatic, or a foodie, there's a topic waiting for you.
Download now, join the community, and start your quest to become a trivia legend!

bluejetty:00119400:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00119400:ios.description:
Download the nBank app and revolutionize the way you bank digitally. Your bank in your pocket.
nBank, an initiative by Nabil Bank. Simply put, nBank is a 100% digital banking platform. Open an account, complete your KYC, pay your bills, deposit your money, and get loans without stepping into a physical Bank branch. Your banking app personalized just for you.
Of course, if you’d like to visit a branch, any one of Nabil Bank’s branches will be more than delighted to serve you with a smile.
So, what exactly does nBank have? Check out a few of our features:
Not just an app, a Superapp
Pay your bills, book flight tickets, calculate your EMI.
Without logging in.
That’s right. You can access a host of services right from the login page. Swipe the bar at the bottom to reveal plenty of things you can do:
• nRemit: Send money from any corner of the world to a Nabil Bank Account
• Mobile Cash: Withdraw funds from a Nabil Bank ATM without using a card
• Get in Touch: Call, Email, Viber, or book an appointment with a Nabil Bank representative
• Topup: Topup your mobile or landline on-the-go
• Bills: Pay your Electricity, Water, Internet, and TV Bills
• Payments: Make government payments, flight bookings, and insurance payments
• Interest Rates: Check out Nabil Bank’s latest Interest Rates for Deposit and Loan Products
• EMI Calculator: Plan your loan amount and tenure with the help of our EMI Calculator
• Exchange Rate: Check out the Bank’s Exchange Rate for the day
…and those are just a few things you can do without logging in.
Interested? There’s more.
Quick Account Opening
Open your bank account within seconds.
You know how opening a bank account can be a long and tiring process? Not anymore. If you’re a Nepalese citizen, you can open an account with us in under 30 seconds. Fill up your basic details and you’re ready to go! Use your app with a few transactional limitations.
And if you want to unlock the full potential of your account, simply complete your KYC – all from the comfort of your home, office, restaurant, you name it.
Digital KYC
Complete your KYC online. No Branch visits required.
Fill up your Know-Your-Customer details in the app, and attend a virtual KYC session to complete your KYC requirements. You will not need to wait in a physical queue anywhere. We promise.
Register with International Number
If you’re residing abroad, you can register for the nBank app using your international number and operate your Bank account. You will receive SMS Alerts, OTP notifications, and even news & alerts from Nabil Bank.
Remittance made simple
Besides sending money within Nepal, customers residing abroad can send money from their international banks directly to a Nabil Bank Account using their Mastercard or Visa Cards by selecting nRemit. All you need to do is fill up a form with the sender and receiver details, along with the amount (in USD) to be sent. The receiver will get the money directly into their Nabil Bank account within seconds.
Save, Spend, and Borrow
You can do it all at the touch of a button.
• View your account statement
• Report a disputed transaction
• Open a Fixed Deposit
• Add your Debit/Credit/Prepaid Cards
• Apply for a Virtual iCard for your online USD payments
• Go cardless with Mobile Cash
• Load your mobile wallets
• Pay your bills
• Scan a QR Code and pay instantly
• Redeem your loyalty points at your favorite restaurant, coffee place, or shop
• Schedule your payments
• Send money to a Bank Account within Nepal
• Add your favorite accounts
• Get instant digital loan
• Get a Loan Against your Fixed Deposit
Simple, Quick, Secure
Log in to your app with your faceID (for iOS 10 & above) or touchID without the hassle of passwords or PINs.
*Disclosure
By downloading the nBank App, you consent to the installation of this app and its future updates and upgrades. You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the app from your device.

bluejetty:00071264:ios.description:
We've reached over 10 million downloads! Thank you ZOOKEEPER fans! 12/14/2020
Featured in App Store for the US, Canada, Brazil, China, Japan, Korea, and many more!
Ranked overall #1 in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and other countries!
“ZOOKEEPER”, the popular action puzzle game played by over 10 million people, is now a Battle Puzzle, and is available for iOS!!!
“ZOOKEEPER” has powered up and become even more fun, with rankings, avatars, item collection, and other new elements!
This game is simple! For those who is familiar with "ZOOKEEPER", and even those who don’t can enjoy the game together!
“How to play”
How do you catch animals?
Slide an animal side by side, and line up three or more animals of the same kind vertically or horizontally to catch them!
The animals caught will count towards ATTACK or DEFENSE points.
How do you battle?
Battle by catching animals for ATTACK and DEFENSE points, 30seconds per round.
When your opponent’s LIFE is completely depleted, you win!
In the event of a draw, battle it out on the next round!!
*When victory hasn’t been decided after 5 rounds, most remaining LIFE wins.
Invite friends
Inviting friends to join the game, not only you'll get x1 power bottle for every friend invited (max 10 friends),
but you will also get the item "Hot Air Balloon" after inviting 10 friends.
"Tips"
Animal panel's arrangement is the same as your opponent!
even falling animal panels are also the same as your opponent.
The one who catch animals more effectively wins.
However, item panels will fall randomly,
therefore, victory just may depend on your luck.
Master active chains!
Just sits back and waiting for animal panels to disappear won’t get you anywhere!
While the panels disappear, try keep catching other animals and make your own chains!
Don’t miss the lucky animal!
One of the animal type are to be selected as Lucky animal, catching it will counts towards both your ATTACK and DEFENSE.
Don’t forget to check them out when starting a new round!
Losing Connection During Battle
When your opponent lost their connection during battle, their ATTACK and DEFENSE scores will be calculated from ATTACK and DEFENSE of their previous game.
At the time of installing this app(including updates), it is assumed that you have understood and agreed to all of our terms of service.
If you do not agree to the terms of this agreement, please refrain from using this service.
https://kiteretsu.jp/terms/

bluejetty:00062218:ios.description:

Will you conquer the world or be the architect of its demise?

Strategic Alliances: Forge alliances with other nations to bolster your defenses and expand your reach. But be wary of betrayals and shifting loyalties.
Realistic Geopolitics: Navigate the complex world of international relations, diplomacy, and espionage. Every decision has far-reaching consequences.
Planet Destruction Simulator: Witness the devastating consequences of nuclear war as cities crumble and civilizations fall. Will you be the harbinger of destruction or the savior of humanity?

bluejetty:00153412:ios.description:
MahjongScapes is a Mahjong Matching Puzzle Game specially designed for seniors.
MahjongScapes blends classic mahjong solitaire game with modern game design, catering specifically to the gaming experience of senior players. The game combines entertainment, brain training, and cultural experiences, making it ideal for all players who enjoy mahjong matching games. An immersive courtyard scene that captures the Zen of living in harmony with nature.
MahjongScapes offers older adults a comfortable visual experience with large fonts and clear tile design, reducing eye strain. The stress-free game mode eliminates timers and score competition, allowing you to enjoy the game at your own pace. With offline play support, you can enjoy the game anytime, anywhere. Multi-device compatibility ensures optimal gaming experience on phones and pads.
Benefits of Playing MahjongScapes
Train the brain: By matching mahjong tiles, you can exercise your memory and logical thinking skills.
Relaxation: The game's soothing pace and stress-free environment help reduce pressure.
Social Interaction: Play with family and friends to enhance social interaction.
How to Play MahjongScapes
‒ The gameplay is simple and fun - match identical mahjong tiles to clear the board.
‒ Multiple difficulty levels adapt to different player skill levels, unlocking new levels and challenges as the game progresses.
‒ Game controls are intuitive and straightforward - simply click or swipe to pair tiles effortlessly.
‒ The game features a relaxed pace with no time pressure so that players can enjoy the game at their own rhythm.
‒ Unlock stunning courtyards and switch styles to enjoy a relaxing Zen atmosphere. 
MahjongScapes Features
Classic Meets Innovation: Combining classic mahjong gameplay with innovative elements.
Easy-to-Read Large Fonts: Featuring large fonts and clear tile designs to reduce eye strain.
Stress-Free Game Mode: No timers or score pressures allow for carefree enjoyment of the game.
Useful Hints and Tools: Provides hints and tools to help players solve challenging puzzles.
Offline Play: Support for offline mode allows gamers to enjoy anytime, anywhere.
Multi-Device Compatibility: Optimized for tablets and smartphones ensuring optimal gameplay.
Customizable Backgrounds: Players can choose different backgrounds according to personal preferences for enhanced visual experience.
Creative Tile Designs: Offers unique tile designs for a fresh gaming experience.
Soothing Relaxing Music: Background music creates a tranquil gaming environment promoting relaxation.
Zen Courtyard: Explore various backgrounds for meditation and relaxation, easing stress and anxiety.
MahjongScapes creates a peaceful gaming environment that helps relax the mind - an ideal choice for leisurely relaxation among senior players. Download MahjongScapes now to begin your journey of wisdom through personalized gaming fun!

bluejetty:00100979:android.description:
Water Sort Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic game where your goal is to sort colored water into tubes so that each tube contains only one color.
Tap a tube to pick it up, then tap another tube to pour. You can pour water only if the target tube has enough space and is empty or has the same color on top. Plan your moves carefully and use empty tubes to solve more complex puzzles.
The game starts easy but quickly becomes more challenging, testing your logic, focus, and problem-solving skills.
Features
• Clean and smooth water animations
• Many levels with increasing difficulty
• Undo and restart options
• Minimalistic and calming design
• Play offline anytime
• Music and sound settings
If you enjoy satisfying puzzle games that help you relax and think, Water Sort Puzzle is the perfect choice. Download now and start sorting!

bluejetty:00131571:ios.description:
365Scores is a customizable live sports scores app that lets fans build a personal feed around the teams, leagues, and matches they care about - with instant alerts, in-depth stats, and highlights along the way. Covers the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, UEFA Champions League, Premier League, and 2,000+ competitions across 9 sports.
Join over 150 million sports fans who rely on 365Scores to follow the game their way.
* 365SCORES HELPS YOU FOLLOW SEVERAL GAMES AT ONCE
Build a personalized My Scores list with the exact teams, leagues, and games you want, and get real-time updates for all of them at once. Remove anything you don't need, so your feed stays focused - not cluttered.
* SET ALERTS YOUR WAY
Choose exactly what triggers a notification - goals, touchdowns, red cards, VAR reviews, lineup announcements, and more - down to the specific game event.
* LIGHTNING-FAST GAME ALERTS
Stay updated with instant game alerts the moment something happens. Warning! Our live notifications may be faster than your game stream.
* LIVE MATCH TRACKER
Watch the match unfold like you're right there - see who's attacking, corners, fouls, and live stats update in real time on our visual Live Match Tracker, even when you can't watch the game itself.
* PROBABLE & CONFIRMED LINEUPS
See probable lineups ahead of kickoff, then get the confirmed starting XI, substitutes, and formations as soon as they're announced - know who's playing before the match begins.
* IN-DEPTH MATCH STATS
Go beyond the score with Heatmaps, xG (expected goals), and Head-to-Head history. Track top stats like shots, possession, and big chances created, plus detailed breakdowns of passes, defense, duels, and discipline (fouls and cards).
* PRE-GAME STATS
Get a competitive edge with comprehensive pre-game stats, including each team's last-game results (goals, xG, shots, and more), head-to-head records, and recent form to help you prepare for every game.
* TEAM NEWS & STATS
No matter which team you support, 365Scores delivers live scores, sports news, roster updates, real-time stats, standings, transfer updates, and social media buzz.
* HIGHLIGHTS FOR TOP LEAGUES
Catch up on highlights and key game moments for major leagues and tournaments, right after the final whistle.
* FOLLOW BIGGEST LEAGUES AND COMPETITIONS WITH 365SCORES
Track the MLS, English Premier League, LaLiga, Champions League, NBA, NFL, MLB, Wimbledon, and 2,000+ competitions across 10 sports, including football, basketball, and tennis - all in one live scores app.
• Soccer – Premier League, UEFA Champions League, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, MLS
• Football – NFL, NCAA
• Basketball – NBA, EuroLeague
• Baseball – MLB
• Ice Hockey – NHL
• Tennis – ATP Tour, WTA Tour, Grand Slams (Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, US Open)
• Handball, Rugby, Volleyball, and more - 2,000+ competitions across 9 sports in total.
* LIVE SOCCER RESULTS
Get all the latest soccer news and updates, right at your fingertips! Follow your favorite teams - from global giants like Real Madrid, Manchester City, and Liverpool to top MLS clubs like Inter Miami and LAFC.
* NBA & NHL COVERAGE
Track your favorite basketball and hockey teams - from the Lakers, Celtics, and Warriors to the Rangers, Bruins, and Maple Leafs - with live scores, standings, and real-time stats all season long.
* EXCLUSIVE iOS FEATURES
Home Screen Widget – view your personalized My Scores list, live and upcoming, right on your home screen.
* LIVE ACTIVITIES ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
See real-time scores, shots on goal, xG, and possession for both teams directly on your lock screen - even when your phone is locked.

bluejetty:00027602:ios.description:
Evo Puzzle is hundreds of levels of logic puzzles, riddles and brain teasers across 20 different kinds of puzzle. You start as a molecule and evolve, rank by rank, all the way up to a human.

Short levels for a coffee break, a queue or a commute. Logic, attention, memory and lateral thinking all get a turn.
20 KINDS OF PUZZLE IN ONE APP
Unblock the cars, connect the pipes, bounce lasers off mirrors, untangle the wires, solve equations, place the dominoes, fill the nonogram.
26 RANKS, FROM MOLECULE TO HUMAN
Every puzzle you solve earns evolution points and moves you up the chain: jellyfish, bee, fox, lion, owl… and finally human.
PLAY ANYWHERE
No internet needed, no timer. Dark mode is easier on the eyes in the evening and at night.
Download Evo Puzzle and see how far up the chain you get.
