bluejetty:00172877:ios.description:
The aviation app pilots have trusted since 1998 — now rebuilt for modern iOS.
Pilots Atlas puts 85,000 airports, 180,000 waypoints and 28,000 points of
interest in your pocket, fully offline. Plan flights, read NOTAMs, track
aircraft live and decode weather without relying on connectivity.
FREE TO DOWNLOAD. FREE FOREVER.
Start with a 7-day Premium trial. When it ends, keep the core features at no
cost — no subscription required.
— FREE FEATURES (Always Available) —
NOTAMs — FREE FOR EVERYONE
• Worldwide NOTAMs from the FAA NOTAM Management Service
• A tab on every airport: decoded, grouped, plus everything within 25 nm
• Drawn on the map where they apply, with a filter switch per category
• Plan for a departure time — see this morning what closes tonight
• A briefing for a whole route, cached against signal loss
LIVE AIRCRAFT TRACKING — FREE FOR EVERYONE
• Real-time ADS-B traffic worldwide, at no cost
• Multiple community networks with automatic failover, so coverage stays up
• Connect your own receiver: SBS1 (dump1090), Stratux, GDL90 or FLARM
• Flight path history, configurable zoom and labels
SUN, MOON AND NIGHT — FREE FOR EVERYONE
• Night by rulebook, not astronomy: ICAO/EASA, FAA 91.209, FAA 61.57(b), UK ANO
• Sunrise and sunset for any place, in its own time zone, offline
• Whether the sun will sit on final at each runway end — now or at your ETA
• Moonlight tonight, with a verdict for night VFR
AI COPILOT
• Ask for weather, NOTAMs, airspace, airports and routes in plain language
• Brief a saved trip at its own cruise altitude, or ask "what's near me"
• It reads the map with you and flies you straight to any result
ON YOUR WRIST AND HOME SCREEN
• Apple Watch app: weather, GPS tracking, flight timers, haptics, voice notes
• Widgets and Live Activities on Home Screen, Lock Screen and watch face
THE BASICS
• 11,000 navaids, and search by ICAO or IATA code
• Configurable units (NM/KM/MI) and a dark mode built for the cockpit
— PREMIUM FEATURES —
WEATHER AT A GLANCE
• METAR/TAF with VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR colour coding
• The forecast for the time you actually arrive, from the TAF period covering it
• Custom weather lists, decoders for METAR, TAF and SNOWTAM, holdover tables
FLIGHT PLANNING & NAVIGATION
• Multi-waypoint trip planning with colour-coded routes
• Worldwide winds aloft — courses, ground speeds, times and fuel, corrected
• A terrain and airspace profile of your route, with the real ground beneath
• Distance rulers, range circles, proximity alerts, GPS track recording
• Paste filed routes with airways and NAT tracks; GPX import/export, sync
AIRSPACE
• Worldwide airspace: class, vertical limits and a readable weekly schedule
• Tap anywhere and every airspace above that point is offered, likeliest first
• A full-screen vertical cross-section you can pan, zoom and filter
• FIR overlays, Special Use Airspace, and full airport details
ANNOTATE YOUR WORLD
• Markers, notes and photos anywhere on the map, plus favourites
• Offline-first — every annotation works with no signal
— OFFLINE MAPS —
• Aviation day and night, streets, terrain and satellite base maps
• The open flightmaps VFR chart, and topographical maps with contours
• Download whole regions for use with no signal
— CAPTAIN'S CORNER (Free) —
• Unit converters, climb gradient and jet fuel calculators
• Aircraft country codes, ICAO prefixes, dangerous goods, VOLMET, ACARS
• Operating minima, Morse, 5,000+ aviation abbreviations
— SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS —
• 7-day free trial — full Premium access
• Monthly or yearly subscriptions
• One-time lifetime purchase available
Payment charged to Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless
canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage them in Account
Settings. The free trial converts to a paid subscription unless canceled.
Continuous GPS use in background may decrease battery life.
Privacy Policy: https://www.absolutezero.de/datenschutz/
Terms of Use: https://www.absolutezero.de/agb/

bluejetty:00016114:ios.description:
Every day while you're gone, an epic battle of swords, guns, and armor rages on your counters, on your floors, and in your yard... Enter the world of the Bug Heroes! 
From the creators of Block Fortress and Heroes & Castles comes a new adventure, blending fast paced action, strategy, and defensive gameplay! 
Master 25 unique heroes - from a hook wielding Waterbug pirate, to an old and wise Aphid sensei, a champion Bumblebee boxer, a grenade launching Worm, a poison obsessed Stinkbug, and tons more! Choose and customize your squad of two, then seamlessly switch between them while unleashing a variety of powerful abilities on your enemies. Scavenge for food and junk, fortify your base, build turrets, level up your heroes, equip weapons and armor, and survive! Or, put your skills to the test in up to 2v2 competitive multiplayer battles! 
---------------------------- 
FEATURES 
• MOBA-like competitive & cooperative multiplayer 
• Tons of single player content, including missions, an endless mode, and a base vs base skirmish mode 
• 25 unique heroes to master - form your team of two 
• Innovative squad based gameplay - control two heroes simultaneously 
• Level up your Bug Heroes, increase their skills, and buy weapons, armor, and gear 
• Scavenge for food, then defend your Food Stash with turrets and upgrades 
• Complete missions, earn stars, and unlock a host of powerful upgrades 
• Master both melee and ranged combat. Slice your enemies with swords, swat bugs off of ledges, blast them from long range with guns and magic, and more 
• Tactical gameplay - use cover to defeat your enemies 
• Over 75 varied enemy types to battle 
---------------------------- 
Questions or comments? Follow us on Twitter @FoursakenMedia, or like us on Facebook!

bluejetty:00133585:ios.description:
Plan your day. Improve your routine. Stress less.
This app is your visual daily planner to help you manage everyday life and improve your wellbeing. We offer a customizable, playful and highly visual way of planning your daily life and achieving your goals. 
You can fetch your plans from your existing calendars integrated, find unique inspiration in our library icons and colours to make it fun and personal, learn better time management skills with our focus timer, and get ongoing reminders and small celebrations designed for a feeling of success and motivation.
Use it at home, in school and at work to support you in doing the things you need to do.
This app is designed to be inclusive and helpful across neurodiversity, including for Autistic people and/or those with ADHD, and support executive function challenges like planning, organization, time management, and focus. 
Our features specifically support these areas.
Download Tiimo today and start living a better life, one small task at a time.
Key Features:
* A visual timeline supports time management and focus.
* Add your routines, events or to-do list.
* Schedule daily weekly monthly or yearly
* Add notification just before or 5 min before event start
* Monitor your performance graphically
* Visual checklists help you keep track of each point on your list not only by text but also by using colours, emojis or icons.
* Ongoing reminders (notifications, vibrations and sound) halfway through and at the end of activities increase motivation and help with transitions.
* Pre-made routines, designed with common activities, that make scheduling faster.
* Choose your own icon and color for each reminders.
* Widget on your home screen supports your focus even without opening the app.

bluejetty:00078834:ios.description:
Have fun, train your brain, and get ready to put your logic skills to the test with the popular Sudoku free puzzle game, now available on App Store! Also known as Number Place, this engaging game is loved by millions and is the most popular combinational number-placement brain puzzle in the world. Sudoku Free Puzzle Game has 5000+ challenging Sudoku puzzles everyday to help you keep your brain active, unwind from stress or relax. Download and start the Daily Challenge now!
To play, simply fill the 9×9 grid with digits so that each column, row, and each of the nine 3×3 sub-grids contains all of the digits from 1 to 9. With four perfectly balanced difficulty levels to choose from, you can challenge yourself at any skill level.
Complete daily challenges and collect trophies to show off your achievements. Turn on/off Notes (Pencil) mode as you like, highlight duplicates to avoid identical numbers in a row, column, and subgrid, and receive intelligent hints whenever you get stuck.
Choose from two input modes: Cell first or Digit first, and enjoy super smooth interfaces like on paper/newspaper. The unlimited undo and eraser features will help you get rid of mistakes, and highlighting of a row, column, and subgrid related to the selected cell will help you discover patterns quickly.
The app also automatically saves your game when you get a phone call, switch applications, or lock the phone so you don't lose progress.
Sudoku Features:
- 4 perfectly balanced difficulty levels
- Complete Daily Challenges to collect trophies
- Turn on/off Notes (Pencil) mode as you like
- Highlight Duplicates to avoid identical numbers in a row, column and subgrid
- Intelligent Hints can guide you through the numbers whenever you get stuck
- 2 Input modes: Cell first or Digit first
- Super smooth interfaces like on paper/newspaper
- Unlimited Undo and Eraser to help you get rid of mistakes
- Highlighting of a row, column and subgrid related to the selected cell to help you discover patterns
- Killer Sudoku, Mini Sudoku and more to come
- Automatically saves your game when you get a phone call, switch applications, or lock the phone
If you're a fan of Sudoku, this is the app for you!

bluejetty:00183312:ios.description:
Track net carbs, plan keto meals and manage intermittent fasting in one app. KetoDiet helps you hit your macros with personalized meal plans, smart meal suggestions and over 2,000 tested low-carb recipes.
Whether you're starting the keto diet or fine-tuning your low-carb lifestyle, KetoDiet brings carb counting, meal planning, fasting and progress tracking together in one place.
== WHY KETODIET? ==
• Keto macro calculator and carb counter: track net carbs, protein, fat and calories
• Auto Fill: discover meals and snacks that fit your remaining daily macros
• Unlimited personalized keto meal plans that respect your preferences and allergies
• Intermittent fasting tracker with estimated milestones and reminders
• Over 2,000 tried and tested keto recipes with full nutrition facts
• Track weight, body measurements, ketones and other health metrics
• Apple Health integration and data backup across iPhone and iPad
== KEY FEATURES ==
SMART MEAL SUGGESTIONS WITH AUTO FILL
Not sure what to eat next? Auto Fill suggests meals and snacks that fit your remaining macros, dietary preferences and allergies. Choose from several options to complete your day.
KETO MEAL PLANNER
Create unlimited weekly meal plans with the meal plan wizard. Build plans around your macros and preferences, copy previously planned days, and follow your meal plan directly from Today.
INTERMITTENT FASTING TRACKER
Track popular fasting schedules, including 16:8, 18:6, OMAD and multi-day fasts. View estimated fasting milestones tailored to your age and gender, with reminders when your fast starts, reaches milestones and ends.
CARB COUNTER & FOOD DIARY
• Log foods, meals and recipes in seconds
• Scan barcodes to track packaged foods
• Create custom foods and meals
• Find restaurant meals and quick keto snacks
• Track daily net carbs, macros and calories
KETO RECIPES & SHOPPING LISTS
• Tried and tested low-carb and keto recipes
• Full nutrition facts and allergy information
• Step-by-step instructions with photos
• Adjust recipes to suit your needs
• Shopping lists with grouped ingredients
• Recipe collections for every meal and occasion
KETO MACRO CALCULATOR
Calculate personalized targets for net carbs, protein, fat and calories. Adjust your goals, choose a higher-protein approach and explore projected weight changes based on your targets.
PROGRESS & HEALTH TRACKING
• Weight, body fat and body measurements
• Progress photos and before-and-after comparisons
• Ketones, blood glucose and lipids
• Macros, electrolytes and water
• Activity, mood and energy
• Apple Health integration
KETO GUIDES & COMMUNITY
Explore expert guides on keto, ketosis and healthy low-carb eating, with new articles added regularly. Join our private Facebook support group for advice, motivation and shared experiences.
== DESIGNED AROUND YOUR DAY ==
A redesigned experience brings your food diary, meal plans, fasting and progress together.
• Five simple tabs: Today, Plan, Add, Food and Progress
• Daily macro targets, meal suggestions and fasting in one place
• Recipe collections including Fits Today, Comfort Food and Big Meals
• Full measurement history and easy progress tracking
• Quick setup to calculate your personalized keto macros
Supports metric, imperial and US units. Available on iPhone and iPad.
TERMS OF USE
In the app under Settings > About > Terms of use, or at:
https://ketodietapp.com/keto-diet-app-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00014512:ios.description:
Notion is an AI-powered all-in-one workspace that helps individuals and teams write notes, manage tasks, organize projects, and collaborate in one place. Whether you’re tracking personal to-do lists, writing and organizing class notes, or managing projects with a team, Notion helps users plan work, stay organized, and achieve goals.
"AI's everything app" — Forbes
Notion is a productivity app where you can write, plan, and organize your notes, projects, tasks and more. Ask Notion AI about project updates, upcoming tasks, and suggestions for a more streamlined workflow.
Simplify writing notes, project and task management, and collaboration. Whether for personal, student or professional use, Notion scales to meet your individual needs with customization tools for everyone.
NEW features:
• AI Meeting Notes: Perfect meeting memory. Your notetaker catches every detail and delivers actionable summaries, right where you work.
• Maps View: Turn databases into interactive maps. Use the new Place property to pin restaurants, trips, offices, clients, and more.
FREE FOR PERSONAL USE
Individuals manage day-to-day tasks, notes, and personal organization.
• Create as many notes, docs, and content as you want.
• Use one of thousands of templates to get started.
FREE TO TRY WITH YOUR TEAM
Teams run on Notion every day, from next-generation startups to established enterprises.
• Import Google Docs, PDFs, and other content types easily to get started
• Write and organize meeting notes, or transcribe with AI.
• Collaboration and team work at your fingertips, in one connected workspace.
• Connect tools like Figma, Slack, and GitHub to Notion.
FREE FOR STUDENTS
Students organize notes, assignments, and study plans in one place.
• Your study planner, class notes, to do lists and more, your way. Loved by millions of students worldwide.
• Get organized for your best school year yet with beautiful, customizable templates created by students, for students.
NOTES & DOCS
Communication is made efficient with Notion's flexible building blocks.
• Create docs with beautiful templates, images, to-dos, and 50+ more content types.
• Meeting notes, projects, design systems, pitch decks, and more.
• Find exactly what you need using Search with powerful filters to find content across your workspace.
TASKS & PROJECTS
Catch all details big and small in any workflow.
• Workflow manager: Create your own priority labels, status tags, and automations to choose the exact info you want to track.
• Capture every detail in a table. Break projects into manageable tasks to get the work done.
AI
One tool that does it all - search, generate, analyze, and chat - right inside Notion.
• Create notes. Transcribe meeting notes with AI.
• Turn databases into interactive maps. Use the new Place property to pin restaurants, trips, offices, clients, and more.
• Write better. Use Notion AI to help write and brainstorm.
• Get answers. Ask Notion AI questions about all your content and get answers in seconds.
• Autofill tables. Notion AI turns overwhelming data into clear, actionable information — automatically.
SYNCS WITH BROWSER, MAC, AND WINDOWS APPS.
• Pick up on mobile where you left off on desktop.
MORE PRODUCTIVITY. FEWER TOOLS.
• Track to-dos, write notes, create docs, and manage projects in one connected workspace.
THINK IT. MAKE IT.

bluejetty:00140036:ios.name: Idle Bao's Prison: Idle Tycoon
bluejetty:00140036:ios.summary: In this game, you will play as Master Bao, assuming the dual roles of a wise judge and a meticulous prison warden. The game integrates wisdom and challenge, allowing you to showcase Master Bao's dignity in the world of ancient-style 3D, unr
bluejetty:00140036:ios.description:
In this game, you will play as Master Bao, assuming the dual roles of a wise judge and a meticulous prison warden. The game integrates wisdom and challenge, allowing you to showcase Master Bao's dignity in the world of ancient-style 3D, unraveling the mysteries of Master Bao's cases while managing hyper-realistic prison scenarios.
As Master Bao, you must discern every clue in each case, unveiling hidden truths. By delivering correct judgments, you will earn vast prestige and gain recognition from the court, swiftly rising through the ranks to become a prominent official.
In the aspect of prison management, you will construct and oversee the prison facilities. You can upgrade cell blocks, bathhouses, labor yards, and dining halls to provide a decent living environment, as well as improve kitchens, laundry rooms, storage areas, and guard quarters to enhance the working conditions of officials.
During the process of managing inmates, you will employ a variety of punishment tools to discipline them and facilitate successful rehabilitation. Additionally, you must address incidents of inmate violence swiftly, maintaining order and safety within the prison walls.
Through delivering judgments and governing the prison, you will accumulate substantial prestige, gain favor from the court, and gradually ascend to higher official positions.
The game features 3D ancient-styled graphics with rich animations and dynamic day-night cycles, presenting a realistic and challenging ancient world. Here, embodying the role of Master Bao, you will balance wisdom and strategy, exploring truths and managing prisons, experiencing the charm of the past and present intertwining seamlessly!
- Judging Gameplay: Discern every clue in each case, seeking hidden truths! Earn vast prestige through judgments, gaining recognition from the court and swiftly advancing in rank!
- Simulation Management Gameplay: Construct prisons, manage inmates. Upgrade cell blocks, bathhouses, labor yards, and dining halls to provide a normal living environment; upgrade kitchens, laundry rooms, storage areas, and guard quarters to improve the working environment of officials.
- Disciplining Inmates: Utilize various punishment tools to discipline inmates and facilitate successful rehabilitation!
- Suppressing Riots: Manage incidents of inmate violence, swiftly quelling riots when they occur!
- Promotion: Through judgments and prison governance, earn substantial prestige, gain favor from the court, and rise in official rank!
- Graphics: 3D ancient-styled graphics; rich animations; dynamic day-night cycles.

Step into a universe where dots of all shapes and sizes collide to create explosive puzzles! In this ad-free, addictive match-3 game, you combine colorful dots and trigger powerful effects using Liners, Pulsers, Blasters, Shurikens, and many more.

• 100% ad-free experience
From the creator of puzzle hits like Dotello, Jewel Galaxy, Rings, and Perspecto, Dotsu is a deeply satisfying and endlessly engaging puzzle game you'll keep coming back to.
Download now and dive into the world of dots!

* Consulta alertas de tormentas, calor, granizo e inundaciones

bluejetty:00066097:ios.description:
Slide and paint your way through a world of line color in Line Color 3D, the exciting color adventure game. With just a tap and hold, make your cube runner glide along the path, watching it masterfully draw the color line. This isn't just a game; it's a vibrant color 3D journey!
Seeking a peaceful escape after a long day? Line Color 3D is your go-to stress buster. This line color game is an ideal way to relax and let go. Download this color adventure and immerse yourself in a world where the only task is to color lines and enjoy the tranquility.
Here’s why you’ll adore Line Color 3D:
– A plethora of challenging levels to navigate through line color puzzles
– Simple, intuitive controls for an effortless cube runner experience
– Various cool cube skins to personalize your color 3D adventure
– The perfect way to draw away stress and bask in relaxation
– Crisp and minimalistic 3D graphics, enhancing your color line journey
But there's a catch – Line Color 3D is irresistibly addictive! You’ll be hooked on coloring lines, eager to paint your way through each level. It allows you to draw a trail of color in numerous fun stages.
So, are you ready to test your reflexes and paint the path with your cube in this color adventure? Download this cube runner game and dive into your new line color quests! Good luck on your travels, filled with lines to color and paths to draw in the wonderful world of Line Color 3D!
For our privacy policy visit: https://azurgames.com/privacy-policy/

For drivers, the app lets you view scores, receive rewards for safe driving, review your trip logs, punch in and out of shifts and more.
For Fleet and Safety managers, this same app lets you view the status of your fleet, keep an eye on driving behavior and send rewards to drivers.
• Track safety scores. Drivers can keep tabs on their safety scores, see how they stack up against one another, and coach themselves into becoming safer, more efficient drivers. Supervisors can view the same scores and leaderboard to see how well drivers perform behind the wheel and what driving behaviors need work, from a laptop, mobile phone, or tablet.
• Reward safe, smart driving. Reward drivers for a job well done behind the wheel. With a tap, managers can send rewards—and drivers receive them—using FleetMobile. Rewards can also be sent via Azuga Fleet.
• ID Drivers. Using Bluetooth, pair phone with the GPS Tracking device to identify who is actually driving the vehicle.
• Receive alerts and notifications. Set up alerts and receive automatic notifications when safety issues, such as speeding or hard braking, are detected.
• Log and tag trips. When a driver uses FleetMobile, data is captured from every vehicle he or she drives, creating a comprehensive trip log. Tag trips as business or personal and capture details, including starting point, destination, stops, locations, distance, speed, and idle time.
• Increase efficiency. Leverage a range of built-in utilities, such as vehicle health monitoring, navigation, tracking, parked vehicle location, and third-party apps.
Here is how it works:
• The Azuga GPS fleet tracking device plugs directly into the vehicle’s on-board computer and captures data on how safely and efficiently your employees drive.
• What is the Driver Score? Azuga takes the data and creates a driver score and ranking based on each individual driver’s behavior behind the wheel. Scores are calculated on a scale of 0 - 100 for the previous day’s trips considering the following unsafe driving events: 
 ◦ Speeding
 ◦ Idling
 ◦ Hard Braking
 ◦ Sudden Acceleration
 ◦ Cornering
 ◦ Distracted Driving
 ◦ Seat belt usage
 ◦ Note: Not all events are considered for score calculations. It is the discretion of your supervisor to choose the events included in the scores calculated for your fleet or company. 
• How is the Azuga Driver Score calculated? Combined with the unsafe driving events, the Azuga Driver Score is calculated based on the following parameters: 
 ◦ Magnitude of events: For example, a hard brake is a change in speed of 8-12 MPH in ONE second.
 ◦ Duration: For example, the number of seconds driving above the speed limit threshold. 
 ◦ Spatio-temporal index: Helps give a perspective on when the event occurred and how well the driver behaved when conditions were adverse. For example, speed during snow conditions.
• The Driver Score screen displays a driver’s performance and driving behavior. The first section has the driver’s overall safety score followed by the scores for the unsafe driving events. 
Please Note: You must be a Azuga Fleet customer to use this app. Every Azuga Fleet GPS tracking subscription includes FleetMobile. Not a Azuga customer? Call us to find out more. US: 1-888-777-9718. Or reach out to our sales team at info@azuga.com.

bluejetty:00163843:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00163843:ios.description:
Welcome to My Hotel Simulator 3D! Build and Manage Your Dream Hotel
In My Hotel Simulator 3D, your journey starts with a small hotel that you can customize and expand into a five-star resort. Each room is yours to design and furnish, offering a wide variety of furniture, decor, and layout options to create the perfect space for your guests. Keep the rooms clean and inviting, ensuring every guest has a comfortable stay.
But managing a hotel isn’t just about rooms. You’ll also oversee the day-to-day operations, including checking guests in, maintaining the facilities, and ensuring all amenities are running smoothly. Your success depends on your ability to provide excellent customer service and make smart business decisions.
Furnish and Decorate Rooms
Design each room to meet the needs of your guests. Choose from a variety of beds, wardrobes, seating options, and decorations to create cozy and luxurious spaces. Match the decor to your hotel’s theme, whether it’s modern chic, classic elegance, or a tropical paradise. Happy guests will leave great reviews, helping you attract more visitors and grow your reputation.
Run a Mini Shop for Guests
Expand your hotel’s services with a charming mini shop, where guests can purchase snacks, toiletries, and souvenirs. Stock your shop with popular items, set competitive prices, and watch as guests enjoy the convenience of on-site shopping. Managing the mini shop adds an extra layer of strategy, as you balance inventory, pricing, and customer satisfaction.
Keep Everything Spotless
Cleanliness is key to a successful hotel. Regularly tidy up rooms, restock supplies, and ensure the common areas are spotless. A clean hotel not only keeps guests happy but also boosts your ratings, making your hotel the top choice for travelers.
Expand and Upgrade Your Hotel
As your hotel grows in popularity, reinvest your earnings to unlock new features and expand your property. Add more rooms, upgrade existing facilities. Each upgrade enhances your guests' experience and increases your revenue.
Customize Your Hotel’s Style
Create a unique atmosphere that sets your hotel apart. Decorate the lobby with stylish furniture, install eye-catching lighting, and add beautiful plants or artwork. Customize the exterior with vibrant colors, elegant signage, and landscaping to make a great first impression on your guests.
Features:
 Manage Your Hotel: Oversee all aspects of hotel management, from room design to guest services.
 Furnish and Decorate: Create stylish rooms and customize the entire hotel to reflect your vision.
 Operate a Mini Shop: Stock and manage a shop for guests to enhance their stay and boost your income.
 Expand and Upgrade: Add new rooms, amenities, and features to grow your hotel and attract more guests.
 Clean and Maintain: Ensure every corner of your hotel is spotless to impress your guests.
 3D Graphics: Enjoy stunning visuals that bring your hotel and its surroundings to life.
Why You’ll Love My Hotel Simulator 3D
If you’ve ever dreamed of running your own hotel or have a passion for management games, My Hotel Simulator 3D is the perfect game for you. This immersive experience combines creativity and strategy, allowing you to design, manage, and grow a thriving hotel business.
With detailed 3D graphics, dynamic gameplay, and endless customization options, My Hotel Simulator 3D offers hours of engaging entertainment. Whether you’re furnishing rooms, managing staff, or running the mini shop, every moment is filled with challenges and rewards.

bluejetty:00081015:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00081015:ios.description:
Curio - Antique Expert In Your Pocket
Curio is the antique identifier app that tells you what your old things are, where they came from, and what they're worth. Snap a photo of any antique, vintage item, or collectible and get an answer in seconds. Whether you're going through a parent's house, hunting at thrift stores and estate sales, running a resale business, or just curious about the treasures on your shelves, Curio turns "I have no idea what this is" into a clear answer.
KEY FEATURES:
Instant Antique Identification
Just take a picture. Curio's identification engine tells you what the item is, who made it, where it's from, and roughly when it was made. Furniture, paintings, pottery, porcelain and china, glassware, clocks, rugs, coins, currency, books, jewelry, and much more. Not sure about that vase from Grandma's cabinet? Snap a photo and find out.
Estimated Value & Quick Appraisal
Find out what your antique is worth. Curio gives you an estimated price range based on what similar pieces are on the market for, so you know what to ask if you're selling and what to pay if you're buying. Never overpay at an antique store again, and never let a valuable piece go for a dollar at a yard sale.
The History Behind Every Piece
Curio doesn't just name your item. It tells you its story: the maker, the era, the style, and why it matters. For many of our users the history is their favorite part, even when they have no plans to sell.
Visual Matches
See similar items on the market from across the web, with photos, so you can compare your piece with your own eyes and check the estimate for yourself. Tap any match to open it right inside the app.
Add Details for Better Results
Spotted a maker's mark on the bottom, a signature, or a pattern name? Add it in a tap. Curio updates the description and the estimated value using your extra details, so results get sharper the more you know.
Catalog Your Collection
Every item you identify is saved to your personal collection. Organize your pieces into collections, revisit their stories anytime, and export them as a PDF to share with family or keep for your records. Many people use Curio to build a home inventory, or to document heirlooms so their kids know what's worth keeping. Sign in to back up and sync across all your devices.
Built for Real Life
* Clearing out an estate or downsizing? Decide what to keep, sell, or donate without weeks of research.
* Thrifting or at an estate sale? Check a find on the spot before you buy.
* Reseller, dealer, or auctioneer? Price your inventory in seconds and write listings faster.
* Collector? Finally learn what you really own.
Curio is fast, simple, and beginner friendly. Download it free and try your first scans, then upgrade for unlimited identifications.
Download Curio today and find out what your treasures are really worth. Snap, identify, and discover the story behind every piece.
Find out more about Curio at https://www.curio.app
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://www.curio.app/privacy

bluejetty:00014327:ios.description:
Get easy, convenient access to your accounts wherever you go with Iowa Falls State Bank's Mobile Banking App. 
IFSB Mobile is a mobile banking solution that enables existing online banking customers to use their mobile device to initiate transactions anytime, from anywhere. 
Customers can view account balances, view transaction history, transfer funds between accounts and pay bills.
If you are not currently an Iowa Falls State Bank online banking customer, you will need to enroll before you can start using IFSB Mobile.
If you already have an online banking account, you will need to activate your mobile banking access while logged into your online banking account. Then, download the IFSB Mobile Phone app and in no time you'll be banking from your phone.
The IFSB Mobile Banking service is a *FREE service.
*There is no fee from the Iowa Falls State Bank. Connectivity and usage rates may apply. Contact your wireless provider for more details.
If you have any questions contact us at (641) 648-5171

bluejetty:00159529:ios.description:
Do you have a loved one incarcerated in the US? Lift their spirits by sharing a piece of your life with them through photos and letters.
Why you’ll love it
• Sending photos and letters is free for anyone who needs it
• Save time and money – we'll print & mail it for you
• Our printing is high quality and something your loved one will cherish
What is Ameelio?
Ameelio is a nonprofit, and we believe that staying connected with your loved one shouldn’t be a financial burden. We want to make it easy for people to stay connected through a challenging time in their life.
We are committed to providing affordable communications for all families—anyone who needs it can always send free mail. Those who wish to support free mail for others can contribute by purchasing special gifts for their loved one. All of the money from these purchases goes directly toward supporting our free offerings.
What users are saying about Ameelio
“This is the most amazing blessing I could have received.” —Shari
“It has been awesome. My LO was excited to get some extra lovin from his letter.” —Telle
“It is a blessing to loved ones to be able to communicate with our family especially during these times.” —Trish
Send any feedback to support@ameelio.org.

bluejetty:00058348:android.description:
Digi Telecommunications Sdn. Bhd. Malaysia has launched the new MyDigi phone plan app, which provides Digi users with a streamlined, all-in-one experience. For prepaid and postpaid users, MyDigi phone plan app is a smarter way to manage your Digi mobile account. By using the quick link buttons, you can pay your mobile bills, check and monitor your internet usage, buy & top up Internet packages, and claim exclusive rewards and deals on food, drinks, and more in Malaysia.
Check and Pay Your Mobile Bills and Top-Up Credit in Malaysia
Experience hassle-free bill payment with the MyDigi telco mobile app. No need to visit the Digi store: pay your bills with only a few taps from anywhere you are in Malaysia!
You can also download past and current phone plan billing statements to monitor and keep track of your mobile bills. 
Do you have a shortage of prepaid credits? Is your prepaid plan about to expire? To keep in touch with your loved ones, simply topup & reload your phone credit with the MyDigi app. Depending on the quantity of online prepaid reload you choose, you'll get more data, call time, and credits. With MyDigi, you can save both time and money.
Check and Monitor Mobile Data Usage & Switch Internet Plan
Monitor your mobile data usage, located under the “Internet” section, as displayed on the homescreen. The data quota and data usage are displayed side by side to give you a clear picture of how much data you consume and how much you need. 
Digi users can also view how many days remain till their data quota expires out or is renewed for the next use cycle. 
If you wish to check your other numbers' mobile data usage, go to the side menu, choose your phone number, and the usage information for that number will be displayed. 
When your current Internet plan package expires, you can switch to a new one using the app!
Data Top Up and International Roaming Passes 
Is your mobile data plan insufficient? You can topup and buy data add ons that are suitable for your usage and budget. 
The data add ons range from basic Internet access to more intensive entertainment (games, music, and videos), as well as larger data purchase options for general use. 
The 'Buy Add-Ons' tab on the homescreen or the 'Box of Surprise' page in the app can be used to purchase add ons.

bluejetty:00096547:ios.summary: Welcome to the crazy, chaotic world of Obby: Rob All Game – the funniest, most unpredictable mobile adventure where you rob everything, outsmart everyone, and earn wild rewards. Whether you’re a pro gamer or just love hilarious viral chaos,
bluejetty:00096547:ios.description:
Welcome to the crazy, chaotic world of Obby: Rob All Game – the funniest, most unpredictable mobile adventure where you rob everything, outsmart everyone, and earn wild rewards. Whether you’re a pro gamer or just love hilarious viral chaos, this is the ultimate experience you’ve been waiting for.
What makes Obby: Rob All Game different?
It’s not just about coins or loot – it’s about creativity, timing, and pure trolling genius.
GAMEPLAY FEATURES:
Rob anything, anywhere – every heist makes you richer and more powerful
Outsmart players and NPCs to steal their treasures and dominate the leaderboard
Earn rewards effortlessly – even when you’re offline, your loot keeps growing
Unlock hilarious gear and prank tools to mess with friends and random players
Run, jump, and escape Obby-style through wild obstacle courses full of traps and surprises
HOW TO PLAY:
Start by robbing your first base and collect your first loot
Sneak, dodge, and jump through obstacles to reach hidden treasures
Reinvent your base, upgrade your skills, and rob even bigger targets
Use troll gadgets and funny traps to outplay your rivals and rule the chaos
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:
Totally free to play – pure fun, zero pressure
Simple to learn but endlessly addictive
Full of laughs, crazy moments, and satisfying heists
Perfect for fans of funny Obby maps, viral pranks, and stealing chaos
This isn’t just another mobile game – Obby: Rob All Game is a wild, viral playground where humor, heists, and mayhem collide. Steal it, upgrade it, and become the ultimate Rob Master.
Ready to take everything that’s not nailed down?
Download Obby: Rob All Game now and start your journey to hilarious, viral greatness.

bluejetty:00013432:android.description:
Welcome to Cannabis City underground life. Gangster game where crime mafia thug wars become common city rules. Explosion, destruction, and heist in this battle arena. Daily work, isn't it? But now you can grow marijuana on your weed farm. Smuggle cannabis in stolen cars, defend plants and take over hemp farm. This is gangster and weed game. All in one! The best features that you can find in gangster game and weed game, now are connected in one mafia game!
Features:
Weed game! Marijuana is the main motive in this gang game.
Free action game in 3D open world simulator with realistic graphics.
This thug life game has multiple weapons type and upgrades.
Many vehicles and cars to drive in the city. Bus, buggy, taxi, etc.
Weed game with different mafia missions types.
Try now one of the most addictive open world games and try the crazy thug life in Gangster game! 
Join to criminal game and create your own gang!
From a poor man to the grand godfather and the biggest farmer in this sick crime city. That's your story and life dream. Beautiful women, super sports car, multiple businesses, thug life, and big really big weed farm.
We prepare a few kinds of thug life mission:
Steal and deliver the car with marijuana.
In this weed game you must conquer other mafia farm
Deliver cannabis plants for the godfather.
Weed game where you can grow weed simulator.
In your thug life you can kill the mad mafia bosses.
Attention our criminal game players! 
Please read before you start playing on this weed game!
Marijuana is prohibited or illegal in some countries. We do not urge to use cannabis in any way. Ganja motive in our open world games was used only for a humoristic reason. Graphics in this criminal game contains only hemp leaf.

Check this:
Our WEED GAMES

Extreme Games Studio

bluejetty:00073665:ios.description:
Index helps small businesses improve customer communication with powerful tools like instant auto-reply, texting shortcuts, customer notes, and more.
GET A DEDICATED BUSINESS PHONE NUMBER
Index gives you a local number that you can use alongside your existing business number or as a replacement for it. Your Index Number powers all of your Index communication tools and features.
RESPOND TO MISSED BUSINESS CALLS AUTOMATICALLY
Turn missed calls into opportunities with Auto-Reply. Index immediately sends a custom, branded text message to keep customer conversations going when you can't pick up the phone. Share hours, important links, and anything else that might help you win new business.
HELP CUSTOMERS INSTANTLY WITH TEXTING SHORTCUTS
Access shortcuts for interacting with customers right from your text thread using Index’s Texting Toolbar. Create reusable templates for common questions, book appointments, request payment, collect reviews, and more—all with a tap. 
CAPTURE AND ORGANIZE IMPORTANT CUSTOMER INFORMATION
Save important details about your customers easily, and reference them quickly to add a personal touch to every conversation. Organize customers into lists for sharing updates, offers, and more.
REACH CUSTOMERS THE WAY THEY PREFER TO BE REACHED
89% of customers prefer texting businesses over any other mode of communication. Index’s suite of simple, text-based features empowers businesses to reach customers on their terms.
Index gives you powerful tools to manage your customer interactions with the convenience of text.
Download Index today to start your risk-free 7-day trial. Cancel anytime.
Note on Subscriptions:
Index is a paid service. Subscriptions are automatically billed monthly or annually to your iTunes Account and auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payments are charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. You can turn off auto-renew or manage subscriptions in your iTunes & App Store account settings. Cancellations take effect at the end of the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period (where available) is forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00188058:ios.description:
Amazon Chime is a new communications service that transforms meetings and video calls with a secure, easy-to-use application that you can trust. With Amazon Chime, you can conduct online meetings, connect with video conferencing, call, chat, and share content easily, both inside and outside your organization. Amazon Chime is available on any device, and your meetings and conversations are always synchronized so that you can stay connected. 
Key Features:
• Tap to join meetings – no more lengthy pin numbers
• Video conference calls with high-definition video tiles
• Easily control meetings with the visual roster
• Tap to share content, view on any device
• Chat and chat rooms, with attachments
Amazon Chime frees you to work wherever you need to with a single app for all your communications needs.
By using Amazon Chime, you agree to the AWS Customer Agreement (visit https://aws.amazon.com/agreement/), AWS Service Terms (visit https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms/), and AWS Privacy Notice (visit https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/).
If you already have an AWS Customer Agreement, you agree that the terms of that agreement govern your installation and use of this product.

bluejetty:00179562:ios.description:
Family Organizer helps your whole family stay connected, organized, and on schedule — all in one place.

Create a family calendar and assign events to family members
View your schedule in monthly or weekly view

Sync across devices to keep everyone up to date
Integrate your existing shared calendars
Filter your schedule by family member
Track family birthdays
Add to-dos with due dates and reminders
Add sticky notes to any day
Check daily weather forecasts
Lists, Recipes & Journaling
Create and email shopping lists and checklists
Keep a daily journal
Store and share your favorite recipes

bluejetty:00132216:ios.description:
DrChrono EHR is an all-in-one EHR that seamlessly integrates patient scheduling, clinical workflow, telemedicine/telehealth and medical billing. With our state-of-the art EHR system, you enter patient information only once and data gets automatically passed to clinical charting, e-prescription, lab orders, and medical billing minimizing multiple data entries and data entry errors.
DrChrono's EHR / EMR was voted the #1 Mobile Electronic Health Record 9 years in a row by Blackbook. 
The DrChrono EHR app is:
• Safe and secure, meeting or exceeding industry standards.
• Simple to use, offering a great out-of-the-box software as well as a customized solution.
• ONC Certified to meet all requirements of the HITECH ACT & Meaningful Use Stage 1,2 & 3.
Best-in-Class Clinical Tools
• H&P, SOAP, and customizable medical forms.
• Integrated Telehealth / Telemedicine so you can have Video Visits.
• Custom vital flowsheets: track any user-defined measurement over time.
• Custom macros: auto-populate your notes with a click of a button.
• Lab integration: order and receive lab results directly into the patient’s chart.
• Dynamic photo charting and drawing tools.
• eRX with EPCS: Electronic prescription including controlled substances directly from iPhone, iPad & computer.
• Electronic referrals: send & track referrals electronically
• A huge library of customizable medical templates
• Medical speech-to-text
& More!
Powerful Patient Scheduling & Engagement
• Pre-appointment & real-time insurance eligibility check
• Automated email/text/phone reminders
• Patient Portal: Fully functional, HIPAA compliant patient portal with secure messaging
• Paperless check-in with digital consent forms on iPads
• Self-check-in Kiosk mode on iPad
Medical Billing RCM Services that Improve Collections
• 94%+ clean claim rate
• 48-hour turnaround on denials
• 96%+ of claims paid within 60 days
• Complete transparency into your practice financial status
• Direct communication with our medical billing team
DrChrono EHR / EMR is available on iPad, iPhone and web. Download today and start providing better & faster patient care!

bluejetty:00132005:ios.name: Cedars-Sinai
bluejetty:00132005:ios.summary: Cedars-Sinai is the standard for excellence in care. Those values extend to our mobile app. With our app, patients can connect with their care team, manage their medical records and track their health progress. U.S. News & World Report rank
bluejetty:00132005:ios.description:
Cedars-Sinai is the standard for excellence in care. Those values extend to our mobile app. With our app, patients can connect with their care team, manage their medical records and track their health progress. U.S. News & World Report ranks Cedars-Sinai among the best hospitals in the nation.   
App Features  
24/7 Video Visits With Cedars-Sinai Connect Cedars-Sinai Connect is our virtual care service that lets you see a Cedars-Sinai provider through secure video visits. Get 24/7 virtual urgent care or schedule a primary care appointment for a time that works for you.  
Urgent Care 
Get care for your immediate needs with options that work for you. Schedule a video visit or an in-person visit at a Cedars-Sinai urgent care location near you. Walk-ins are also welcome during open hours.  
Find a Doctor   
Find a provider who fits your needs. Search by specialty, condition, location or name to explore Cedars-Sinai providers and find the right fit for your care.  
Schedule and Manage Visits 
With My CS-Link, you can schedule appointments with your care team and manage upcoming visits in one place. You can also explore other care options when you need them. If you do not already have a My CS-Link account, please go to https://www.cedars-sinai.org/mycslink.html  
Stay Connected  
Keep up with your care through My CS-Link. Message your care team, check test results, view upcoming visits, access your medical records and more.  
Locations 
Find Cedars-Sinai hospitals, urgent care centers and medical offices near you and get directions to where you need to go.  
Walking Directions   
Get turn-by-turn directions to nearly 400 points of interest across Cedars-Sinai Medical Center and save your parking location for later.  
Apple Health   
Connect My CS-Link with Apple Health to access your medical record and share health information such as steps, blood pressure, glucose levels and BMI.  
Contact Us   
The Cedars-Sinai app provides contact information for our departments and services. Cedars-Sinai is available to take your call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to help with your health needs, billing questions and more.

bluejetty:00018119:ios.description:
Know exactly what your military reserve retirement is worth — before you get there.
Reserve Retirement Calc takes the guesswork out of your future retirement pay. Enter your pay grade, retirement points, and target retirement year, and get an instant, detailed breakdown of your monthly retirement pay and Survivor Benefit Program (SBP) premiums — shareable by email in seconds.
What it calculates:
- Monthly retirement pay under High-3 or Blended Retirement System (BRS)
- TSP balance projection for BRS members, including lump-sum election and reduced-pay scenarios
- Base SBP and RC-SBP premiums for spouse coverage, with Method 1 and Method 2 comparisons
- SBP breakeven analysis so you know when coverage pays off
Built for reserve and guard members:
- Whether you're an active driller, approaching the 20-year mark, or already in the gray area waiting for age 60, this app gives you the numbers that matter for your situation.

bluejetty:00187557:ios.name: Inventory for Business
bluejetty:00187557:ios.summary:

Track products, equipment, supplies,
bluejetty:00187557:ios.description:
Inventory for Business is an inventory management and stock tracking app with barcode scanning, multi-location inventory, team access, reporting, and tools for small businesses and growing organizations.
Track products, equipment, supplies, assets, serialized items, lot-controlled stock, kits, services, and bulk inventory from iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Scan barcodes to find items, add inventory, adjust stock, and manage everyday inventory operations.
Keep employees and team members working from the same inventory while managing stores, warehouses, branches, locations, and departments from one platform.
INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
• Add, search, update, and organize inventory items quickly.
• Track stock across branches, locations, stores, or departments.
• Attach images and notes, manage vendors, and organize items by category and type.
• Track serialized items, lot-controlled inventory, packs, kits, services, and bulk stock.
• Use smart lists for favorites, flagged items, expired stock, and items approaching expiration.
• Create and share custom item lists with your team.
BARCODE SCANNER
• Scan barcodes to find, add, open, or adjust inventory items.
• Use the built-in camera scanner for fast stock operations.
• Connect compatible external Bluetooth barcode scanners.
• Scan items while receiving, counting, checking, or updating stock.
BARCODE & LABEL GENERATION
• Generate barcode and QR code images directly in the app.
• Create and print labels for products, equipment, assets, and inventory.
• Print using standard adhesive sheets, Avery-style templates, A4, US Letter, and rolls.
• Supports EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC, Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, QR, QR Mini, and other common formats.
• Generate custom barcode labels using your own SKU or item codes.
MULTI-LOCATION INVENTORY
• Manage inventory across stores, warehouses, branches, offices, and departments.
• Keep inventory organized by location with centralized visibility.
• Separate operations by branch or business unit.
• Give users access only to relevant locations and inventory.
TEAM COLLABORATION
• Share inventory with employees, partners, and team members.
• Let multiple users work with the same up-to-date inventory.
• Assign roles and control who can view, add, update, or manage data.
• Create access lists combining users, roles, and branches.
REPORTS & ANALYTICS
• Review inventory activity with reports and charts.
• Analyze stock levels, item activity, and inventory movements.
• Create, print, email, or share professional PDF reports.
• Import and export CSV files for inventory updates and analysis.
ITEM ORGANIZATION
Inventory for Business supports:
• Retail products
• Warehouse stock
• Equipment and business assets
• Supplies and materials
• Serialized and lot-controlled inventory
• Kits and packs
• Services and bulk inventory
SECURITY & ACCESS CONTROL
• Manage users and assign predefined roles.
• Limit access to specific actions, branches, or inventory data.
• Authorize individual devices before allowing account access.
• Use biometric authentication supported by your device for secure access.
BUILT FOR SMALL BUSINESSES AND TEAMS
Inventory for Business works for retail stores, warehouses, offices, service companies, equipment inventories, supplies, and businesses with multiple locations. Use it as a barcode inventory system, stock tracker, warehouse inventory app, equipment tracking solution, or shared inventory platform.
STARKODE FOR BUSINESS
Part of the Starkode business suite for teams working across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Need help? Contact support@starkode.com.
SUBSCRIPTION
Starkode membership is month-to-month with no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. Cancel anytime from your device.
Privacy Policy: https://starkode.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://starkode.com/terms/

bluejetty:00066141:ios.name: Minesweeper: Collector
bluejetty:00066141:ios.summary: Tired of boring common square levels? Finally there is a brand new minesweeper with different game modes! Each level is a part of collection. Complete collections to obtain keys and gain access for more episodes. Achieve higher levels to un
bluejetty:00066141:ios.description:
Tired of boring common square levels? Finally there is a brand new minesweeper with different game modes! Each level is a part of collection. Complete collections to obtain keys and gain access for more episodes. Achieve higher levels to unlock new items, chests, pets and much more! Try it now for free!
Important! If you’re an experienced player disable "beginner" game mode in options and reach the hardest levels.
Features:
• Online mode!
• 22 episodes, 150 collections, 1350 unique levels!
• 30 pets. Would you be able to collect all additional evolutions at 180 levels? 
• Paid add-on "Puzzles". 42 puzzles and 714 levels available! 
• Tower of Power - new hard mode!
• Two types of game fields: square and hexagon.
• Treasure chests and useful items hidden at game field.
• And of course coins, which will be handful to buy these items!
• Quests - a great opportunity to earn coins and challenge yourself.
• Play classic 3 different difficulties of Minesweeper or throw your skills in Custom mode, in which you can design width, height, types and difficulty of the minefield by yourself.
• Scale the screen smoothly using buttons for comfortable one-hand gameplay.
• Progress always autosaves wherever you've stopped and also saves in cloud if using "Game Center".
• Challenge yourself by getting 24 achievements and compare your successes with other players.
• Developer worked very hard especially for all Minesweeper fans =)
Online mode is released! All news about the game on twitter and facebook pages
https://twitter.com/MinesweeperGems
https://www.facebook.com/minesweeperCollector

bluejetty:00023358:ios.description:
Heart Rate Monitor: Your Personal Health Companion
Discover the ultimate app for tracking your heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), daily steps, and now blood oxygen levels with ease and precision. Say goodbye to manual pulse meters and hello to Heart Rate Monitor, your all-in-one health monitoring solution. Perfect for individuals who value their well-being and want to stay on top of their fitness levels.
Innovative Features:
Heart Rate & HRV Monitoring: Utilize advanced algorithms to measure your heart rate accurately. Analyze your HRV to gain insights into your stress, energy, and readiness levels, with detailed HRV data displayed. These features become personalized over time as the app gathers more information, offering tailored insights into your physiological status.
Step Counting: Track your daily activity with step counting, including detailed breakdowns for hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly progress.
Blood Oxygen Recording: Monitor your blood oxygen levels with the newly enabled feature, providing deeper insights into your respiratory and cardiovascular health.
Blood Pressure Logging: Easily track and organize your blood pressure readings for convenient monitoring.
Breathing Exercise Feature: Improve your well-being with guided breathing exercises.
Fitness Level Insights: Gain valuable information on your fitness levels and potential heart disease risks.
Workout Intensity Tracking: Ideal for monitoring high-intensity interval training or cardio workouts, with personalized heart rate zones.
User-Friendly & Reliable:
Our users love how Heart Rate Monitor has replaced their traditional pulse meters and manual logs. The app offers easy monitoring, with well-organized categories for resting, exercising, and post-exercise heart rates.
Seamless Integration:
Heart Rate Monitor syncs seamlessly with the Health App, sharing your heart rate, blood oxygen, and step count records for a comprehensive health overview. Just ensure a well-lit environment for optimal camera performance, and you’ll have your results in seconds!
How to Use:
Launch the app.
Place the tip of your finger on your phone’s camera.
Ensure the flash LED is on.
Don’t press too hard.
Important Disclaimer:
Heart Rate Monitor is not a medical device and should not be used for medical purposes. HRV and blood oxygen features provide insights into physiological status only and are not indicators of psychological conditions. Always consult a healthcare professional for any health concerns. The app is ad-supported. For terms of use, please visit our blog page.
Download the Heart Rate Monitor App NOW and embark on a journey towards a healthier you!
This application integrates with the Health App and shares Heart Rate and Blood Oxygen Records with the Health App.
Terms of Use: https://myheartratemonitorapp.blogspot.com/2018/07/terms-of-use-ios.html

bluejetty:00129573:ios.summary:

 What you’ll love about Relax Puzzles: 
- Daily puzzles - new f
bluejetty:00129573:ios.description:
Relax Puzzles (Relax Jigsaw Puzzles) are puzzles for adults and children. This puzzle game lets you complete puzzles for free offline, including puzzles made from your photos.
 What you’ll love about Relax Puzzles: 
- Daily puzzles - new free puzzles every day!
- You can complete puzzles offline!
- A wide range of puzzles with different themed collections.
- A range of difficulty levels from 24 to 900 pieces, with rotation and without!
- You can create puzzles from your own photos.
- You can work on several puzzles at once.
- A special help button, the option to view the completed picture or even change the background.
- A special game mode for left-handed players.
You’re sure to love doing our wonderful puzzles!
A jigsaw puzzle is a type of puzzle consisting of an image split into small, irregularly-shaped pieces, which then have to be fit together to form a complete picture. Completing the puzzles takes dedication, patience, and concentration.
Some say that jigsaw puzzles were invented in 1760 by John Spilsbury, a London engraver, cartographer, and publisher, when he cut a paper map into a number of small pieces of various shapes.
Puzzles are more than just a fun way to spend time. They also enhance your fine motor skills, help you look at problems from different perspectives, develop your imagination, your spatial reasoning, your attention span, your concentration and memory, as well as your ability to make decisions independently. All of these things are particularly important for children. Relax Puzzles offers children ages 3 and up practice with all of these skills.
There are plenty of ways to do puzzles online on your computer, but our mobile app lets you put together puzzles wherever you want: out with friends, on public transport, even in the woods. You can still complete our puzzles, even without an Internet connection.
One major upside of using a jigsaw puzzle app compared to traditional puzzles is that an app takes up much less space! Think of how sad you feel when you’ve nearly completed a puzzle, but the final piece has gone missing. What game offers a free solution to this problem? Relax Puzzles, of course - a fun new competitor in the jigsaw bestgames category among puzzle games, as well the offline games category.
Relax Puzzles is a free-to-play game, but it does contain in-game purchases. If you have any questions or feedback, contact us at relax.puzzles.support@openmygame.com - we’ll be happy to hear from you! Who knows, maybe your suggestion for improving the game will be included in the next update!
OpenMyGame offers you the chance to dive headfirst into the fun and fascinating world of puzzles. This is the sign you’ve been waiting for - open the app and get one step closer to total relaxation!

bluejetty:00039694:ios.description:
Hinário 5 e Bíblia Sagrada da Congregação Cristã no Brasil (CCB) em um único aplicativo — 100% grátis, sem anúncios, sem cadastro e totalmente offline.
Criamos este aplicativo para servir quem precisa do Hinário nº 5 e da Bíblia no culto, sem distrações: nada de propagandas, compras ou coleta de dados.
PRINCIPAIS FUNCIONALIDADES
• Hinário 5 completo: 480 hinos e 6 coros, com player de melodia para acompanhar cada hino.
• Partituras do Hinário: a partitura completa de cada hino nas 7 edições do hinário — Dó, Ré, Mi bemol, Fá, Sol, Lá e Si bemol —, com modo escuro e correções que chegam automaticamente.
• Bíblia Sagrada completa: tradução de João Ferreira de Almeida, Revista e Corrigida.
• Narração da Bíblia: ouça a Palavra em voz alta, com destaque do versículo, escolha de voz e reprodução com a tela bloqueada.
• Versículo do dia: receba um versículo por notificação diária, no horário que você escolher — opcional e configurável nos Ajustes.
• Casas de Oração — o Relatório num mapa fácil: mais de 19 mil localidades em 26 países, com endereço, horários de culto, indicação de culto acontecendo agora e dados sempre atualizados.
• Cultos online: assista a cultos ao vivo e gravados dentro do aplicativo, com lembretes opcionais por notificação.
• Busca unificada: hinos por número ou letra, passagens bíblicas e Casas de Oração em um só lugar.
• 7 idiomas: Português, Inglês, Espanhol, Italiano, Francês, Alemão e Japonês — hinário e Bíblia completos em cada idioma.
• Leitura confortável: temas de leitura, modo escuro, tamanho de fonte ajustável e interface simples, pensada para todas as idades.
• Funciona offline: Bíblia, hinário, melodias e localidades sem precisar de internet.
Não temos vínculo oficial com a Congregação Cristã no Brasil. Este é um projeto mantido por amor à obra, sem fins lucrativos.
Baixe agora e tenha o Hinário 5, a Bíblia Sagrada e as Casas de Oração sempre à mão. Deus abençoe!

bluejetty:00017323:ios.description:
With Truth or Dare, the ULTIMATE party game, you'll be laughing, blushing, and maybe even cringing as you and your friends answer tough questions and take on crazy dares.
In Truth or Dare, players take turns choosing between answering a tough question truthfully or completing a crazy dare. The game is full of unexpected twists and turns, and you never know what's going to happen next!
The challenges are divided into 8+ very different categories, there are over 900+ Truths or Dares.
One of these decks, called the "Dirty Deck," is ideal for adults and includes more risqué and suggestive truth and dare options. And if that's not enough, you can even create your own custom deck!
If you don't want to answer relationship questions question or do the sexy dare, you simply don't use those decks.
So gather your friends, grab some snacks, and get ready to play Truth or Dare! Are you brave enough to face the truth or will you take on the dare? 
Keep in mind that this is the game for ADULTS, if you're too young or easily offended this is not the game for you.
Rules:
1. Pass the phone around
2. Decide if you want truth or dare
3. If you don't want to answer the question or do the dare, you have to do the punishment.
Or you can play without punishment, which means no backing out!
Truth or Drink offers a 3-day free trial, after which a weekly subscription is required to continue playing. The game cannot be played without an active subscription or free trial.
Upon confirmation of purchase, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account. The subscription will automatically renew on a weekly basis unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings. If you cancel during the trial period, you will not be charged. After canceling auto-renewal, you will retain access to the game’s features until the end of the current payment period.

Your goddesses await you.

◆Anime Tower
bluejetty:00040447:ios.description:
Looking for the sequel? Be sure to check out Shiba Wars 2!
Your goddesses await you.
Experience a fusion of tower defense & anime in this modern TD game. Recruit your favorite characters, level them up, and defeat the enemy.
◆Anime Tower Defense◆
This it THE game for fans of the TD genre who enjoy beautiful art & aesthetics but don't want to sacrifice strategy & gameplay. There are 100s of handcrafted stages with several paths to victory. Whether you chase power, or chose to use your favorite characters, is up to you.
◆RPG Upgrading System◆
There are several paths to increasing the power of your favorite goddesses. With no duplicate system, you are in full control of achieving a character's true potential. The strategy element of this game is not paywalled.
◆Recruitment system◆
There is no gacha in this game. Characters are unlocked in the shop using in-game currency earned from completing stages & clearing missions. If there is a character that you want, there is nothing stopping you from chasing her.
◆Modern gaming◆
This game abandons the tricks used by mobile games. As tower defense & RPG fans ourselves, we developed this game with a player-first mindset. Quality of life features such as auto-complete remove the need to mindlessly grind. We listen to all player feedback and respond to all comments, continuously improving the game with each update (every 3 weeks).
If you're a fan of RPGs, anime, or Tower Defense, this is the game for you.

listings.name: Mi Vodafone
listings.description:
Mi Vodafone siempre contigo: todo lo que necesitas, en una sola app
Estrenamos nuevo diseño para que gestionar tus servicios de Vodafone sea más fácil, rápido e intuitivo que nunca, desde cualquier lugar y en cualquier momento.

 - Tu Tienda Online, con los mejores precios y descuentos exclusivos: 
   - Compra lo último en smartphones, accesorios, universo gaming y la mejor selección beauty.
   - Además, añade líneas o renueva tus tarifas fácilmente.
   - ¿Sin stock? No te preocupes, te avisamos en cuanto vuelva tu producto favorito.
   - Consulta el estado y seguimiento de tus pedidos al momento.

 - Sección “Para Ti”: Beneficios solo para clientes. Disfruta de ventajas exclusivas con Happy, sorteos y llévate hasta dispositivos gratuitos. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ganar premios increíbles cada semana con nuestros Miércoyeees! 

 - Control total de tus productos, facturas y consumos. Revisa todos tus productos contratados (líneas, fibra, TV…) en segundos. Consulta tu consumo en tiempo real, descarga o paga tus facturas directamente desde la app. 

 - Entretenimiento sin límites. Activa y gestiona fácilmente tus suscripciones a Netflix, HBO Max, Filmin, Prime, Disney+ y DAZN. ¡Lo mejor del cine, entretenimiento y el deporte, a un solo clic!

 - ¿De viaje? Lleva tu tarifa contigo. Consulta cómodamente la tarifa de tu país de destino y activa o desactiva el Roaming con un solo botón. 

 - ¿Necesitas ayuda? Nos puedes informar averías, hacer su seguimiento e incluso hablar con uno de nuestros técnicos.


Mi Vodafone es para ti si:
 - Tienes un contrato de particular.
 - Tienes un contrato de autónomo o pequeño negocio.

¿Tienes tarjeta prepago? Puedes gestionarlo todo fácilmente con la app Mi Vodafone Prepago
¿Tienes otro tipo de servicio?  Puedes gestionarlo todo fácilmente desde nuestra web: www.vodafone.es 


Contacta con Vodafone
Haremos todo lo necesario para que tu experiencia sea la mejor posible. También nos puedes encontrar en:
 - Web: www.vodafone.es
 - WhatsApp: +34 607 100 100
 - X: https://x.com/vodafone_es
 - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vodafoneES
 - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vodafone_es


¿Ya la tienes instalada?
Mantenla siempre actualizada para disfrutar de todas las mejoras que lanzamos continuamente.
Gracias por confiar en nosotros y ayudarnos a seguir creciendo contigo.

bluejetty:00061617:ios.summary:

1. Create an account within minutes by uploading a resume.

bluejetty:00061617:ios.description:
Search thousands of career opportunities every week with the free Robert Half app. 
1. Create an account within minutes by uploading a resume.
2. Tell us your preferences such as job title, remote/hybrid, contract or perm, and salary range.
3. All jobs are single- tap apply —– no more reformatting or re-uploading your information!
4. Keep track of your application status, manage interview requests, job offers and save new jobs. 
When you apply through Robert Half, you gain access to our skilled network of professional recruiters. Simplify your job search in accounting and finance, technology, admin, marketing and creative, and more! 
Key Features:
- All posted jobs are clients who are working with us for their hiring needs, so we will never ask you to duplicate work by applying outside of our app 
- Get personalized recommendations and matches that align with your career goals and preferences. 
- Find remote, contract and permanent jobs.
- Stay updated with customized job alerts sent to your inbox.
Already working with a Robert Half client? The app offers convenient features:
- Easily enter and submit your hours worked and stay informed about the status of your submitted time reports
- Set up secure direct deposit
- Access your past time reports after completing a job
- View paystubs and access tax documents
Find on-site and remote jobs with Robert Half, ranked the #1 professional recruiting and a top-ranked temporary staffing firm by Forbes (2023).

इसेवा कसरी प्रयोग गर्ने ?
bluejetty:00013747:ios.description:
इसेवा नेपालकै पहिलो मोबाइल खाता हो । इसेवामा खाता खोली आफ्नै मोबाइलबाट नि:शुल्क आफ्नो मोबाइल रिचार्ज, घरको बिजुली, खानेपानी, टेलिफोन, इन्टरनेट आदिको बिल भुक्तानी गरि मासिक रु ५०० देखि रु २००० सम्म बचत गर्नुहोस् । 
इसेवा कसरी प्रयोग गर्ने ? 
रजिष्ट्रेशन
इसेवाको App Download गरि Register गर्नुहोस् । यसरी Register गर्दा तपाँईको मोबाइल नम्बर नै तपाँइको इसेवा आइडी हुनेछ ।
इसेवामा पैसा जम्मा गर्न
इसेवामा चार प्रकारबाट सजिलै रकम जम्मा गर्न सकिन्छ:
१. इन्टरनेट वा मोबाइल बैंकिङ मार्फत
बैंकको खाताबाट इन्टरनेट वा मोबाइल बैंकिङ मार्फत इसेवामा नि:शुल्क रकम जम्मा गर्नुहोस। मोबाइल/इन्टरनेट बैंकिङ सेवा लिनु भएको छैन भने आजै आफ्नो बैंक को शाखामा गएर सेवा सुरु गराउनुहोस ।
२. काउण्टर डिपोजिट मार्फत
इसेवाको पार्टनर बैंक मध्ये ७ वटा बैंकबाट इसेवामा काउण्टर डिपोजिट पनि गर्न सकिन्छ । 
ग्लोबल आइएमई बैंक,
प्रभु बैंक, 
महालक्ष्मी डेभेलपमेन्ट बैंक, 
जनता बैंक,
मेगा बैंक 
ओम डेभेलपमेन्ट बैंक
कामना सेवा विकास बैंक
३. eSewa Cash Point मार्फत
तपाँईको आफ्नो टोल छिमेकमा रहेका eSewa Cash Point चिन्ह अंकित इसेवाका एजेन्ट मार्फत पनि नि:शुल्क रकम जम्मा गर्नुहोस।
४. तपाँईले अन्य इसेवा प्रयोगकर्ताबाट इसेवामा पैसा राख्न र पठाउन पनि सक्नुहुन्छ ।

बिजुली र खानेपानीको बिल भुक्तानी
इन्टरनेटको बिल भुक्तानी
टेलिभिजन रिचार्ज
मुभि टिकट
होटल बुकिङ
स्कुल फि 
इन्सुरेन्स प्रिमियम
किस्ता भुक्तानी
डिम्याट खाता दर्ता र नविकरण
क्रेडिट कार्ड बिल भुक्तानी
अनलाइन सपिङ
बैंक डिपोजिट
इसेवाको बारेमाः
eSewa fonepay Pvt. Ltd. सन् २००९ बाट सेवा दिइरहेको नेपालको पहिलो भुक्तानी सेवा प्रदायक कम्पनि हो । मोबाइल तथा इन्टरनेट बैंकिङको सफ्टवेयर प्रदायक कम्पनिमा नेपालकै अग्रणी स्थानमा रहेको F1Soft International को एक सहायक कम्पनिको रुपमा इसेवा रहेको छ ।
हाल नेपालको ७७ वटै जिल्लामा पहुँच भएको यस eSewa fonepay Pvt. Ltd. सँग १० लाख भन्दा बढि दर्ता भएका ग्राहकहरु , ४०,००० भन्दा बढि व्यवसायी (eSewa Zone/Point), ४७ बैंकहरु तथा १,५०० भन्दा बढि मर्चेन्टहरु आवद्ध रहेका छन।
थप जानकारीका लागि: १६६०-०१-०२१२१
ईमेल: csd(@)esewa.com.np
eSewa is Nepal's first payment gateway with integrated digital wallet. You can register on-the-go and save Rs. 500 - Rs. 2000 in a month. 
How to register and make payment with eSewa? 
Registration
Download eSewa app and click on Register. Your mobile number will be your eSewa ID.
Load fund to eSewa
You can load fund to your eSewa account in 4 different ways:
1. Via Mobile/Internet Banking:
You can load eSewa wallet from your internet/mobile banking without any additional cost from 47 banks. Visit your bank branch if you have not enabled internet banking and mobile banking.
2. Via Counter Deposit:
You can visit nearest branch of below mentioned partner banks for loading fund to your eSewa account via counter deposit:
a. Global Bank
b. Prabhu Bank
c. Mahalaxmi Development Bank
d. Janata Bank
e. Mega Bank
f. OM Development Bank
g. Kamana Sewa Bikas Bank
3. Via eSewa Cash Point
You can visit nearest eSewa Cash Point and load fund to your eSewa wallet without additional service charge.
4. You can also send and receive fund to your eSewa wallet from other eSewa users for free.
Services of eSewa:
Mobile recharge and TOPUP
Landline Bill
Airline and Bus Ticket
Electricity and water bill payment
Internet Bill
Television Subscription
Movie Ticket
Hotel Booking
School Fee
Insurance Premium
EMI Payment
DMAT account opening and renew
Credit Card Bill
Online Shopping
Bank Deposit
About eSewa
eSewa Fonepay Pvt. Ltd. is the first and leading Payment Service Provider, starting service from 2009 AD. eSewa is a subsidiary company of F1Soft International, leading fin-tech company in Nepal.
eSewa has it's wider coverage to all the 77 districts of Nepal. eSewa has a growing network of more than 10 lakhs registered customer, 40,000+ agents (eSewa Zone/Point), 47 banks, 1500+ merchants.

bluejetty:00070344:ios.description:
Control your home's window coverings from the convenience of your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch. The PowerView® App provides intelligent operation of popular Hunter Douglas window coverings. Adjust your window coverings to manage incoming light and energy usage throughout your home with the tap of a button or through automated operation. The app merges seamlessly with your connected lifestyle to provide a level of convenience and ease for your automated window coverings.
Features:
• Control Hunter Douglas motorized window coverings, individually or in groups, throughout your entire home.
• Quickly and easily navigate the app using built-in tabs: Dashboard, Rooms, Scenes, and Schedules.
• Add favorite Scenes, Shades, and Schedules to your Dashboard, so they appear first whenever you open the app.
• Create customized shade position settings called "Scenes" for convenience, or to manage your natural lighting and privacy needs throughout the day.
• Put your Scenes in motion using Schedules. Easily program your Scenes to activate automatically at different times of day to deliver the look and comfort you want, without you having to press a button. Configure Schedules to occur at a specific time, or based on unique Sunrise and Sunset times in your specific location.
• Easily enable or disable Schedules, so that your blinds take the day off when you do.
• Manage your Home from anywhere with RemoteConnect™. This requires a PowerView® Gateway, an Internet connection, and initial in-home setup.
If you need help or have a question, email us at PowerView@hunterdouglas.com or call 1-844-PWR-VIEW (US), 1-800-265-8000 (Canada).

bluejetty:00151831:ios.description:
Where Word Categories Meet Tripeaks – A Fresh Puzzle Adventure!
Dive into Word Tripeaks, the innovative game that blends word categorization with the addictive tripeaks solitaire gameplay!
In each level, you’ll uncover cards from a pyramid of words. Some cards show categories—like “Fruit,” “Color,” or “Animal.” Others display specific words, such as “Apple,” “Blue,” or “Tiger.” Your mission? Match each word to its correct category while clearing the board TriTripeaks-style!
How to play:
Tap cards that are free (not blocked by others) to reveal them.
Once a category card is found, collect words that belong to it.
Plan your moves wisely—you can only use cards that are fully uncovered!
Clear all cards before runs out to earn big rewards and advance to more challenging puzzles.
Features:
Unique Hybrid Gameplay: Enjoy the satisfaction of word sorting mixed with strategic card-clearing action.
Hundreds of Levels: From easy brain teasers to mind-bending challenges, every level brings fresh categories and words.
Learn as You Play: Discover new vocabulary and categories in a fun, engaging way.
Relaxing Yet Stimulating: Perfect for quick sessions or deep puzzle-solving moments.
Colorful Visuals & Soothing Sounds: A delightful interface designed for hours of relaxed play.
Whether you’re a word puzzle enthusiast or a Tripeaks fan looking for something new, Word Tripeaks offers the perfect blend of logic, language, and fun.
Ready to climb the word pyramid? Download Word Tripeaks now and train your brain—one category at a time!

listings.description:
【APP简介】
    新人注册领超值折扣券、实名认证可享免押入住、添加小猪企微领专属优惠券包、社群好礼每周送不停……更多福利，快来小猪！
    不同的旅行目的地，相同的标准化房间，旅行就该如此？ 当然不是，来小猪，每一次出发都能让你遇见惊喜。
  小猪民宿成立于2012年，为国内领先的特色住宿预订平台。小猪全平台共有超过80万间房源，分布在全球超过700座城市及目的地，包括特色民宿、客栈、城市公寓、轰趴别墅、树屋等多样的特色房源，可以满足你外出旅行、商务出差、朋友聚会、情侣约会、求医、求学、求职的每种住宿需求，是酒店之外的预订首选。
【国内外海量特色民宿】在小猪，你可以栖息于山海间，酣睡在市井胡同；也可以住进INS风网红民宿打卡，去体验老洋房、四合院。从北京到三亚，从海边到深山，从国内到海外，无论是冰天雪地的漠北，还是万绿归宗的云南，或是精彩纷呈的东南亚，只要你打开小猪APP就能找到属于你的特色居所，度过一段超乎想象的旅行时光。
【线上选房订房 轻松入住】你可随时随地打开小猪APP，浏览房源照片，挑选自己喜欢的房源，了解房源和房东的介绍及价格信息，并与房东进行在线沟通，第一时间掌握这些短租日租房、民宿客栈或是酒店式公寓的详情，轻松完成住宿预订。你还可以从房东那里了解到最正宗的当地文化和旅游信息，完美规划自己的旅程。
【千万入住用户好评】于万用户做出真实评价，帮你快速了解房源详情、入住体验、房东服务，筛选更轻松，住的更舒心。
【佳宿安全有保障】双方身份验证，线上安全交易，7*24小时客服保障，房客在小猪平台下单均会赠送意外险，让每一次出行更有保障。
【成为小猪房东】你可以发布属于自己的独特房源，结识一群有趣的朋友，并且轻松获得额外的收益！
酒店之外，就住小猪！在小猪，让每一次出发，都邂逅惊喜。

【联系方式】
无论你是想了解小猪，预订小猪的房源，还是想成为小猪的房东，我们随时欢迎您联系小猪客服：400-010-7890
