bluejetty:00064262:ios.description:
Blast off!! Launch yourself into one of the best free matching games!
Looking for more than just 4 direction match 3 games and puzzles!? Try your hand with SIX DIRECTIONS with the hexa puzzle block game for adults & children and enjoy the fun and magic of TOY PARTY! the new FREE MATCH 3 game from the creators of casual puzzle games enjoyed by more than 8 MILLION players! 
 - Bored of easy puzzle games for adults that even young children can solve?
 - Got a creative AND logical brain to take on a DAZZLING MATCH 3 PUZZLE CHALLENGE?
Find yourself in the shoes of Joyce, a young girl who ends up visiting the magical world of toys. Help Joyce in her toy box puzzle adventure by clearing each creative level, all taking place on the hexagon block game board.
Take on SIX directions on a HEXA BLOCK MATCHING bee hive shaped toybox game board!
Play TOY PARTY, the BEST free matching games for adults!
HOW TO PLAY 
- Swap and match-3 or more similar toy blocks!
- Blast blocks away with fun Toy boosters!
- Open the Toybox to collect even more toys!
- Be creative with the toy block match directions!
- Crush the hexa shaped puzzle game board with your strategy game skill!
- Remember there are SIX directions to match the toy block!!
- Make more Toy boosters with dazzling lollipop colors!
- Clear each level by achieving the puzzle challenge!!
- Enjoy hexa block match 3 puzzle solving games!
- Want to play the next smash hit brand NEW match 3 games?
Looking to play free games without wifi? No wifi needed to play puzzle games for free in Toy Party! You can take on this delight alone or play with friends and family to see who can get the highest score! It's best match 3 game for adults and kids! See who can get more golden trophies!
TOY PARTY INFORMATION
◽ Toy Party is a FREE MATCH 3 puzzle game with in-app purchases available
◽ Toy Party is a six way, match 3 hexa block puzzle game
◽ Toy Party will provide a fun challenge for traditional 4 direction match 3 users
◽ Toy Party is a hexa matching games for adults
MORE TOY PARTY INFORMATION 
◽Toy Party FAQ Link: https://nstagepuzzle.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
◽ Toy Party Support Link: https://nstagepuzzle.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

bluejetty:00144700:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00144700:ios.description:
A powerful but simple tool to track all of your stuff. Whether you're moving houses, tracking inventory, storing holiday decorations, or packing up old items in the basement, Boxes is the app to help you get it done.
Features:
- Create spaces to segment your objects by room or location
- The app generates and tracks the box and item numbers for you
- Quickly add items to a box or directly to a space
- Snap photos of your open box or items and upload them
- Add values, quantities, and 7 other built-in attributes to your items
- Create your own custom attributes and make them available on all of your items
- Add sizes and weights to your objects
- Run and export detailed, graphical reports
- Share across devices
- Invite team members with fine-grained roles and feature grants
- Customize and print labels directly from the app onto any label or paper size
- Print a manifest of your entire collection
- Scan QR codes and barcodes for quick object viewing
- Use NFC tags to scan and open your objects
- Attach your own QR codes and barcodes to your items
- Run advanced, automated actions when objects and items are scanned
- Use Smart Search to peek inside boxes using your camera
- Mark your objects as heavy, fragile, expensive, hazardous and/or temperature sensitive
- Add tags to your objects for better categorization and searching
- Add notes to your objects for a more detailed description of contents
- Create aliases to customize naming or numbering schemes
- Create tasks and reminders to help you with important todos
- Create and set custom object statuses
- Search all of your objects for specific contents, notes, tags, statuses, or attributes
- Filter your view to just the objects you want to see
- Quickly move objects from one space to another
- Duplicate or move items across boxes
- Bulk edit large sets of objects
- Bulk import data via CSV file
- Use custom numbering schemes
- Set custom app themes
- Use offline without an internet connection, then sync changes when back online
- See detailed audit logs of changes to your inventory
- Receive signed webhook payloads when any of your data changes
- Get help right in the app via 1:1 chat with support
Great as a:
- Moving organizer, moving helper, or moving checklist
- Home inventory collector
- Inventory management system
- Holiday decoration tracker
- Storage facility tracking
- Box scanner
And so much more!
User Guide: https://user.boxesapp.net/guide
Privacy Policy: https://boxesapp.net/privacy
Terms of Use: https://boxesapp.net/terms

bluejetty:00090674:ios.description:
Health Stats is the most detailed way to explore your Apple Health data: clear charts, personal records, and trends all in one place
If you use Apple Health and want more than raw numbers, Health Stats gives you a simple way to track progress, spot patterns, and stay motivated over time.
See your health and fitness data in one clean dashboard. Track key metrics like steps, walking and running distance, exercise time, stand hours, calories burned, water intake, and more. All data syncs directly from Apple Health.
Go deeper with detailed workout stats for activities like running, walking, cycling, swimming, strength training, HIIT, yoga, hiking, and more. Review workout totals, distance, time, calories burned, and activity trends to better understand your progress.
Keep your numbers in view with widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Choose from seven widgets: a single stat, a stat with its goal, your goal streak, a stat with its last 7 days, a week of bars, a running total, and an overview of several stats. Most let you pick the date range, including ranges you saved in the app.
Health Stats also helps you stay consistent:
• Set personal goals for your most important metrics
• Build goal streaks: how many days, weeks or months in a row you reached your target
• Track progress over time
• Compare performance across periods
• Discover trends in your health and activity data
• View personal bests and lifetime records
• Explore detailed charts and stat breakdowns
Whether you want to improve your daily activity, stay motivated with goals, or better understand long-term health and fitness trends, Health Stats makes Apple Health easier to use and more meaningful.
Why people use Health Stats:
• Clear Apple Health insights
• 100+ health and workout metrics
• Goals, streaks, and progress monitoring
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Trends, comparisons, and personal records
• Clean charts and detailed stat views
• Privacy-friendly, no account required
Privacy first
Your health data stays on your device. Health Stats reads from Apple Health and is designed to help you understand your data without compromising your privacy.
Download Health Stats and get more value from your Apple Health data.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/health-stats-app

Pocket Rocket keeps track of all upcoming SpaceX rocket launches, and reminds you of when they're happening. Launch dates change constantly, so we act as your launch concierge to make sure you never miss out on witnessing history. 
With this app, you can view existing and future rocket models, receive critical updates about launches, livestream new launches, watch each historical launch, and see your favorite rocket in Augmented Reality. 
Base Features for All Users:
- Day-Of Reminder notification about every Upcoming Launch.
- Full access to all features of the app! What you see is what you get.
- See dates and countdowns for each launch, so you know exactly when they will happen. 
- Interact with your favorite rockets in a 3D view, and in AR. 
- Livestream every launch directly from the app!
Subscription Tiers: 
Pocket Rocket Plus
- All the Base features.
- Receive Launch Updates and Detailed Reminders. 
- Updates for when a launch date changes just before a launch is expected to happen.
- Reminders for each upcoming launch, from T - 1 Week, T - 24 Hrs/12 Hrs (it varies), T - 1 Hr, and T - 5 Minutes. 
Pocket Rocket Silver
- All the Base features.
- All Launch Updates and Reminders
- Support the development of the app. This helps us continue building Pocket Rocket full-time. 
- A Silver Decal in your app to display your level of support.
- Exclusive future features to further display your level of support! 
Pocket Rocket Gold
- All the Base features.
- All Launch Updates and Reminders
- Support the development of the app.
- A Gold Decal in your app to display your level of support.
- Exclusive future features to further display your level of support! 
We hope you'll love it. 
(Disclaimer: This is app is not affiliated with SpaceX or its partners or customers)

bluejetty:00165792:ios.summary: FNP Exam Prep is your comprehensive guide to conquering the Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) certification exams of the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) and the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (AANPCB)
bluejetty:00165792:ios.description:
FNP Exam Prep is your comprehensive guide to conquering the Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) certification exams of the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) and the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (AANPCB) — and now the Adult-Gerontology Primary Care NP exam (AGNP: A-GNP-C and AGPCNP-BC). Developed by experienced exam experts, this app offers an extensive selection of high-quality questions, detailed answer explanations, and multiple testing modes—empowering you to practice effectively and confidently, anytime and anywhere.
We constantly update the content based on the latest exam syllabi, ensuring the material you study is always current and relevant. Our subjects are professionally categorized according to the most recent exam guidelines, allowing you to focus on the topics most important to your success. With user-friendly navigation and a powerful performance analysis system, you can easily track your progress, identify areas for improvement, and tailor your study strategy to maximize efficiency.
Key Features:
* 6 Dynamic Test Modes: Simulate the real exam, create targeted quizzes, and adapt your practice sessions based on your personal learning style.
* 8,000 Practice Questions Across Three Exams: AANPCB FNP (1,800+), ANCC FNP (3,600+) and AGNP Primary Care (2,500+) — rigorously reviewed items that closely mirror the actual test format and difficulty.
* In-Depth Answer Explanations: Gain a thorough understanding of the reasoning behind each answer, reinforcing core concepts and building confidence.
* Performance Tracking & Analytics: Monitor your strengths and weaknesses, fine-tune your study plan, and make steady progress toward your goals.
* User-Friendly Design: Enjoy an intuitive, clean interface that streamlines your practice and keeps you focused on what matters—passing your exam.
Your Path to FNP Success:
Preparing for the AANPCB or ANCC FNP exam, or the AGNP Primary Care exam, doesn’t have to be overwhelming. With FNP Exam Prep, consistent effort and strategic practice will transform your hard work into proven success. Focus your studies, strengthen your knowledge base, and approach your exam with the confidence you need to excel.
***
DISCLAIMER:
We do not represent any of the exam certification organizations, governing bodies, nor do we own the test names or trademarks of these exams. All test names and trademarks belong to respected trademark owners.
FNP® is a registrar owned by the American Nurses Credentialing Council (ANCC). It is administered exclusively by ANCC®. This application is not approved or endorsed by ANCC®.

Meetby is a unique dating app where people meet and date other local people. It's created to change the antiquated rules of dating.
We are dedicated to providing people with an innovative and fun way to meet others online. Our features will bring you a fresh and unique experience while you are looking for new people.
Our unique features:
1, Love at first sight
In the real life, you may fall in love with someone at first sight on the street. But maybe you are too shy or have no time to say hi to that person. On our app, the feature “Love at first sight” simulates the scenario of meeting people on the street. It helps you use your intuition to find people you like. People will appear on the phone screen for a short period of time. If you fall in love with someone at first sight, you need to tap his/her photo quickly to move them to your love bag. Then you can talk with them. 
2, Romantic jigsaw
Romantic jigsaw helps you know better about other people before you contact them. The photos of other users will be made as jigsaw puzzles. When you play the jigsaw puzzle, you will look closer to the users’ photos and know more about them. After you finished 5 jigsaw puzzles successfully, you can chat with one of them for free.

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once you turn off auto-renewal, your subscription will expire at the end of the current billing cycle. For more details, please see our Service Agreement and Privacy Policy.

listings.name: Meetby: Local Dating App
listings.description:
Meetby is a unique dating app where people meet and date other local people. It's created to change the antiquated rules of dating.

We are dedicated to providing people with an innovative and fun way to meet others online. Our features will bring you a fresh and unique experience while you are looking for new people.

Our unique features:

1, Love at first sight

In the real life, you may fall in love with someone at first sight on the street. But maybe you are too shy or have no time to say hi to that person. On our app, the feature “Love at first sight” simulates the scenario of meeting people on the street. It helps you use your intuition to find people you like. People will appear on the phone screen for a short period of time. If you fall in love with someone at first sight, you need to tap his/her photo quickly to move them to your love bag. Then you can talk with them. 

2, Romantic jigsaw

Romantic jigsaw helps you know better about other people before you contact them. The photos of other users will be made as jigsaw puzzles. When you play the jigsaw puzzle, you will look closer to the users’ photos and know more about them. After you finished 5 jigsaw puzzles successfully, you can chat with one of them for free.
 
About auto-renewable subscription:
If you choose to purchase Sugar Meet subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal (1 week: $5.99, 1 month: $15.99, 3 months: $35.99) within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Once you turn off auto-renewal, your subscription will expire at the end of the current billing cycle. For more details, please see our Service Agreement and Privacy Policy.

Service Agreement - https://meetby.app/tos.html
Privacy Policy - https://meetby.app/pp.html

bluejetty:00177612:ios.description:
Trichstop is the #1 platform to treat hair pulling disorder (trichotillomania).
The Trichstop App is a proven and effective solution for addressing and managing your hair pulling disorder. Gain direct one-on-one access to a specialized therapist with expertise in treating hair pulling, who guides you through overcoming your personal challenges. The app also offers a range of resources and tools to support you in your journey towards recovery and growth. 
Key Features:
Expert Therapist Support: Our therapists specialize in treating hair pulling disorder using evidence-based techniques from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) as well as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT). 
Personalized Treatment Program: Receive a customized treatment plan tailored to your specific needs by an expert therapist. This program will help you address the underlying causes of your hair pulling and allow you to develop healthy coping mechanisms.
Education: Gain a deeper understanding of hair pulling and its causes, triggers, and associated conditions, as well as the physical and emotional impact of hair pulling. Learn about evidence-based treatment strategies and practical techniques and steps that you can take towards healing.
Helpful Tools: Access a range of in-app tools to easily implement the evidence-based therapeutic techniques you learn during your sessions. Begin your journey by taking a self-assessment in order to measure your progress and tailor your treatment plan. Monitor your pulling episodes and urges in our Self-monitoring tool to become aware of your pulling patterns. Practice mindfulness techniques in our Mindfulness tool to increase awareness and manage your racing thoughts. The app has many other tools designed specifically to enhance your healing journey and support your progress.
Support Groups: Engage with a community of individuals facing similar challenges through virtual support groups led by skilled therapists. Share experiences, gain support, and offer encouragement to one another.
Educational Content: Explore a rich library of educational materials, such as articles, videos, and webinars, to deepen your understanding of hair pulling disorder and its management. This content provides valuable insights and empowers you with knowledge.
Take the first step towards overcoming hair pulling and improving your well-being with the Trichstop App. This app is designed to facilitate your journey towards healing by providing you with the therapeutic support and tools you need. Start your path to recovery today.
CONNECT WITH US!
We’d love to connect with you and receive feedback.
Email us: support@trichstop.com
Check out our website: www.trichstop.com

bluejetty:00186458:ios.name: MathBoard
bluejetty:00186458:ios.summary: MathBoard® is a powerful and highly configurable math learning app designed for children of all ages. From simple addition and subtraction in early grades to more advanced multiplication, division, and even algebraic equations, MathBoard ad
bluejetty:00186458:ios.description:
MathBoard® is a powerful and highly configurable math learning app designed for children of all ages. From simple addition and subtraction in early grades to more advanced multiplication, division, and even algebraic equations, MathBoard adapts to meet each student’s level and pace.
More than just drills, MathBoard encourages students to truly learn how to solve problems—not just guess the answers. With multiple question styles (including multiple choice and fill-in-the-blank), a built-in scratchboard for working out problems, and an interactive Problem Solver, MathBoard guides students step by step through the logic behind each answer.
The app includes a variety of math activities such as Find the Sign, Equality/Inequality, and Match Math, making learning both engaging and effective. Difficulty levels automatically adjust based on your settings, ensuring that practice stays aligned with the student’s progress.
What Teachers Are Saying
“This is the best integer practice app or program I have found in 34 years of teaching math.”
— Tim Seiber, Math Teacher
“MathBoard has charm without losing track of its fundamental purpose.”
— MacWorld (4 out of 5 mice)
“A stunning app for teaching math. The number of customization options available makes this a brilliant app for making math fun.”
— androapple
Key Features
 • Step-by-step Problem Solver for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
 • Random equation generation for basic operations, squares, cubes, and square roots
 • Fully customizable number ranges and equation formats (e.g. 6 + x = 12)
 • Intelligent wrong-answer generation to discourage guessing
 • Built-in scratchboard for working through problems by hand
 • Activities and quizzes with countdown or elapsed time options
 • Multiple student profiles with progress tracking and sharing
 • Quick reference tables for counting, addition, subtraction, and multiplication
 • Full support for iCloud Sync
 • Designed for the latest Apple tech:
 • Apple Pencil
 • Apple Magic Keyboard
 • Text-to-Speech and Speech Input
 • Windowed multitasking in iPadOS 26

bluejetty:00185651:ios.summary:
BRAND NEW DESIGN FOR 2020! NOW COME AS "MILLION GOLDEN DEAL"
"Deal The Big Deal" is an exhilarating hit game show where contestants play and deal for a top prize of $1 million in a high-energy contest of nerves, instincts and raw intuition
bluejetty:00185651:ios.description:
BRAND NEW DESIGN FOR 2020! NOW COME AS "MILLION GOLDEN DEAL"
"Deal The Big Deal" is an exhilarating hit game show where contestants play and deal for a top prize of $1 million in a high-energy contest of nerves, instincts and raw intuition.
Each night, the game of odds and chance unfolds when a contestant is confronted with 25 sealed briefcases full of varying amounts of cash – ranging from a measly penny to $1 million. Without knowing the amount in each briefcase, the contestant picks one – his to keep if he chooses – until its unsealing at game's end.
The risk element kicks in when the player must then instinctively eliminate the remaining 24 cases – which are opened and the amount of cash inside revealed. The pressure mounts as in each round, after a pre-determined number of cases are opened, the participant is tempted by a mysterious entity known only as "the Banker" to accept an offer of cash in exchange for what might be contained in the contestant's chosen briefcase – prompting Mandel to ask the all-important question – Deal or No? You must think carefully to give the right answer.
As each case is opened, the likelihood of the player having a valuable cash amount in his or her own case decreases or increases. Viewers will see if, truly, fortune favors the bold. The contestant knows that as long as the larger cash prizes haven't been opened, the Banker's deals will only get higher. And if the conflicted contestant accidentally opens a case with a bigger cash value – the Banker's offer could suddenly evaporate.
The prizes in this free deal game are not exchangeable for real-world money or prizes. For prompt support, please contact our support team via support@vgamestd.com.
If you see anything need to improve to make game more fun. Please give us your comments.

bluejetty:00090428:ios.description:
تأسست شركة بيت العباءة الشرقية
في 11 رمضان 1408 هـ 28 أبريل 1988 م 
 بالمدينة المنورة ، حيث أفتتح أول فرع لها ؛ وأخذت بالتوسع بإفتتاح عدة فروع لها مكة المكرمة 
 وبحكم مواقعها المتميزة في المدينة المنورة ، و مكة المكرمة ، إكتسبت الشركة شهرة عالمية 
 وهي اليوم علامة تجارية مسجلة تمنح حق امتياز الإسم والمنتج ، ولديها وكلاء في الامارات و الكويت و البحرين و ليبيا و المغرب و بروناي وماليزيا و جنوب أفريقيا ، وتتطلع الشركة نحو التوسع عالميا 
 تخصصت شركة بيت العباءة الشرقية بصناعة وبيع العباءة والأزياء الشرقية ؛ وتعد من أوائل المتخصصين بذلك 
حيث أصبحت الشركة اليوم من الرواد في التطريز اليدوي ، الذي أكسبها شهرة واسعة في هذا المجال ، بالإضافة إلى مكائن التطريز الحديثة بالكمبيوتر 
تهدف شركة بيت العباءة الشرقية بتقديم منتج يخاطب النخبة من أصحاب الذوق الرفيع ؛ ونتيجة اهتمامنا بمعايير الجودة في الأقمشة والخياطة والتطريز وإضافة أرقى أنواع الكريستال ؛ أصبحت الشركة اليوم شريك في ترويج العلامات التجارية العالمية

bluejetty:00095926:ios.description:
Welcome to Goods Hunt!
A physics-based puzzle where your shopping cart transforms into an absorbing collector. Navigate supermarket aisles, gather everyday items, and watch them stack infinitely high before collapsing spectacularly. Seasonal events like Halloween bring spooky collectibles and festive challenges to your shopping trips.
INFINITELY SATISFYING
Complete your shopping list and trigger a breathtaking collapse animation. Realistic physics makes each tower crumble uniquely. 
YOUR HOLE CART SIZE UP GRADUALLY 
Start with a small absorption hole. Eat small items first to expand your hole size. The bigger you grow, the larger items you can hunt. This creates natural progression where impossible items become achievable as you progress. Strategic thinking determines collection order.
THEMED COLLECTIONS
Unlock cup collections as you progress through levels. Discover themes like Fruits, Bakery, Aquatic, Candy Land, Beverages, and more. Each theme features multiple cups to collect during gameplay. Complete entire collections to earn exclusive rewards including coins, boosters, and special bonuses.
CONTINUOUS EVENTS
- Key Hunt challenges you to collect golden keys scattered throughout levels. Unlock treasure chests containing rare items and exclusive cups. 
- Chugging Treasure brings limited-time collectible milk appearing in each level.
- Star Contest offers weekly competition on global leaderboards where top performers earn legendary recognition. 
- Cloud Quest provides themed challenge chains - complete quests to unlock entire collection sets instantly.
- Halloween fills the aisles with spooky collectible objects to hunt, plus a 7-day challenge with fresh goals to complete.
We regularly add new events and exclusive content keeping gameplay fresh.
YOUR SUPERMARKET ADVENTURE
Familiar aisles, recognizable products, everyday items you see in the supermarket - but with an addictive twist and cute design.
The most satisfying feeling comes when items stack infinitely high inside your cart. It's the comforting familiarity of shopping combined with incredibly rewarding gameplay.
PROGRESSION
Unlock themes at level milestones, we have various collections for you to discover. Collect boosters through gameplay and events - Magnet attracts nearby items automatically, Freeze Time pauses countdowns for planning, Compass reveals hidden shopping list items.
FAMILIAR SUPERMARKET ITEMS
Recognizable supermarket products create immediate connection. Everyday goods from real shopping trips make collecting fun and relaxing. This familiarity makes the experience oddly satisfying.
IDEAL FOR
Collection completionists hunting themed sets. Event participants enjoying rotating challenges. Casual players seeking relaxing puzzles. Competitive players climbing leaderboards. Anyone appreciating visual and audio feedback.
HOW TO PLAY
Drag the hole through aisles absorbing goods strategically. Eat small items to increase size. Complete objectives before time expires. Gather cups during gameplay. Finish collections for rewards.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us at support@lihuhugames.com. 
Download Goods Hunt and start your infinite stacking adventure today!

bluejetty:00040679:ios.description:
مرحبًا بك أيها المغامر،
كانت مدينة النسيم في ما مضى مكانًا مزدهرًا، ولكنها أصبحت اليوم تحت رحمة قوى الظلام. نحتاج إلى مساعدتك لاكتشاف الحقيقة واستعادة الأمل من جديد.
صمم شخصيتك القتالية بلمستك الخاصة
- اختر مقاتلك من بين مجموعة متنوعة من الفئات، مثل: المحاربين والفرسان والسحرة والرماة والساموراي والنينجا وغيرها. كل فئة تمتلك قدرات خاصة مثل السحر والأسلحة القوية مثل السيف والخنجر مما يمنحك أسلوبًا فريداً في اللعب.
خصص مظهرك بالكامل لتعبّر عن شخصيتك بأسلوب مميز.
- تشكيلة مدهشة من العتاد والأزياء والمخلوقات اللطيفة
- لعبة ار بي جي RPG فانتازي بشخصيات انمي وتجربة ممتعة في عالم خيالي.
- اختر أزياء متنوعة لتخصيص مظهرك بالكامل.
- اصطَد مرافقين لطيفين يرافقونك في رحلتك او تنقل على متن السرج عبر عالم مفتوح وجميل.
- اجمع بطاقات القوة واتخذ هيئة الوحوش
- اهزم الوحوش القوية واستولِ على بطاقات الأرواح التي تمنحك قوة خارقة.
- تحوّل إلى الوحوش واستخدم مهاراتهم الفتاكة في المعركة لتصبح من أقوى ابطال اللعبة.
- انضم إلى أصدقائك وواجهوا الوحوش معًا
- خض تحديات شيقة و العاب حماسية مع أصدقائك لتتغلبوا على المراحل والوحوش القوية التي تتطلب تنسيقاً جيداً بين أفراد الفريق.
ارفع قوتك القتالية
- أتمم مهمات المملكة مع لاعبين من جميع أنحاء العالم لترقية قوتك.
- كوّن أقوى التحالفات وقاتل من أجل النصر
- اهزم التحالفات الأخرى باستخدام الاستراتيجية والقوة في المعارك بين التحالفات.
- استمتع بالفعاليات الترفيهية وعِش تجربة حماسية مع أعضاء التحالف.
- دع قصص بطولاتك تنتشر في كل بقاع الأرض
- أظهر شجاعتك ومهاراتك في الحلبة عند منافسة اللاعبين الآخرين.
- قاتل من أجل النصر والوصول إلى قمة قوائم المتصدرين.
استمتع بألعاب مصغرة متنوعة 
- تسابق، أطلق النار، اختبر معلوماتك، واستمتع بأكثر من 20 نمط لعب ترفيهي في افضل لعبة انمي.

bluejetty:00118995:ios.description:
Everlance records your miles automatically and turns them into tax deductions. At the current IRS rate of 76 cents per mile, 1,000 miles of work driving is $760 back in your pocket.
Professional includes 1099 tax filing and $1M audit protection, so your records hold up if the IRS ever asks.
"A driver's co-pilot" - The New York Times Trusted by over 4 million drivers and self-employed pros.
▶ WHAT YOU GET
- Automatic mileage recording that runs in the background
- Smart trip classification to sort work driving from personal
- Manual expense and receipt logging on Starter, or automatic capture by linking a card on Professional
- Deduction Finder to surface write-offs you would otherwise miss
- IRS-compliant reports for taxes or reimbursements
- 1099 tax filing and $1M audit protection on Professional
→ "What makes it especially great for the self-employed is its assistance in managing taxes. Its deduction finder even scans expenses to see if there's anything else you can file as a tax deduction" - Wired
▶ WHY IT MATTERS 
Every mile you drive for work is money back in your pocket. Drive 100 work miles a week and that is roughly $3,950 in deductions over a year, at the current IRS rate. Miss a few trips and you lose a real piece of it. Everlance keeps the record for you: every mile logged, every receipt stored, every deduction found and your numbers ready the day you file.
▶ YOU STAY IN CONTROL 
Where you drive is your business. Everlance is ad-free, protected with bank-level encryption and your data is never shared or sold.
Record automatically in the background, switch to manual or limit recording to your work hours. Automatic recording needs location and motion permissions turned on, and you can turn them off whenever you want.
▶ WHO IT'S FOR 
If you drive your own vehicle for work or charity, Everlance was built for you.
- Delivery and rideshare drivers on DoorDash, Uber, Lyft, Instacart and Shipt
- Real estate agents and field sales reps
- Freelancers and contractors juggling multiple clients
- Small business owners who want one tool for mileage, expenses and taxes
- Volunteers recording charitable miles
→ "Everlance is by far the best option I've found, combining a simple, attractive interface with a price that's impossible to beat. It has earned a permanent spot on my phone" - CNET
▶ PLANS FOR EVERY BUDGET 
Start free, no credit card required.
- Basic (free): manual mileage recording, 30 automatic trips per month and reports
- Starter: unlimited automatic mileage recording, smart trip classification, manual expense and receipt logging, IRS-compliant reports
- Professional: everything in Starter plus automatic expense capture by linking a card, Deduction Finder, 1099 tax filing and $1M audit protection
Starter and Professional both include a free 7-day trial, so you can try everything before you commit.
Customer support is available in English, Spanish and French. 
Contact us at support@everlance.com. 
Privacy Policy: https://www.everlance.com/privacy 
Terms of Service: https://www.everlance.com/terms-of-service 
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Download Everlance free and start recording your miles today.

bluejetty:00060911:ios.name: Best Decision - decision maker
bluejetty:00060911:ios.summary: Buying new MacBook? Wondering which house is best for your family? Choosing holidays: tropical beach or a spirited trip through Asia? Always make Best Decision! Best Decision is an extremely easy choice-making analytics app. It will tell yo
bluejetty:00060911:ios.description:
Buying new MacBook? Wondering which house is best for your family? Choosing holidays: tropical beach or a spirited trip through Asia? Always make Best Decision! Best Decision is an extremely easy choice-making analytics app. It will tell you which decision is objectively the best, then YOU choose whatever you please.
The decision making process in Best Decision is trimmed down to the necessary minimum. It’s a 3-step-down staircase:
1. enter all the choices you’re considering
2. enter all the relevant criteria and their importance
3. estimate how well each option meets each criterion
Best Decision takes it from here and the math does the job. As an outcome, you get plain & simple result: your Best Decision and all the other options in order of how well they suit you.
So if you are about to make an important decision, let Best Decision's algorithms do the hard work for you. GET IT NOW!
Most important FEATURES of Best Decision:
1. UNIVERSAL APP for all your iOS and macOS devices (iPhone, iPad, iPod Touch and Mac)
2. uses iCloud to automatically SYNC your data between all your devices
3. suitable for COMPLEX and SIMPLE DECISIONS 
4. highly FLEXIBLE: 
 + can store unlimited number of decisions, options and criteria
 + is suitable for different types of decisions
 + allows to define personal criteria together with their importance
 + allows to modify all previous inputs
 + allows to change the order of decisions, options and criteria (tap and hold)
5. Decision TEMPLATES 
6. Touch ID, Face ID or password-protect so YOU DECIDE who can access your decisions 
7. USER FRIENDLY: guides you easily through the decision making process
8. presents OBJECTIVELY BEST OPTION in comparison with all other sorted by rating results
9. you can SHARE calculated verdict by Message, send it by mail, generate to PDF or save to Photos
10. use 3D Touch ACTIONS on icon to quickly go to the last 3 decisions or create a new one
11. find any decision in your SPOTLIGHT SEARCH by name or considered option 
12. work more efficiently with SLIDE OVER and SPLIT VIEW on your iPad

bluejetty:00076371:ios.description:
Phase Card Game, also known as Phase Rummy, has been bringing families and friends together for over 10 years!
Play anytime, anywhere. A match takes just 10 minutes, making it perfect for quick games with friends and family. Play with 2 player, 3 player, or 4 players, invite your friends and enjoy exciting multiplayer fun together.
Players strive to complete 10 different “stages” of card combinations, which can include sets, runs, or specific patterns of cards. The goal is to be the first player to successfully complete all 10 Stages.
Every deck includes 'Wild' and 'Skip' cards, introducing exciting twists that can completely alter the course of the game! Wild Cards are multicolored cards that can be used to represent any number or color. Skip Cards are action cards that can be used to skip another player's turn when played. 
This card game is a beautiful Rummy inspired game, offers an excellent user interface, making it easy to initiate games with both your friends and fellow online phase rummy enthusiasts. This popular online card game, which can now be enjoyed virtually with friends and players from around the world, combines elements of skill, strategy, and a dash of luck.
The ten phases are predetermined and must be completed in order. The phases include tasks such as forming sets of cards with the same number or runs of consecutive numbers. For example, Phase 1 might require two sets of three cards with the same number, while Phase 4 might need a run of seven consecutive cards.
Enjoy 10 phase rummy with your friends and family. The name of the 10 card rummy game originates from the requirement for a player to navigate through ten stages (or melds) to secure a win. This enjoyable and demanding new card game features some formidable phase objectives at every level. Your goal is to accomplish these 10 phase objectives and clear your hand before your opponent
Don't hesitate any longer! Grab the Rummy cards game today and dive into hours of entertainment! This online 10 Cards Phase Game allows you to play with friends or match up with players from all over the world in real time.
Your search ends here! Download Phase Card Game today!
Rummy Card Game Features: 
* 2, 3, 4 Player mode.
* Play an offline game with Smart & Competitive AI.
* Play Online with real card game enthusiasts from around the world. 
* Play with Friends & family on a Private Table.
* Localized gameplay in French, Deutsch, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese & English.
* Get free coins by Spin and Watching Video.
* Experience genuine multiplayer action by playing with real online opponents
* Very Intuitive Interface and game-play
If you love Solitaire card games, you'll definitely enjoy this online Game. Step into the wonderful world of card game and challenge your friends!
Phase Card Game offers an engaging and competitive card-playing experience that requires a mix of strategy, timing, and card-counting skills. Whether you're a seasoned 10 Cards rummy pro or a newcomer, this online version brings the classic 10 Phase card game to your digital devices, allowing you to enjoy hours of challenging and entertaining gameplay.
Please don't forget to Rate and Review Rummy Card Game! 
Stay with us for more interesting games.

bluejetty:00135611:ios.description:
CONSULT AN ONLINE DERMATOLOGIST VIA THE MIISKIN APP
- Choose a board-certified dermatologist in your state
- Popular for acne, hair loss, melasma and anti-aging
- Ensure continuity of dermatology care by consulting the same dermatologist each time
- First-time consultation starts at $59. Medication renewals $39.
- Request a prescription for oral, topical or personalized formulas
- No subscriptions, order your treatment on-demand
MIISKIN APP FEATURES
Via the Miiskin app you can consult an online dermatologist licensed in your state, and get a response in 1 - 2 business days.
Common conditions typically addressed include:
- Acne: Ranging from mild to severe, including initial treatment and ongoing management.
- Hair loss: Including androgenic alopecia, telogen effluvium, and other non-scarring types of alopecia.
- Anti-aging and cosmetic concerns: Fine lines, wrinkles, and skin texture issues that can be improved with prescription creams like tretinoin.
- Rosacea: Flare management and long-term prescription care.
- Eczema and dermatitis: Atopic dermatitis, hand eczema, contact dermatitis, and related conditions.
- Mild psoriasis: When it can be managed with topical treatments.
- Bacterial skin infections: Folliculitis, impetigo, and other localized infections that don’t require procedures.
- Fungal infections: Tinea (ringworm, athlete’s foot, jock itch) and localized yeast rashes.
- Viral infections: Cold sores, shingles, and genital herpes, where timely antiviral prescriptions are important.
- Pigmentation concerns: Hyperpigmentation, melasma, post-inflammatory dark spots, and uneven skin tone.
- Urticaria (hives): Sudden outbreaks that are bothersome but not life-threatening.
- Warts and molluscum contagiosum: Diagnosis and prescription treatment guidance (procedures may still need in-person care).
- Seborrheic dermatitis: Dandruff or facial scaling that responds to prescription topicals.
- Perioral dermatitis: Rash-like breakouts around the mouth, nose, or eyes.
MIISKIN APP: Connecting patients with independent, board-certified online dermatologists
The Miiskin app connects patients with independent dermatologists who offer virtual care through their private practices. Miiskin does not interfere with their practice of medicine and does not sell or distribute any medications. All prescriptions are fulfilled via third party online or local pharmacies.
THE VISION OF MIISKIN
Miiskin has evolved from a skin monitoring app into a comprehensive online dermatology consultation platform designed to serve both patients and dermatologists. This shift reflects the Miiskin’s commitment to meeting the growing demand for accessible, affordable, and expert-led dermatological care through technology. The features for patients looking to keep an eye on their skin are still available in the app.
MIISKIN PREMIUM
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
TERMS OF SERVICE
https://miiskin.com/terms
MIISKIN SUPPORT
If you need any help or assistance with the Miiskin app or your subscription, do not hesitate to contact Miiskin on support@miiskin.com. To get help with medical problems, please start consultations with the dermatologists in the app and use the built-in messaging feature in your consultation.

bluejetty:00074362:ios.description:

* Vessel catalog

* Waypoints, routes, ETA, XTD, speed limits 
* Route Meeting Point 
* Visual CPA 
* AIS "virtual boarding" 
* Mariners tools: VRM, EBL, Mariners Notes, Clearing Lines 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00137451:ios.description:

In these games, the joy of learning is universal, suitable for both boys and girls. Download now and embark on a journey where education meets entertainment, shaping bright minds one game at a time. Don't miss out on this engaging experience that balances education and fun. Join us in creating a foundation where kids don't just play games but actively engage in a process of exploration and skill development. Download now and unlock the potential of your toddler early learning years!

bluejetty:00127622:ios.description:
A vibrant way of reading the TLS on your Apple device. With its combination of literary discoveries, incisive criticism, essays, poems and debate, the TLS is for anyone with an interest in the world of culture and ideas. In addition, you will find an easy search function, the weekly TLS podcast and full access to years of back issues. From fiction to philosophy, religion to politics, social studies to film: TLS readers can decipher, discuss and delve into it all.
The TLS app is free to download and you can access the contents in the following ways:
1) If you subscribe to the TLS, simply log in by using your surname and your subscriber number.
2) You can buy individual issues for £2.99 or an auto-renewing subscription at £7.99pm from the iTunes store.
Subscription renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of your current period, otherwise the account will be charged as normal. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: http://www.newsprivacy.co.uk
Terms of Use: the-tls.co.uk/terms-conditions

Rehabilitate, prevent injuries and free your pain.

You will have, anywhere and at any time, what you need to relieve pain, rehabilitate or prevent musculoskeletal injuries, strengthen your body for your sport or daily life tasks and help you with treatment and training protocols for your students and patients .
The app's functions allow you to easily access the exercise or program you need for your diagnosis, goal, sport and more. Check out what you'll find at Wolt:
- Exercise videos with full descriptions
- Smart search with over 300 filters to quickly find the exercise or program
- Programs for a range of diagnostics
- Strengthening and injury prevention programs for various sports
- Custom creation of programs for healthcare professionals
- Sharing programs from professionals to your patients and students

PATIENTS, STUDENTS AND ATHLETES
Relieve your pain and improve your health and quality of life.
Prevent injuries and improve your performance in physical activities with exercises and programs for strengthening, mobility, stability and power. Receive programs from your physical therapist, trainer or teacher directly in the app with complete instructions to do at home.
PROFESSIONALS
Maximize your practice
Don't waste any more time looking for exercises and practices on the internet for your patients and students. Have a complete exercise and rehabilitation platform in your hands. Enrich your appointments and classes by sharing your prescriptions directly to your patients, students and athletes.

Wolt is free to download. Full usage requires an active subscription, available monthly or yearly. New customers have access to the free plan that has limited access to exercises and programs. bluejetty:00130422:android.name: Shop Makeover: Makeup Fashion!
bluejetty:00130422:android.summary: Welcome to Shop Makeover, the clothes fashion battle! Hair&cut covet fashion battle! Sketchbook fantasy episode! Transform your job simulator avatar into a speed queen miss universe! Whether you're running my mini mart or clothing store 3d,
bluejetty:00130422:android.description:
Welcome to Shop Makeover, the clothes fashion battle! Hair&cut covet fashion battle! Sketchbook fantasy episode! Transform your job simulator avatar into a speed queen miss universe! Whether you're running my mini mart or clothing store 3d, become a massage envy and get a fantasy hike makeup, dress-up and barber chop!
The ultimate fashion farming simulator and design game that combines the excitement of a farming simulator with the thrill of a town-building game. Unleash your inner superstar!
Unleash your creativity with fashionable clothes and hair&cut makeover. Become a massage envy speed queen in this perfect avatar job simulator. Be ready to dress-up your miss universe, put on makeup and barber chop to perform a beautiful project makeover! Be ready to call it my mini mart and clothing store at the same time!
In this game, you'll have the chance to run your own clothing store 3D, where you'll design clothes and help customers find the perfect outfit. Like a true fashion battle, you'll have to use your style DNA to make even the most fashionably-challenged customers look like a yoyo doll!
With the help of the sketchbook and illustrator tools, you can sketch and craft your own clothes and accessories, using free form designs and 3D puzzles to make your store stand out. If you're up for a challenge, you can even take on the speed queen and monster high fashionistas in a fashion battle!
But it's not all about fashion and design, you'll also get to experience the joy of a farming simulator as you build your own store from scratch, like in Farmville and Hay Day. You'll have to get your hands dirty and build your store, grow your own crops, and manage your inventory like a pro.
Don't forget the makeup games and makeover studio, where you can make up and dress up your own avatar, just like in Project Makeover or Super Stylist. You can even give yourself a new look and hairstyle, with Hair & Cut and Barber Chop.
Whether you're a good or bad girl, it has something for everyone. With so many clothing stores to find, including Covet Fashion and clothing store 3D, you'll never run out of options. And if you're feeling competitive, you can challenge your friends to see who can build the best store and become a true Miss Universe!
You can also find clothing in the supermarket and create your own clothing designs with the help of Stitch Fix and Fashionable. You can use the design feature to create clothes of your choice and even use the shop as your own personal clothing design studio!
If you're a fan of puzzles and 3D games, you'll love it. You'll use your design skills to build clothing stores and makeovers that look like they're straight out of a Sketchbook. You'll even get to create your own clothes with free form designs that are sure to impress!
The ultimate fashion-themed game where you can sell, master, and achieve your dreams of becoming a top fashion designer. In this game, you'll help desperately needed people achieve their dreams by transforming them into confident and fashionable individuals.
Choose hairstyles and wardrobes to stylize your character and create your own unique look. You'll also be able to customize and decorate your store with the latest and greatest furniture and decor, with more coming soon.
There's drama everywhere in this game, including egotistical icons in dire need of your help. Your challenge is to solve your client's challenges and obstacles, and deal with their challanges.
You'll face addictive and challenging obstacles that will test your skills and creativity. Unlock new hairstyles, wardrobes.
With every successful makeover, you'll become a master of the fashion industry, and be able to help more and more clients in dire need of your expertise. Customize, stylize, and decorate your way to becoming the ultimate fashion designer, and unlock your full potential in this challenging and rewarding game.
Join the fashion battle! Play for free and get ready to become a true style icon.

bluejetty:00080225:ios.description:
Your thoughts create your future. And dozens of negative thoughts endlessly repeat in your mind that drive you to dark paths. Positive affirmations help rewire our brains, build self-esteem and fix these negative thought patterns. They motivate us and allow us to change how we think and feel.
Empower yourself by verbally affirming your dreams and ambitions. Choose from many daily intentions and set reminders to be delivered throughout the day. 
Positive affirmations not only do they help make significant shifts in your mindset they also serve as prompts and daily reminders on what you are truly capable of, making sure you have an amazing day, every day.
The manifest app is simple but effective and uplifting. It is kind of like getting a text from a good friend telling you how much they appreciate you: it takes a few seconds to read, puts a smile on your face, and reminds you what's really important in life. It’ll remind you of your worth, talent, and strength.
With the manifest app, we aimed at affecting the conscious and the subconscious mind and as a result, transform your thoughts and habits and shape your reality.
When you’ve downloaded the manifest app you’ll get:
• Affirmations for any situation from 30+ different categories
• Smart affirmation reminders
• Unique new affirmations added every week
• Practice as many affirmations as you want
• Personalize your theme with dozens of high-quality background images and fonts
• Ambient sounds that uplift you
• Live scenes to calm your mind
• Share your daily affirmations to any platform in portrait or square mode
• Like your affirmations to see them anytime in your favorites
• And much, much more…
Manifest offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription to provide unlimited access to the all-inclusive solution while you maintain an active subscription. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/manifestios/privacy/
Terms: https://zipoapps.com/manifestios/terms/

bluejetty:00019488:ios.summary:

The classic idle card game with a cumulative download of more than 20 million times - TapTap He
bluejetty:00019488:ios.description:
PocketGamer commented: "Perfect vertical game experience of TapTap Heroes will completely subvert your imagination of ordinary idle RPG games."
The classic idle card game with a cumulative download of more than 20 million times - TapTap Heroes' 4th anniversary celebration is about to start.
[Game Introduction]:
The first multiplayer strategy RPG game! Collect heroes and resources, strategically adjust the idling lineup, explore and defeat powerful bosses in Den of Secrets, PK with global players!
[Game Story]:
In Mystia, the holy sword with the power of creation was discovered again, and this time the person who obtained it was Freya, the queen of hell, who may want to take control of the whole world.
Alliance knights, horde warriors, elf wizards, undead spirits, and heaven gods all embark on the journey for the power of creation.
You'll fight with more than 500 heroes from six different camps, and stop Freya's plans before danger sets in.
Game Features:
[Easy and labor-saving, place and idling]:
Afraid of being too tired? Your heroes will still fight for you while you're offline!
There is also a function to automatically receive rewards with one tapping!
You can collect rich rewards everyday!
[Six camps, rich cultivation]:
More than 500 heroes from six camps are waiting for you. Improve hero level, star awakening and evolution, reasonably configure hero talent skills, unlock more cool appearance and more powerful skills, which can effectively improve the combat power!
Hero equipment enhances the hero's health and defense, runes enhance the hero's potential attributes, they can make your hero more powerful.
[Varieties of PVE gameplays]
Various Rogue-like gameplays such as Hero Expedition, Void Cage, Shadow Maze, etc.
Mainline instances, Den of Secrets, Planet Trial, etc. verify your familiarity with the heroes;
Build your exclusive territory, unlock resource buildings of gems, gold coins, and wood, etc., decorate the territory, improve the prosperity of the territory, start the Adventure voyage;
Unlock Familiar Home, unlock advanced familiar skills and potential.
[Global PVP competitive competition]:
Enter the Elite arena through the single-player PVP Warrior arena, and then to the King's arena, all the way to enter the Legend arena!
Invite your friends to form a fantasy team and compete with players from different parts of the world;
The original gameplay--Peak, using strategies to select heroes, buffs and equipment to randomly form teams.
[Form a guild and challenge guild boss together]:
Fight side by side with members in the guild, challenge the guild boss, improve the personal technology strength in the guild, win rich rewards!
The War of Mana is open for outstanding guild alliances, snatch resource pools, compete for champion badges and treasures!
Play with tens of millions of players from all over the world and share the joy of gaming and life!
[Hint: This game requires an internet connection]

bluejetty:00021011:ios.name: Sleep Sounds: Nature & Ambient
bluejetty:00021011:ios.summary: Do you have trouble sleeping? The Sleep Sounds app will lull you to sleep in no time with a great collection of nature sounds and relaxing music to choose from. Sounds can be played individually or mixed together, with the added ability to
bluejetty:00021011:ios.description:
Do you have trouble sleeping? The Sleep Sounds app will lull you to sleep in no time with a great collection of nature sounds and relaxing music to choose from. Sounds can be played individually or mixed together, with the added ability to adjust each individual volume level to your liking. 
In addition to helping you sleep better, these sounds are also perfectly suited for general relaxation and meditation.
Struggling sleeper and you like the sound of rain drop? Try our rain app! It’s made for every sleeper needing peace. Mix calming sounds like rain drop patterns or thunder in this soothing rain app. Perfect for meditation or sleep, every sleeper will love how each rain drop relaxes. Get this rain app and sleep deeply tonight!
Features include:
• 36 ambient sounds and music. This includes 12 free sounds, with the option to unlock the remaining 24 through the in-app purchase option.
• The ability to either play the sounds individually or play as many sounds together at the same time. There are lots of combinations for you to discover and create many beautiful ambient sound experiences.
• Individual volume control sliders for each sound. This is great for finely tuning your ambient sound mixes.
• A sleep timer option with many preset timer options (ranging from 5 minutes to 8 hours) available. This is a perfect addition for anyone looking to use the app as a sleep aid, once the timer fires, all playing audio will stop to allow your device to go into "sleep mode".
• When the sounds and music are playing, users are able to close the app and do general tasks on their device, such as check emails, browse the internet & use other apps.
Sleep Sounds makes a perfect companion for general relaxation and can be used to help aid sleep. We strongly advise you to check out our in-app upgrade, where you can access more sounds to help further enhance your relaxation experience.
Subscription:
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. If your subscription is subject to any promotional discount, the discount will expire upon the end of the current period and you’ll be charged the standard rate upon renewal. Go to your iTunes Account under subscriptions to manage your membership and to turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Terms of Use: https://zipoapps.com/sleepsoundsios/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/sleepsoundsios/privacy/

bluejetty:00098532:ios.description:
Turn your ideas into perfect music with a single tap! Whether you want to make a cover using any voice or create an original song, our app brings your ideas to life in just a few simple steps. 
Every track you generate sounds beautiful, natural, and emotionally rich — crafted to match your style and intention. Try it now and experience how amazing your music can sound!
Why Bach AI?
【 Use Your Own Voice to Sing Any Song 】
Want a truly personal touch? Record or upload your own voice, and the AI will recreate your favorite songs using your unique timbre. It’s like having your own professional studio performance, giving you endless possibilities to make every cover truly yours.
【 Cover Songs with Ready-Made Voices 】
Ever wondered how a song would sound if performed by a different character? Upload a music file, then choose from a wide variety of pre-set character-style voices—from playful cartoon tones to realistic human-style vocals—and instantly transform any song into a fresh, amazing performance.
【 Turn Your Ideas into Full Songs 】
Even if you only have a rough musical idea or concept, our AI can transform it into a complete song. Just describe the mood, style, or instrumentation you want, and the app will generate a polished track with natural, expressive vocals that bring your vision to life.
【 Generate Songs from Your Lyrics 】
Have lyrics ready? Simply paste them into the app, choose the genre and mood, and let AI compose the perfect melody and arrangement to match your words. The result is a professional-sounding song that makes your lyrics shine.
【 Choose Any Music Style 】
We provide a wide range of genres for every creator: pop, hip-hop, R&B, EDM, ballad, rock, lo-fi, and more. Simply pick the style that inspires you, and the AI will build the song around it.
【 Enjoy High-Quality, Natural Sound 】
Powered by advanced music-generation technology, every track comes out sounding natural, expressive, and polished. From vocal realism to professional arrangements, the quality is engineered to meet your expectations—and make your music truly stand out.
#SUBSCRIPTION TERMS#
- You may unlock premium features with flexible payment options: Weekly, Yearly, Lifetime.
- Subscriptions will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase and will renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Apple ID account settings.
By using Bach AI, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service:
Privacy Policy: https://app.chat-apps.ai/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://app.chat-apps.ai/useragreement.html

bluejetty:00060769:ios.description:
The ‘Vachanamrut Study App’ by BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha 
The Vachanamrut is a principle scripture of Swaminarayan Sampraday that introduces Bhagwan Swaminarayan's novel Vedantic philosophy of Akshar-Purushottam Darshanam. It is a compilation of 273 spiritual discourses delivered by Bhagwan Swaminarayan from 1819 to 1829. It is a Hindu scripture filled with illuminating analogies and metaphors, and divine revelations that provide philosophical and practical answers to the deepest mysteries and questions of life.
With the inspiration and guidance of Brahmswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Pragat Brahmswarup Mahant Swami Maharaj as well as the tireless efforts of the learned sadhus and experienced volunteers of BAPS, the Vachanamrut is being made available in ‘app’ format – delivering the same spiritual wisdom in a modern, accessible medium.
Through short-and-simple definitions and easy-to-understand explanations, this app provides a study platform for spiritual seekers looking to better understand the subtleties of eternal knowledge and apply the teachings of Bhagwan Swaminarayan to their lives. Utilising current technology, this app meets the needs of today’s spiritual generation by giving them access to ancient wisdom in a modern format – making the study of the Vachanamrut a truly enjoyable experience.
The ‘Vachanamrut Study App’ contains easy-to-use features such as: 
- Simple definitions of regional, scriptural and philosophical words.
- Clear and structured explanations of complex concepts with scriptural references and the words of the Gunatit Guru Parampara 
- Compilation of quotations by Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the Guru Parampara to enhance the theoretical and practical interpretations of subtle concepts
- Interesting introductions to various people, places and scriptures
- Historical accounts, Prasangs, Explanations, Glory and Summaries related to the Vachanamrut
- References and meanings of shloks as well as kirtans mentioned in the Vachanamrut
- New look and feel
- English translations of History, Prasangs, Explanations, Glory and Summary to complement the Gujarati text
- Access the Vachanamrut that you last visited from the Home Page
- Auto-rotate view available to ease your reading
- Audio feature to enhance the reading experience
- Subject-wise reading options
- Bookmark function to access the marked position in the Vachanamrut directly from the Home Page
- Tapping on the “Read” button will automatically take you to the next Vachanamrut without having to swipe. This can be enabled from within settings
- View the history of all the Vachanamruts you have visited
- Back-up and restore the app

bluejetty:00147908:ios.description:
myBlu is the delivery companion for orders shipped with ShipBlu. Sign in with the phone number you gave the store and every shipment on its way to you appears in one place, with live tracking, online payment and a QR code to receive it.
TRACK EVERY STEP
• See your active shipments and delivery history at a glance
• Follow a step-by-step timeline from pickup to your door
• Know the estimated delivery date and get a push notification the moment anything changes
• Confirm or dispute a reported delivery attempt in one tap
PAY ONLINE, SKIP THE CASH
• Pay the cash-on-delivery amount before the courier arrives
• Cards and mobile wallets, processed on a secure payment page
• See the amount, fees and VAT before you confirm
• Review every payment under Transactions, and request a refund if a paid order is returned
RECEIVE WITH A QR CODE
• Paid orders get one QR code per package
• Show it to the courier, or share it with someone you trust to receive on your behalf
MADE FOR YOU
• Arabic and English, with full right-to-left support
• Light and night modes
• Rate your delivery experience after each order
• Chat with ShipBlu support from inside the app, with your shipment details already attached
• Sign in with a one-time SMS code. No passwords to remember
myBlu is for people receiving shipments handled by ShipBlu. If you do not see your orders, make sure you signed in with the same phone number the store has on file for you.

bluejetty:00025344:android.description:

The XCAD app allows viewers to earn Creator tokens while watching their favourite Creators. Viewers can earn, view and trade Creator tokens all through the app. The app works in the background while you watch videos via the in-app browser.

bluejetty:00021261:ios.description:
Welcome to the easiest way to book using a Flight Pass.
Please note: You will need to have an active Flight Pass account to use this app. 
Wondering what a Flight Pass is? A Flight Pass is a prepaid package of one-way flight credits used for travel. Learn more about Flight Passes here: http://flyac.ca/flightpass.
BOOK A FLIGHT
- Complete a booking in as little as 6 taps of your thumb, with the Flight Pass App’s friendly one-handed design.
- Tell us where you’re going, and the Flight Pass App will suggest which one of your passes to use. We took the guesswork out of it, so you can get where you need to go.
- Find the perfect flight by quickly sorting through available flights by duration, and time of day.
SYNC YOUR BOOKINGS
- Book on the website? All of your bookings, just as you’d expect, now appear in the Flight Pass app. Easily see where you’ve been, and where you’re going next.
MANAGE YOUR BOOKINGS
- Change or cancel your bookings with ease, directly from the Booking Details screen.
GET YOUR UPGRADE
- Travelling on a Flight Pass that offers complimentary upgrade? Request your upgrade directly in the Flight Pass App (lucky you!)
YOUR FLIGHT PASSES
- A central place to review all of the Flight Passes you own, administer, or travel on.
- See all the details of your Flight Pass, including credit balance, and booking history.
- Have a Flight Pass paid over several instalments? Complete your payment directly from the ‘Your Flight Passes’ section.
- Have a Flight Pass eligible for extension? Extend your Flight Pass directly from the 'Your Flight Passes' section.
IMPORTANT DISCLOSURES
These functions apply when enabled:
- Location: your location data is used to show the closest airport for booking.
By pressing the “Install” button or by downloading the app, or setting up your device to do so automatically, you consent to the installation of the app, its future updates and upgrades and to the app Terms of Use (“Terms of Use”) that govern the use of the app that are available here: http://www.aircanada.com/en/mobile/tc_ios.html. You can withdraw your consent at any time by uninstalling the app. For help uninstalling the app, please contact us at iphone@aircanada.ca.

By downloading or updating this app, you understand that Air Canada may: collect data about your device in order to serve you the correct software, as well as maintain and develop its services; require that you change some of your device settings to use specific features; collect personal information as detailed in our Privacy Policy. For more information, please see http://www.aircanada.com/en/about/legal/privacy/policy.html

bluejetty:00183759:ios.description:
Az OTP SmartBank IOS alkalmazás segítségével könnyedén és bárhol igénybe tudja venni az OTP Bank szolgáltatásait.
Technikai feltételek
- Op.rendszer (iPhone, iPad): min. iOS 11.0
- iPad-en mobil design
Módosított operációs rendszerrel rendelkező (jailbreakelt) készülékek esetében a SmartBank alkalmazás új verziója nem elérhető.
Az alkalmazás letöltésével és használatával Ön elfogadja az OTP Bank honlapján található Általános Adatkezelési Tájékoztatójában foglalt tájékoztatást személyes adatainak kezelésével kapcsolatban. 
2022. március 24-től kivezetésre kerül a SmartBank szolgáltatás a lakossági ügyfélkörben, helyét az új OTP MobilBank veszi át. A részlekről az OTP Bank honlapján olvashat.
OTPdirekt SmartBank
Az OTP SmartBank használatához regisztráció szükséges, melyet az alkalmazás letöltését és megnyitását követően végezhet el. Ennek során az internetbanki azonosítók (Azonosító, számlaszám, jelszó) ésegy 6-8 számjegyből álló PIN kód megadása szükséges. A PIN kód az arra alkalmas készülékeken helyettesíthető ujjlenyomat azonosítással is. A Mobil Aláíráshoz használt telefonszámra kapott SMS kód megadását követően a szolgáltatás azonnal igénybe vehető.
Funkciók (lakossági és vállalkozói bankszámlák és lakossági hitelkártya számlákra):
- Belföldi forint átutalás, bankon belüli deviza átutalás, jövőbeni utalások
- OTP kártyák közötti utalás (lakossági bankszámlák)
- Csekkbeolvasás
- Számla részletes adatai, számlatörténet
- Tranzakciók ellenőrzése
- Tranzakciók aláírása (vállalkozói bankszámlák)
- Bankkártya adatok lekérdezése, limitmódosítás, aktiválás, letiltás és webKÁRTYA adatok lekérdezése (lakossági bankszámlák, hitelszámlák)
- Bankkártya hozzáadás az Apple Wallet-hez
- Autópálya-matrica vásárlás
- Mobil feltöltés
- Lekötött betétek lekérdezése, feltörése
- Új betét lekötés
- Vásárlási kedvezmények regisztráció, ajánlatok, lekérdezés
- Beállítások:PIN módosítás, gyors egyenleg engedélyezése, ujjlenyomat engedélyezése, profilbeállítás
- Postaláda
- Internetes vásárlás (webshop)
- OTPdirekt internetes szolgáltatásba történő belépés/tranzakció jóváhagyás QR-olvasással
- Valuta/deviza árfolyamok lekérdezése
- Pénzváltó, ATM és bankfiók kereső
Using OTP Bank’s SmartBank iOS application, you can easily access OTP Bank’s electronic banking services.
Technical requirements
- OS: at least 11.0 or higher (iPhone,iPad)
- iPads with mobile design
In the case of jailbroken devices, the SmartBank application's new version is not available.
Please read our privacy policy before downloading the Smartbank Application. You can rady our privacy policy on www.otpbank.hu.
From March 24, 2022, the SmartBank service will be phased out in the retail clientele and will be replaced with the new OTP MobilBank application. You can read about the details on www.otpbank.hu.
OTP SmartBank
To use SmartBank, you need to register in the application, which requires your internetbank identifier and a 6-8 digit PIN code. The PIN code can be substituted by a fingerprint if the device is capable. To finish the registration, providing an SMS code is necessary. 
Functions
- Domestic Forint transfers, Foreign currency transfers, Repeating transactions
- Card-to-card transfers (for retail accounts)
- Cheque scanning
- Account details, Account history
- Check transactions
- Sign transactions (for corporate accounts)
- Future transfers
- Bankcard details, changing limits, activation blockage and webCARD details (for retail accounts)
- Bankcard menu, Add To Apple Pay Wallet
- Motorway ticket
- Mobile phone top-up
- Time deposits (details and early mature)
- New time deposit
- „Vásárlási kedvezmények” registration, offers, query
- Settings: blocking access, changing password, enable multitasking, profile settings
- Messages
- Online purchase

bluejetty:00100724:ios.description:
Discover new stories and worlds in Chinese!
Ready to move beyond flashcards and graded readers? Readibu is your portal to the world of popular Chinese web novels, short stories and children stories enjoyed by native readers — or bring your own books and read them the same way. From historical to sci-fi or romance to horror, there's always something good to read.
Readibu is a Chinese reading app where you can:
1. Explore popular web novels, short stories, and children stories from native Chinese sites — browse by ranking, category, or search
2. Import your own EPUB, PDF, or TXT files and read them alongside your web library
3. Tap on characters for definitions
4. Open web pages in a reader for immersive reading
5. Absorb the language while you're immersed in gripping adventures
Supported features:
• Tap for dictionary
• Text-to-speech
• Simplified and traditional conversion
• Pinyin/zhuyin display over words
• Add custom url to display in reader
• Import EPUB, PDF, and TXT files into your library
• Organize your reading with collections, bookmarks, and history
• Check the difficulty of any text with HSK-level breakdowns
• Look up words in Pleco, MDBG, Yellow Bridge, Baidu Translate, and more
• Export saved vocabularies
• Auto-detect next chapter
• Auto-save last page you were on
• Back up and restore your library and vocabulary
================================
ENHANCE YOUR READING EXPERIENCE WITH READIBU PREMIUM
• Cloud sync - Sync subscription, library, bookmarks, vocabs and reading progress between devices
• Sentence Translation - Unlimited translation by Google Translate
• Image Search - Display image search results for selected text
• Offline Reading - Download pages for reading offline
• Quiz Mode - Quiz your pinyin, tones, and definitions of words you looked up before
• Smart Name Recognition - Detect names of people, orgs and places in content
• Syntax Analysis - Analyze syntax of sentence
Free trials included with all plans!
1-month subscription: $4.99 per month
3-month subscription: $9.99 per month
12-month subscription: $47.99 per year
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the end of your free trial period. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period or trial. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Itunes Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.readibu.com/privacy
Terms & Conditions: https://www.readibu.com/terms
Have questions? Feel free to contact us at support@readibu.com.

bluejetty:00089753:android.name: Abhi - Your Salary Now!
bluejetty:00089753:android.summary: ABHI is Pakistan’s first financial wellness platform. Abhi is licensed and registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) under Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) and a whitelisted Digital Lending app from SECP & ad
bluejetty:00089753:android.description:
ABHI is Pakistan’s first financial wellness platform. Abhi is licensed and registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) under Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) and a whitelisted Digital Lending app from SECP & adheres to the effective regulatory compliance for Earned Wage Access (EWA). We empower salaried individuals by providing them access to their earned salaries anytime, anywhere through the ABHI App. Employees having their employers registered with Abhi can access Abhi's services, which saves operational hassle of managing salary advances for HR and Finance teams, and gives financial empowerment to employees. 
How it works?
Login with your CNIC (after your company is registered with us). Request the amount you want to withdraw from your earned salary. You can transfer the money into your salary bank account. The total transacted amount + transaction charges will automatically be deducted from your next month’s salary. For more information visit www.abhi.com.pk or drop us an email at connect@abhi.com.pk.
NOTE: As per the regulatory framework, EWA is not a loan and repayment is made in the next month's payroll cycle irrespective of the day you withdraw, and there is no APR associated with it, only fixed transaction charges for using the service that the employee consent to before transaction.

Combine crazy mutant sloth species to create surprising new breeds of these slow-blooming creatures and discover their hidden potenti
bluejetty:00150261:ios.description:
Being named after the laziest deadly sin gave sloths an unfair stigma, and it’s up to you to change that!
Combine crazy mutant sloth species to create surprising new breeds of these slow-blooming creatures and discover their hidden potential!
You’ll find that sloths can be loving pets, highly proficient climbers and incredibly efficient trackers…
If you’re willing to wait a little, that is.
LAZY FEATURES
- Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
-Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the sloths
HOW TO PLAY
- Drag and drop similar sloths to create new mysterious creatures
-Use sloth eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
-Alternatively, fiercely tap a sloth to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
-Different stages and many sloth species to discover
-A mind-blowing story with awesome (but slowly-developing) twists!
-The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
-Doodle-like illustrations
-Open-ended gameplay: enjoy the freedom!
-No sloths were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Sloth wisdom: the best things take a loooooooong time to happen.
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq
