bluejetty:00180223:ios.name: xTerminal - SSH Terminal Shell
bluejetty:00180223:ios.summary:
xTerminal - Your Ultimate SSH Terminal Shell
xTerminal is your all-in-one SSH terminal client for managing servers with speed and security. Whether you're an IT professional or a developer, xTerminal gives you the tools to easily connect,
bluejetty:00180223:ios.description:
xTerminal - Your Ultimate SSH Terminal Shell
xTerminal is your all-in-one SSH terminal client for managing servers with speed and security. Whether you're an IT professional or a developer, xTerminal gives you the tools to easily connect, control, and manage your servers from anywhere.
Key Features:
* Interactive SSH Terminal: A fast, reliable terminal for executing commands on your servers. Eg: Use top to monitor system status or follow logs with tail -f.
* Powerful Editor: Edit documents with vi/vim just like on a desktop, with full support for CTRL and arrow keys, making your SSH terminal experience smooth.
* Multi-Session Management: Manage multiple SSH connections at once. Add, remove, and switch between sessions with ease, boosting your productivity.
* Snippets: Save and organize frequently used SSH commands. Quickly search by name, command, or label, making repeated tasks quicker and simpler.
* Device Management: Add your SSH servers, group them by labels, and search by name, host, or labels. Connect via password or public key authentication.
* Advanced SSH Options: Support for SSH jump hosts and SOCKS5 proxies for enhanced security and flexible connections.
* SFTP for File Management: Upload, download, edit, move, and delete files using the built-in SFTP, allowing you to manage files on your servers directly from the terminal.
* Keep Sessions Alive: Use “Keep Awake” and “Keep Alive” features to maintain persistent SSH connections without interruptions.
* User-Friendly Interface: Simple navigation with pull-to-refresh, search highlights, sortable lists, and drag-and-drop to reorder devices or snippets.
* Live Ping Monitoring: Check device connectivity in real-time with ping stats, including ms and TTL, helping you monitor the health of your network.
* Discover Network Devices: Easily find and save neighboring network devices for quick access later.
* Secure Port Knocking: Add an extra layer of protection by using port knocking to guard your servers from unauthorized access.
* Enhanced Security: Use TouchID/FaceID to protect your SSH sessions, ensuring secure access to your terminal on app launch or resume.
* iCloud Sync: Backup and restore your device and snippet lists across all iOS devices, ensuring seamless access to your settings anywhere.
* Copy & Paste: Effortlessly run commands from the clipboard or copy terminal output, streamlining your workflow in the terminal.
* Universal App: Optimized for both iPhone and iPad, giving you a consistent experience across devices.
* Secure Data Storage: All credentials and data are stored securely on your device, so you can rest assured your information is safe.
* Batch Execution: Execute commands on multiple servers at once and view all the outputs in one go.
* Startup Snippets: Set up essential commands to run on app startup, giving you immediate access to critical tasks as soon as you connect.
xTerminal is built for anyone needing a fast, reliable, and secure SSH terminal. It’s perfect for managing remote servers on various platforms, including macOS, Linux, OpenBSD, FreeBSD, NetBSD, Solaris, and OpenVMS.

bluejetty:00171752:ios.description:
Far away in the frozen wilderness, a spark of hope survives…
As leader of a small band of survivors, you must build, craft, and manage life in a land where the cold never ends.
From a lonely campfire to a thriving Casual Survival Simulation village, every choice matters — gather scarce resources, upgrade shelters, assign jobs, and unlock crafting tools.
This isn’t just growth, it’s Survival. Protect your people, balance progress with safety, and lead them to endure against the icy winds.
Survive & Expand
The cold never ends! Gather wood, stone, and food to keep your villagers alive. Manage resources carefully in this Resource Management & Survival challenge.
Crafting & Upgrades
Unlock tools, craft shelters, and upgrade buildings to protect your people. From simple huts to powerful workshops, every upgrade helps your community grow stronger.
True Idle Fun

- Survival in a snowy wilderness
- Crafting & building system
- Idle progress & offline rewards
- Village growth & resource management
- Relaxing yet strategic Casual gameplay

bluejetty:00035920:ios.description:
Maze Zen – Find Your Center, Find Yourself
Tilt. Glide. Breathe. With every subtle shift of your device, your world slows down, and your focus sharpens. In Maze Zen, the journey is as essential as the destination—a tranquil dance between motion and stillness, where you guide a lone ball to the heart of a circular maze.
Like meditation, Maze Zen invites you to silence the noise, draw inward, and awaken the present moment. Each level is a passage not just through the maze, but through your own inner landscape. The twist and turn of the labyrinth mirror the winding paths of life. The ball you guide? A reflection of your mind—restless, seeking, but destined to find its still center.
“When the player finds their center, wisdom blooms.” - Autonomous
Arriving at the goal, you’re greeted by words of insight from great minds—philosophers, zen masters, and sages—reminding you that truth lies in simplicity. These reflections gently guide you toward clarity and deeper understanding, encouraging you to carry that wisdom into your life beyond the game.
The movements in Maze Zen are more than mechanics—they are moments of mindfulness. In the space between tilts, you reconnect with your breath. In the stillness of the center, you glimpse a spark of something profound—a quiet sense of belonging, a reminder that the answers are already within you.
Why play Maze Zen?
- Experience the calm of a meditative journey anytime, anywhere.
- Train your mind to focus and find balance amid chaos.
- Unlock profound reflections from the wisest thinkers, one maze at a time.
- Evoke a sense of peace and purpose in your daily routine.
In a world that rushes, Maze Zen offers pause.
In a world full of distractions, it offers focus.
And in a world of endless noise, it offers silence.
Let go of haste. Embrace the journey. Download Maze Zen today and discover that the act of finding your center—both in the game and in life—may be the truest path toward peace.
Your journey to understanding begins with a simple tilt.
Will you find your way?
==========================================
TIPS
- TIP: On Apple Watch, Tinker with the Digital Crown to find your color mood.
- TIP: On iPhone, Pinch the screen on iPhone to find your color mood.
- TIP: On older Apple Watches, in Apple Watch Settings, enable Wake for 70s for best results and fiddle with the digital crown to keep playing.

bluejetty:00100733:ios.description:
HONORS FOR MILLIE WAS HERE
• A Kirkus “Best Book of the Year” Winner
• A Washington Post’s “Best Apps to Give and Get”
• Editor’s Choice, Children’s Technology Review
THE CRITICS LOVE MILLIE
“Millie offers the kind of humor that appeals to both kids and parents on different levels.” —Common Sense Media
“She’s a good dog with a great set of apps." —Kirkus
"My daughter 'oohed' and 'ahhed' over the adorable art, has already replayed it several times, and has asked me to download more Millie books for her.” —WIRED
“Children’s storybook apps have all begun to look alike, but Megapops’ interactive reading experience Millie Was Here stands alone as the pick of the litter.” —The Horn Book
GIVE US YOUR PAW AND WE’LL GIVE YOU A TREAT!
Get ready to steer the action, reveal surprises, play games, and collect stickers along the way in this hilarious book app—the second in the Millie Was HereTM series.
YOU'LL HOWL WITH LAUGHTER
Millie is an adorable but mischievous mutt who turns real life into a real adventure, and this is her first full length story. A simple walk in New York’s Central Park quickly becomes a walk on the wild side, as you help Millie explore a “dense jungle” filled with delightful surprises. You’ll learn secrets from a “wise old unicorn,” tame “wild piranhas,” and take on a “band of pirates,” all in a quest for a priceless treasure: The Lost Key to Endless Bacon!
THE TALL “TAILS” OF A SHORT DOG
The Millie books combine real-life photographs with fantastical art and story elements to create far-fetched, humorous “fairytales” for kids. They’re a lighthearted, modern twist on a classic format, and everyone’s in on the joke.
TEACHING OLD SKILLS USING NEW TRICKS
Our goal is to use a technology to which kids are naturally drawn to foster a love of reading, promote imaginative and inferential thinking, and help kids develop cognitive, creative, language, and motor skills. Education and language specialists have found that even the most reluctant readers are enticed to read Millie’s books. 
THIS PUPPY WAS BORN DIGITAL
The Millie Was HereTM series was created from the ground up as an interactive reading experience for iOS devices. It wasn't adapted from a book, film, or television show—so its interactivity and mixed-media design are built right into the story, not added on later. The result is interactivity that feels intuitive, natural, and fully integrated into the narrative. 
FEATURES
• Read-along text (highlights words as they are read)
• Interactivity on every page, including digital pop-ups, mini games, and more
• Packed with exciting video clips and animation
• Virtual stickers hidden on every page, and a sticker book for your collection
• "Classroom Mode" allows educators to control the pace
• Card Maker creative activity
• Language Switch allows instant language changes from the home screen
• Innovative “Bedtime Mode” creates a calmer experience for nighttime reading
• Two reading modes allow users to choose between having the book read to them, or reading it themselves.
• Original music and fun sound effects
• Professional dramatic narration 
• Beautiful, original artwork and photography
• A cute dog on every page!
Millie Was Here is now available in 11 languages! 
PRIVACY
Megapops takes children's privacy very seriously. Our apps do not collect any personal information or include in-app purchases. For more information, please see our privacy policy: www.megapops.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00140711:ios.description:
Camera Finder is designed to carefully find and connect all the cameras in your home and help you detect or connect camera devices when the cameras are connected to your home network.Protect your privacy and give your home environment peace of mind.
**Detect Cameras With Precision**
Camera Finder swiftly scans your surroundings and pinpoints the presence of cameras, irrespective of their brand or make. 
**Comprehensive WiFi Network Analysis**
Camera Finder performs a rapid scan of all WiFi networks within seconds, revealing every device connected. This thorough inspection allows you to take charge of your network security by keeping track of unknown connections.
**Accurate Device Identification**
Our app provides you with meticulous details about each detected device, including IP addresses, MAC addresses, device names, and models. This precise identification aids in monitoring your network and prevents unauthorized access.
**Network Performance Tools**
Camera Finder includes tools to test your internet and network speed, conduct ping tests for real-time connection quality, and employ Whois Lookup to gather domain information. These features help maintain optimal network performance and troubleshoot issues proactively.
**Search Beyond WiFi**
Expanding the realm of security, Camera Finder integrates additional search capabilities for Bluetooth devices and electromagnetic signals. This multi-layered approach ensures all possible avenues for surveillance are accounted for, offering you a comprehensive sweep for unwarranted devices.Enhance your sense of security and take control of your privacy.
About subscription:
– The user confirms the purchase and pays using their iTunes account. If you need to cancel the renewal, please manually turn off the automatic renewal function in the management 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
– The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal fee will be determined. User management, auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Privacy Policy: https://app.appurple.com/log/appurple/page?page=page1
Terms of Use: https://app.appurple.com/log/appurple/page?page=page2

bluejetty:00157906:ios.description:
No Contact tracker is the #1 way to break free from your ex. Following the no contact rule is the best way to heal.
Healing from a breakup can be tough, but you don’t have to go through it alone. No Contact is here to help you maintain no contact, move on with confidence, and regain your strength. With No Contact, you’ll feel empowered to let go and move on.
WHY YOU NEED NOCONTACT:
Stay Consistent
90% of people break no contact at some point, but the key to moving on is consistency. NoContact keeps you motivated, so you don’t cave in.
No Contact Tracker
Remembering why you started is key to moving on. The longer you see your progress, the less likely you are to cave in.
Give It Time
It takes about 90 days to get over an ex, and we’re here to help you through each stage. NoContact shortens that down to a 30 day plan.
Regain Confidence
Regain confidence and clarity as you heal—no need to rush, just follow the steps at your own pace.
Join Thousands of Healers
Join thousands of others who have successfully healed, moved on, and grown stronger through the power of no contact.

Personalized No Contact Rule Plan*

AI Therapist & Journaling*

Progress Tracking*

Community*
Find others going through the same breakup healing.
Achievements & Motivation*
Unlock achievements as you stay strong and resist temptations to contact your ex.

When you’re tempted to reach out, activate our emergency mode to get support and stay on track.
Breakup Advice & Resources*
Access a library of articles and expert advice on moving on, coping with emotions, and building a stronger you.
Instant Affirmations*
Receive daily affirmations and reminders to stay focused on your goals.

🔮*Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)*🔮
1️⃣ How does UpRock work?
UpRock lets you earn rewards by participating in optional activities like playing games, answering surveys, uploading shopping receipts, and more. Some rewards are earned by completing offers, while others are earned passively when the app is running. You always choose when to participate, and you can start or stop at any time.
2️⃣ What are UpRock Points?
UpRock Points (UPTP) are in-app rewards you earn for completing activities in the UpRock app, such as games, surveys, and other promotions. As you complete activities, your UPTP is added to your Wallet so you can easily track your rewards in one place.
3️⃣ What are Rocket Boosts?
Rocket Boosts are temporary bonuses that increase how much you earn in the UpRock app. You can earn Rocket Boosts by completing certain activities, achievements, or promotions in the app. While a boost is active, it automatically applies to your earn rate and helps you earn more rewards during that time.
Rocket Boosts are optional, have a limited duration, and expire automatically when they end.
4️⃣ How do I earn rewards?
You can earn rewards on UpRock by completing simple activities in the app. Depending on your device, available earning options may include:
* Playing games
* Answering surveys
* Uploading shopping receipts
* Referring new users
* Staking tokens
* Unlocking achievements
In addition to these activities, some rewards are earned automatically while the app is open, based on your participation and availability.
5️⃣ Is there a cost to use this app? 
No, UpRock is free to download and use. The longer you contribute, the more you earn.
6️⃣ I need help. How can I contact support?
We're here for you! Just reach out to our support team via the contact info provided in the app.
To stay updated, please visit uprock.com and sign up for our newsletter or follow us on https://x.com/uprockcom. 
Join us today! Download UpRock AI Earnings and be part of the solution. Make passive income and shape the future of the AI era! 🚀🎉

bluejetty:00098397:ios.description:
Play thousands of games instantly, all inside one app. No installs. Big games! 
CrazyGames puts a whole gaming universe in your pocket, without taking up your phone’s storage.
Tap a game and start playing right away. No long downloads. No updates. No waiting.
Play popular hits like Mahjongg Solitaire, 8 Ball Pool, Space Waves, Ragdoll Archers, Bloxd and many more, all in one app.
From quick casual fun to action-packed battles, CrazyGames has games for everyone:
- Casual & relaxing games
- Puzzles, brain teasers & logic challenges
- Action, shooting & strategy
- .io games and online battles
- Car & racing games
- Merge, tycoon & idle
- Multiplayer & 2-player titles
- Sports, arcade, and much more
Why players love CrazyGames
- Lightweight install, takes up very little space on your phone
- Instant play, no extra downloads, no waiting
- 1500+ games in one app, explore tons of genres in seconds
- Simple and beautiful, clean design that puts games first
- New games every day, always something new
- Cross-device sync, save favorites and continue on mobile or desktop
- Popular hits included, play games you already know and love

.io & Battle Arena: fast online battles
Car & Racing: drift, drag, park and stunt
Puzzle & Brain Games: match-3, escape rooms, logic puzzles
Multiplayer: PVP shooters, party games, football and more
Idle & Tycoon: satisfying tap-and-upgrade progress
Sports: pool, soccer, basketball, and classics
Arcade: timeless pick-up-and-play favorites
How it works
1. Install CrazyGames, it’s small and lightweight
2. Browse or search by keywords like “multiplayer”, “car games”, “puzzle” or “adventure”
3. Tap Play, your game starts instantly
4. Tap the heart icon to save favorites and pick up anytime
So what are you waiting for? Go discover your next favorite game!

bluejetty:00131436:ios.description:

∙ Sign up and complete Chevron Texaco Rewards account in the app

∙ Fill up when prompted, then view your receipt in the app  
More ways to use the app 
∙ Find participating locations and filter by amenities 
∙ Connect your phone to your car dashboard with Apple CarPlay 
∙ Use your Apple Watch to fuel up and redeem rewards at participating locations that accept mobile payments 
∙ View rewards, track savings, and access in-app receipts

• Generate garden design ideas from a photo
• Visualize backyard landscaping before starting work
• Explore patio, deck, pergola, pool, and outdoor kitchen layouts
• Plan planting, hardscaping, lighting, and decorative features
• Personalize your design with text instructions such as adding flowers, creating open space, moving or replacing objects, or generating a daytime or nighttime look

bluejetty:00182690:ios.name: Preflop+ Poker GTO Nash Charts
bluejetty:00182690:ios.summary: Preflop+ is a poker math and preflop chart app for iPhone and iPad. It gives you Nash equilibrium shove/fold charts with the exact EV of every decision, five interactive training drills, and a full set of poker calculators — all working off
bluejetty:00182690:ios.description:
Preflop+ is a poker math and preflop chart app for iPhone and iPad. It gives you Nash equilibrium shove/fold charts with the exact EV of every decision, five interactive training drills, and a full set of poker calculators — all working offline with no internet connection.
"Preflop+ is a great tool. It takes all the Nash Charts and distills them at your fingertips. It is far better than other apps as it displays EV of what each hand will be earning." — Matt Berkey, High Stakes Cash Game Pro and Founder, Solve For Why Academy
"I use the app every single day to improve my ability to quickly calculate pot odds and equity situations — invaluable in the live setting." — Lara Eisenberg, WSOP Bracelet Winner
WHY EXACT EVs MATTER
Most shove/fold apps give you a binary answer: shove or fold. That's fine at the extremes and useless at the margin. Preflop+ shows the actual EV of every hole card for shove, call, rejam, and call-rejam, so you can see which spots are genuinely close. When you have an edge on the table, you can pass on a marginally +EV shove. When you're short and card-dead, you can find the spots that are barely profitable and take them. The number tells you what the label can't.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Nash Shove/Fold Charts — exact EVs for shove, call, rejam, and call-rejam across stack sizes from 5bb to 25bb and above, every position, and every player count
• Equity Calculator — hand vs hand, hand vs range, range vs range, on any street: preflop, flop, turn, and river
• Equity Drills — interactive quizzes to sharpen equity estimation for fast decisions in live games

bluejetty:00023293:ios.summary:
Build timers that guide you through every step. Hear the next stretching instruction, follow a cooking sequence, or alternate activity and rest—with spoken announcements, sounds and clear visual progress.
Start with a ready-made preset, th
bluejetty:00023293:ios.description:
Build timers that guide you through every step. Hear the next stretching instruction, follow a cooking sequence, or alternate activity and rest—with spoken announcements, sounds and clear visual progress.
Start with a ready-made preset, then adapt it to your routine. From a simple countdown to a workout with several stages, choose your cues and preview the sequence before you begin. Try the Stretching preset for an example with spoken guidance.
HEAR WHAT COMES NEXT
Create cues such as “Hold the stretch” or “Round 3 of 5.” Combine your own text with timer and event names, round numbers, elapsed or remaining time, and the current clock time. Choose a voice and delay speech to let an alarm sound first. Use the same text and variables in on-screen messages and notifications.
SET THE PACE OF YOUR ROUTINE
Build intervals for HIIT, Tabata, stretching, meditation or study breaks. You can also time turns in board games.
• Choose a duration or a specific finish time, with an optional preparation delay.
• Repeat for a set number of rounds or indefinitely.
• Schedule cues at specific times of day, relative to the start or end, or at regular intervals. Use times or percentages—for example, a gong 30 seconds before the end or a tick every second.
• Run an event every round, only the first or last, or a range such as rounds 3–5. End actions can run every round or only after the final one.
SAVE IT ONCE, USE IT AGAIN
Run several timers at once. Use events to control timers, display a timer or open a URL. Add, reorder and hide timers to keep the ones you need within reach. Save your setups as presets, organize them, and import or export them to reuse or share.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Display remaining time, elapsed time, the clock or graphical progress in two customizable areas. Switch to full screen for a larger view, in portrait or landscape. Keep track of the current round, dim the display for a less intrusive screen, and lock the controls while keeping the time visible. Choose whether to stop at the end or keep showing the time elapsed since finishing.
MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Choose bells, gongs and other alarms, or import and record your own sounds. Try Shepard tones: sequences that seem to rise or fall endlessly in pitch. Play a song from your music library, choose a random track from a playlist, or schedule music to stop.
Prefer silent cues? Use on-screen messages, vibrations or a flashing screen. Customize colors and backgrounds, and search over 1,800 icons. On supported devices, you can also schedule photos or use the flashlight as a visual cue.
In the background, scheduled notifications can display messages and play sounds. Snooze reminders directly from notifications, choose whether to show round and notification numbers, or tap to run your configured timer controls or open a URL. Spoken announcements and photos require Timer to stay open.

• Schedule cues at specific times of day, relative to the start or end, or at regular intervals. Use times or percentages—for example, a gong 30 seconds before the end or a tick every second.
• Run an event every round, only the first or last, or a range such as rounds 3–5. End actions can run every round or only after the final one.

SAVE IT ONCE, USE IT AGAIN
Run several timers at once. Use events to control timers, display a timer or open a URL. Add, reorder and hide timers to keep the ones you need within reach. Save your setups as presets, organize them, and import or export them to reuse or share.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Display remaining time, elapsed time, the clock or graphical progress in two customizable areas. Switch to full screen for a larger view, in portrait or landscape. Keep track of the current round, dim the display for a less intrusive screen, and lock the controls while keeping the time visible. Choose whether to stop at the end or keep showing the time elapsed since finishing.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Choose bells, gongs and other alarms, or import and record your own sounds. Try Shepard tones: sequences that seem to rise or fall endlessly in pitch. Play a song from your music library, choose a random track from a playlist, or schedule music to stop.

Prefer silent cues? Use on-screen messages, vibrations or a flashing screen. Customize colors and backgrounds, and search over 1,800 icons. On supported devices, you can also schedule photos or use the flashlight as a visual cue.

In the background, scheduled notifications can display messages and play sounds. Snooze reminders directly from notifications, choose whether to show round and notification numbers, or tap to run your configured timer controls or open a URL. Spoken announcements and photos require Timer to stay open.

bluejetty:00062465:ios.summary:
Learn languages like kids. Effortlessly.
Have you been learning a new language for a while and still can‘t speak it? Have you tried different language apps but got nowhere? Do you do language exercises but still can't put together even a s
bluejetty:00062465:ios.description:
Learn languages like kids. Effortlessly.
Have you been learning a new language for a while and still can‘t speak it? Have you tried different language apps but got nowhere? Do you do language exercises but still can't put together even a simple sentence? Do you just tap on the screen expecting to start speaking?
With Mooveez, you'll learn to speak effortlessly and well. You won't learn a new language the traditional way, but you'll pick it up naturally, the way children learn their own native language. Our method is based on the same principles of natural learning that you use to learn a native language. It is based on four steps.
Learning effortlessly in 4 steps:
• Everyday listening 
• Quick comprehension 
• Imitation instead of rules 
• Active speaking 
Mooveez was awarded the Global Innovation of the Year Award by the British Council in London.
Mooveez has over 1 million downloads and counting!
Why Mooveez?
• An effortless language learning method - our method is scientifically proven. We collaborate with a team of experts from the Faculty of Arts at Charles University in Prague, who work on natural language acquisition in children and adults.
• A variety of languages - learn English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Czech and Russian for free!
• Animated videos and stories - these unique videos make it easy to learn a new language.
• 10x more listening than with other apps - listening is important in order to learn a language naturally which is why we have created a lot of listening material in Mooveez.
• Practical phrases and basic vocabulary - we've selected 1,000 of the most common words and phrases, which make up 80% of the most frequently spoken words in the language.
• 7x more speaking than in other apps - at Mooveez, we've made it our goal to get you talking. That's why our users imitate native speakers in activities with voice recognition that allows them to check their recorded pronunciation against the original.
• A wide range of language lessons - there are over 1,300 lessons across 8 languages for you to learn languages with in Mooveez. All are neatly divided into topics like travel, family, work, shopping and more!
• Learn based on YOUR needs - there is no fixed curriculum at Mooveez. Choose what you learn and when you learn. You’re in charge of your learning.
• Measurable progress - at the end of each lesson, there is a short practical test for you to do so you can track your progress.
• Premium version - For those who want to learn a new language faster, we have a paid version that includes much more learning material. This will accelerate your progress in the language even more!
What our users say about us: 
• “Fun way to learn!
• “I really like this app, it has more options in languages than Duolingo, I love it so far!”
• “Quite different. An excellent way to overcome the trepidation of speaking out loud.”
• “I wanted to learn basic Spanish for my vacation and it worked! Might try some other languages as well. Thanks!”
• “I am really liking this app for English beginners. I am testing it to recommend to some of my students who have a hard time understanding and speaking. I'm loving it!”
Try this unique method based on the principles of natural language learning. Principles we all know but have forgotten. Rediscover your natural ability to learn to speak any language.
Let us know how you go with this method. Write to us with your thoughts and comments. We'd love to read them at: info@mooveez.com.
Thank you for choosing Mooveez! 
Miroslav Pešta
Founder of Mooveez

bluejetty:00121782:ios.name: Is It Love? Ryan - You choose
bluejetty:00121782:ios.summary: Embark on a romantic adventure worthy of the greatest TV series, find the love of your life, start a family and become a real businesswoman alongside the mysterious and charismatic Ryan Carter. Play all three seasons of ""Is It Love? Ryan""
bluejetty:00121782:ios.description:
Embark on a romantic adventure worthy of the greatest TV series, find the love of your life, start a family and become a real businesswoman alongside the mysterious and charismatic Ryan Carter. Play all three seasons of ""Is It Love? Ryan"" and immerse yourself in an incredible success story! Make your own choices throughout the episodes of this visual novel!
The story: 
Your story begins in the heart of the bustling city of New York. You have a nice apartment in town and your best friends, Matt and Lisa, are always there for you. You started your career as a Marketing Assistant at Carter Corp, the most influential company in the United States, and you are now managing your own Humanitarian and Environmental branch.
But an unexpected event turned your life upside down: you met Ryan Carter, the mysterious and untamable CEO of Carter Corp. It's love at first sight, and thanks to him you will learn to become a better version of yourself, both humanly and professionally. Tame the big boss, face the consequences of your relationship and become unstoppable in the eyes of all. But beware, the love games you play can come at a cost...
Features: 
• Your choices impact the storyline
• Interactive narrative game 100% in English
• A visual, sensorial and emotional adventure
• Ryan Carter is back for a last season!
• Photo-realistic backgrounds
• A new chapter every 3 weeks (11 chapters in total)
• Two secret scenes per chapter
• Regular additional content: Extra Love stories, Extra Event stories
Cast:
Ryan Carter - CEO and Founder of Carter Corp
Charismatic, magnetic, bossy... 
Parker Snow - Journalist
Clever, ambitious, well-informed...
Thomas Gordon - Matt's coworker
Womanizer, clumsy, kind-hearted...
Mark Leviels - Carter Corp Branch Manager
Intellectual, workaholic, quiet...
Jenny Blake - Business Partner
Protective, stubborn, passionate about cooking...
Matt Ortega - Director of Communications
Bad boy, funny, creative...
Lisa Parker - Ryan's Assistant
Sociable, sweet, loyal...
Follow us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/isitlovegames/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/isitlovegames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weareisitlovegames/
Got any problems or questions?
Contact our in-game support team by clicking on Menu and then Support.
Our story:
1492 Studio is based in Montpellier, France. It was co-founded in 2014 by Claire and Thibaud Zamora, two entrepreneurs with over twenty years’ experience in the freemium game industry. Acquired by Ubisoft in 2018, the studio has forged ahead in creating interactive stories in the form of visual novels, further enriching the content of their ""Is It Love?"" series. With a total of fourteen mobile applications with more than 60 million downloads to date, 1492 Studio designs games that take players on a journey through worlds that are rich in intrigue, suspense and, of course, romance. The studio continues to provide live games by creating additional content and keeping in touch with a strong and active fan base while working on upcoming projects.

bluejetty:00171091:ios.description:
Crime Junkies, we’ve built a Fan Club app JUST for you. You won’t just be listening to Crime Junkie… you’ll be experiencing Crime Junkie and other Audiochuck shows in a whole new way! 
We have added a variety of features to enhance your Fan Club experience:
• Ad-Free & Exclusive Episodes - As a Fan Club member, you get access to every wide release episode and every piece of exclusive content within your tier completely ad-free! All of your episodes are organized in one spot, easy for you to listen anytime, anywhere.
• Curated Collections - Enjoy collections put together by Crime Junkie that span a wide variety of shows, topics, and themes. There is always something new to discover! 
• Never Lose Your Spot - The app keeps track of what you’ve listened to and where you’ve stopped. It will save your last play location so you don’t ever lose your spot!
• Filter & Sort - You can filter by category and episode type as well as sort by newest and oldest episodes. It’s so easy to find what you’re looking for.
• Interactive Episode Experience - Don’t just listen to the episodes… follow along in the app. While you’re listening, photos in the app will automatically rotate based on what or who is being talked about in the episode. You can also see all of the photos, sources, and information from the episode right in the app.
• Get the Latest Crime Junkie News - Exclusive Fan Club announcements will be available right in the app! Don’t miss the latest from Crime Junkie, including exclusive merch and tour announcements. 
• Engage with Other Fans - You can engage with other Crime Junkie fans in the app through polls and discussion topics! You can even access the discussion thread about a certain episode directly from an episode page.
• Manage Notifications - Turn on and off any notifications from Crime Junkie anytime you want. Get messages how you want them and where you want them.
• Communicate Directly with Crime Junkie - Communicating directly with Crime Junkie is super easy in the app! Send us a DM in the Profile section.
• Easy to Navigate - The app is super easy to use so you can binge Crime Junkie and other Audiochuck shows whenever you want.

- Canlı Döviz Kurları 
- Borsa İstanbul Endeks Verileri ve Tüm Borsa Hisse Senedi Verileri (*15 dakika gecikmeli)
- Canlı Altın Fiyatları: Kapalıçarşı, Spot Piyasa, Serbest Piyasa ve Altın Büroları: (Harem, Altınkaynak, Özbey vs)
- Banka Canlı Döviz Kurları
- Amerika'da işlem gören hisse senetleri.( Nasdaq, NYSE ve diğerlerinde işlem görenler)
- Canlı Döviz Sınırsız ve ücretsiz SMS, E-Mail ve Uygulama push fiyat alarmları
- Canlı Kripto Para Birimleri ( 15.000 + Kripto Para Birimi)
- Canlı Döviz Portföy Takip ekranı. Tüm yatırımlarınızı anlık takip
Canlı Döviz ile anlık olarak dolar,euro,gram altın,sterlin,japon yeni, bitcoin, euro/dolar paritesini takip edebilir, tüm bu kurlar ve paritelerin son 6,12,24 saat veya haftalık-aylık grafiklerini görebilirsiniz.
Borsa verileri ile, tüm Borsa İstanbul endeks verileri ve Hisse Senedi verilerini 15 dakika gecikmeli ve saniyelik değişimlerle izleyebilirsiniz.
Fiyat alarmı özelliği ile dolar kuru , euro kuru, tüm döviz kurları, hisse senetleri, borsa verileri ,altın ve diğer tüm kurlar için fiyat alarmı ekleyebilir ve döviz fiyat alarmı gerçekleştiğinde 7/24 ve anında bildirim ile haberdar olabilirsiniz.
Anlık haberler ile gün içinde 200'den fazla döviz ve borsa haberini rahatça takip edin.
Tüm döviz ve borsa verileri anlık olarak yenilenmekte ve gün içindeki değişimlerinin yanı sıra, grafik yardımı ile belli zaman aralıklarında döviz değişimlerini sizlere sunmaktadır. Borsa verileri anlık değişimler ile gösterilmekte ancak 15 dakika öncesinin verisi verilmektedir. 
-Dolar , Euro , Altın ve diğer tüm döviz kurları saniyelik değişimler ile %100 anlık ve canlı olarak iletilmektedir. 
-Hızlı değişiklik gösteren dolar, euro ve tüm döviz kurlarını herhangi bir gecikme olmadan, canlı olarak takip edebilirsiniz. Fiyat alarmı özelliği, hiçbir fiyat hareketini kaçırmamanız için mükemmel bir özelliktir ve kullanımı tamamen ücretsizdir.
Borsa İstanbul'dan alınan tüm veriler 15 dakika gecikmelidir. Borsa İstanbul verilerinin dağıtım hakkı, Borsa İstanbul Alt Dağıtıcı Lisansı alınarak sizlere verilmiştir.
Dünya endeksleri ve hissleri ile nasdaq, nyse, cac, gibi 200'den fazla dünya endeksini canlı takip edenilir, Amerika'da işlem gören tüm hisse senetlerini takip edebilirsiniz.
Aylık Üyelik Detayları:
-Üyelik periyodu 1 aydır, üyelik aktif olduğu sürece uygulamada reklam görmezsiniz.
-Yukarıdaki tuşta görünen ücret, üyelik almanız durumunda Itunes hesabınıza yansıtılır.
-Üyeliğiniz, üyeliğinizin bitimine 24 saat kala iptal etmediğiniz sürece her ay yenilenir.
-Üyeliğiniz her zaman yukarıda belirtilen ücret ile 30.günde yenilenir ve kendi yerel para biriminiz kullanılır.
-Üyeliğiniz iTunes hesabınızdan veya telefonunuzun ayarlar bölümünden istediğiniz zaman sonlandırılabilir.

bluejetty:00185550:ios.description:
Download Fandango – the #1 movie ticketing app with over 2 million 5-Star Reviews! Available across iOS devices including iPhone, iPad, iMessage and Apple Watch! • BUY MOVIE TICKETS: Get your tickets ahead of time to skip the box office line and secure the best seats to the biggest movies. Save time with mobile tickets using your iPhone’s Apple Wallet or Apple Watch for quick and easy entry.
• FREE ACCOUNT: Checkout as a Guest or sign up for free for a faster, more convenient ticketing experience. Save your favorite movies, preferred theaters, payment info, and theater rewards account information while earning Fandango VIP+ rewards with each ticket.
• GET FANDANGO & THEATER REWARDS: Earn/redeem theater loyalty points AND Fandango VIP+ loyalty points. Create a free account to get a $5 reward for every 4 tickets towards Fandango movie tickets or Vudu on demand streaming. Enjoy even more rewards by linking your favorite theater reward programs like AMC Stubs, Regal Crown Club, Cinemark Movie Rewards, and more!
• SELF-SERVICE REFUNDS & EXCHANGES: If plans change, you can easily refund or exchange your tickets before the theater’s deadline with self-service refunds.
FANDANGO APP FEATURES: 
• SEARCH TODAY’S SHOWTIMES: Use the In Theaters Today time filter to quickly scan today’s showtimes across multiple theaters for selected time ranges.
• CHECK AVAILABLE SEATS: Use Seat Map Preview to easily check seat availability for all showtimes and find the best seats before purchasing your movie tickets.
• BROWSE MOVIES: Check out the latest movies in theaters and coming soon, browse Rotten Tomatoes® scores, and be the first to know when tickets go on sale with FanAlert™ email notifications. 
• WATCH MOVIE TRAILERS: Check out the latest trailers for new and upcoming movies. Like what you see? Just one tap to find the best seats or be notified when tickets go on sale.
• BROWSE THEATERS NEAR YOU: Find nearby theaters and showtimes instantly, view all theater amenities, and save your favorite theaters for easy access.
• ASK SIRI: Set shortcuts to retrieve your movie tickets, view specific movie times, and check theater locations.
• PLAN THE PERFECT MOVIE NIGHT: Make and share movie plans with Fandango for iMessage. Easily split payments with friends and get paid back with PayPal or Venmo, no more IOUs.
Fandango’s partners are the nation’s leading exhibitors, including AMC Theatres, Regal Cinemas, Cinemark, Marcus Theatres, Harkins Theatres, and many other innovative theater chains and independent cinemas. Together, these exhibitors represent more than ninety percent of the nation's theaters with online ticketing capabilities.

bluejetty:00134911:ios.description:
Now live in Pilot Phase – California DMV Mobile Wallet
Californians now have a secure way to present their driver’s license or identification card using their smartphones via a Mobile Driver’s License (mDL) digital credential.
California DMV Wallet gives you the control of the driver’s license data you share with others. For example, when buying age-restricted items, the app can confirm you are of legal age without having to share your birth date or address.
With mDL in your CA DMV Wallet, you can breeze through the TSA queue at the airports using your phone. You can also enroll in the TruAge program via the Wallet Marketplace to purchase age-verified products at a corner store near you (starting with select pilot locations in California and expanding nationally). The Wallet will soon be supporting online identity verification for government and commercial applications. 
Designed with California's diverse population in mind, the CA DMV Wallet open-source platform uses state-of-the-art encryption algorithms and security technologies to combat fraud and reduce identity theft while improving privacy, transparency, and access for all Californians with a smartphone.
Important note: While the mDL can be used as an official state-issued ID, per the pilot scope approved by the California legislature, you must still have a physical driver’s license or identification card with you.
For more information, please visit: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/ca-dmv-wallet/
California DMV Wallet is free, easy, secure, and convenient

apple-macos:6444531544.name: MoneyWell : Personal Budgeting
apple-macos:6444531544.description:
MoneyWell is a personal finance package built around the concept of envelope budgeting. It's designed to keep you from overspending by using proactive budgeting techniques. It also helps you direct your extra money to debt reduction and savings so you end up with a nice cash buffer for emergencies and a more stress-free life.
You can download it for free, look at a sample budget or try setting up your own. There's no time limit and it's fully featured except you can only create 200 transactions in "Free mode". If you like what you see, there's a subscription which unlocks unlimited transactions. 
We'll never remove access to your data, so even if your subscription expires and you return to "Free mode", you'll still be able to view and export your data.
Too many other financial tools rely on end of the month budget reports to keep your spending in line, but by that time it's too late to fix anything. We call this regret-based budgeting, where you print reports and then regret not sticking to your plan. It's a broken system that most people can't use. With MoneyWell, there's one simple rule: Spend only what you have in your buckets.
MoneyWell will help you by allowing you to create a spending plan and then telling you how much you need to save in each bucket category to meet your goals.
